            for x1, x2 in loader:
                x = torch.cat([x1, x2], dim=0).to(device, non_blocking=True)
                if device.type == "cuda":
                    with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.float16):
                        f = model(x)
                else:
                    f = model(x)
                f = f.float()
                b = x1.size(0)
                emb = torch.cat([f[:b], f[b:]], dim=1).cpu().numpy()
                parts.append(emb)

        emb_all = np.vstack(parts).astype(np.float32)
        embeddings_train[model_name] = emb_all[:n_train]
        embeddings_test[model_name] = emb_all[n_train:]
        success.append(model_name)
        print(
            f"Extracted {model_name}: {emb_all.shape}, "
            f"time {time.time() - start:.1f}s",
            flush=True,
        )

        del model
        if device.type == "cuda":
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return success, embeddings_train, embeddings_test


def fit_pcas(tr_idx, encoders, embeddings_train):
    pcas = {}
    for enc in encoders:
        emb = embeddings_train[enc][tr_idx]
        n_comp = min(EMBED_PCA_DIM, emb.shape[1], len(tr_idx) - 1)
        pca = PCA(n_components=n_comp, svd_solver="randomized", random_state=SEED)
        pca.fit(emb)
        pcas[enc] = pca
    return pcas


def apply_features(indices, pcas, encoders, embeddings, meta_feats):
    parts = [meta_feats[indices]]
    for enc in encoders:
        emb = embeddings[enc][indices]
        parts.append(pcas[enc].transform(emb).astype(np.float32))
    return np.hstack(parts).astype(np.float32)


def train_lgb_model(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y_va, X_te, params, sample_weight=None):
    params = params.copy()
    dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, weight=sample_weight)
    dva = lgb.Dataset(X_va, label=y_va, reference=dtr)

    def _run():
        return lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=3000,
            valid_sets=[dva],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(100), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )

    try:
        model = _run()
    except Exception:
        if params.get("objective") == "huber":
            params["objective"] = "regression"
            model = _run()
        else:
            raise

    val_pred = model.predict(X_va, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    test_pred = model.predict(X_te, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    return np.clip(val_pred, 0, 100), np.clip(test_pred, 0, 100)


def run_meta_cv(meta_train, y, meta_test, folds, objective="mse"):
    oof = np.zeros(len(y), dtype=np.float32)
    test_pred = np.zeros(len(meta_test), dtype=np.float32)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(folds):
        params = get_params(objective, fold)
        val_pred, te_pred = train_lgb_model(
            meta_train[tr_idx],
            y[tr_idx],
            meta_train[va_idx],
            y[va_idx],
            meta_test,
            params,
        )
        oof[va_idx] = val_pred
        test_pred += te_pred / len(folds)

    return np.clip(oof, 0, 100), np.clip(test_pred, 0, 100)


def run_self_training_cv(
    train_df,
    test_df,
    folds,
    encoders,
    embeddings_train,
    embeddings_test,
    meta_train,
    meta_test,
):
    y = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)
    test_idx = np.arange(len(test_df))

    teacher_mse_oof = np.zeros(len(train_df), dtype=np.float32)
    student_mse_oof = np.zeros(len(train_df), dtype=np.float32)
    teacher_huber_oof = np.zeros(len(train_df), dtype=np.float32)
    student_huber_oof = np.zeros(len(train_df), dtype=np.float32)

    teacher_mse_test = np.zeros(len(test_df), dtype=np.float32)
    student_mse_test = np.zeros(len(test_df), dtype=np.float32)
    teacher_huber_test = np.zeros(len(test_df), dtype=np.float32)
    student_huber_test = np.zeros(len(test_df), dtype=np.float32)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(folds):
        print(f"--- Self-training fold {fold + 1}/{N_FOLDS} ---", flush=True)
        fold_start = time.time()

        pcas = fit_pcas(tr_idx, encoders, embeddings_train)
        X_tr = apply_features(tr_idx, pcas, encoders, embeddings_train, meta_train)
        X_va = apply_features(va_idx, pcas, encoders, embeddings_train, meta_train)
        X_te = apply_features(test_idx, pcas, encoders, embeddings_test, meta_test)

        # MSE teacher
        val_t, te_t = train_lgb_model(
            X_tr,
            y[tr_idx],
            X_va,
            y[va_idx],
            X_te,
            get_params("mse", fold),
        )

        # MSE student with test pseudo-labels
        pseudo_t = np.clip(te_t, 0, 100)
        X_stu = np.vstack([X_tr, X_te])
        y_stu = np.concatenate([y[tr_idx], pseudo_t])
        w_stu = np.concatenate(
            [
                np.ones(len(tr_idx), dtype=np.float32),
                np.full(len(X_te), PSEUDO_WEIGHT, dtype=np.float32),
            ]
        )
        val_s, te_s = train_lgb_model(
            X_stu,
            y_stu,
            X_va,
            y[va_idx],
            X_te,
            get_params("mse", fold),
            sample_weight=w_stu,
        )

        # Huber teacher
        val_th, te_th = train_lgb_model(
            X_tr,
            y[tr_idx],
            X_va,
            y[va_idx],
            X_te,
            get_params("huber", fold),
        )

        # Huber student with test pseudo-labels
        pseudo_th = np.clip(te_th, 0, 100)
        X_stu_h = np.vstack([X_tr, X_te])
        y_stu_h = np.concatenate([y[tr_idx], pseudo_th])
        w_stu_h = np.concatenate(
            [
                np.ones(len(tr_idx), dtype=np.float32),
                np.full(len(X_te), PSEUDO_WEIGHT, dtype=np.float32),
            ]
        )
        val_sh, te_sh = train_lgb_model(
            X_stu_h,
            y_stu_h,
            X_va,
            y[va_idx],
            X_te,
            get_params("huber", fold),
            sample_weight=w_stu_h,
        )

        teacher_mse_oof[va_idx] = val_t
        student_mse_oof[va_idx] = val_s
        teacher_huber_oof[va_idx] = val_th
        student_huber_oof[va_idx] = val_sh

        teacher_mse_test += te_t / len(folds)
        student_mse_test += te_s / len(folds)
        teacher_huber_test += te_th / len(folds)
        student_huber_test += te_sh / len(folds)

        print(
            f"Fold {fold + 1}: teacher_mse={rmse_score(y[va_idx], val_t):.4f}, "
            f"student_mse={rmse_score(y[va_idx], val_s):.4f}, "
            f"teacher_huber={rmse_score(y[va_idx], val_th):.4f}, "
            f"student_huber={rmse_score(y[va_idx], val_sh):.4f}, "
            f"time={time.time() - fold_start:.1f}s",
            flush=True,
        )

    return {
        "teacher_mse": (teacher_mse_oof, teacher_mse_test),
        "student_mse": (student_mse_oof, student_mse_test),
        "teacher_huber": (teacher_huber_oof, teacher_huber_test),
        "student_huber": (student_huber_oof, student_huber_test),
    }


def optimize_weights(pred_list, y):
    n = len(pred_list)

    def objective(w):
        p = np.zeros_like(pred_list[0])
        for i in range(n):
            p += w[i] * pred_list[i]
        return mean_squared_error(y, p)

    try:
        from scipy.optimize import minimize
    except Exception:
        minimize = None

    if minimize is None:
        w0 = np.ones(n) / n
        return w0, np.sqrt(objective(w0))

    cons = {"type": "eq", "fun": lambda w: np.sum(w) - 1.0}
    bounds = [(0.0, 1.0)] * n
    w0 = np.ones(n) / n

    res = minimize(
        objective,
        w0,
        method="SLSQP",
        bounds=bounds,
        constraints=cons,
        options={"maxiter": 1000, "ftol": 1e-12},
    )

    if not res.success:
        print("Weight optimization warning:", res.message, flush=True)

    w = np.clip(res.x, 0.0, 1.0)
    if w.sum() > 0:
        w = w / w.sum()
    return w, np.sqrt(objective(w))


def main():
    set_seed(SEED)

    train_df = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    y = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)
    print(f"Train size: {len(train_df)}, Test size: {len(test_df)}", flush=True)

    folds = list(
        KFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED).split(train_df)
    )

    print("Computing image statistics...", flush=True)
    stats_train = compute_image_stats(train_df, TRAIN_DIR)
    stats_test = compute_image_stats(test_df, TEST_DIR)
    meta_train = make_meta_features(train_df, stats_train)
    meta_test = make_meta_features(test_df, stats_test)

    print("Training metadata-only LightGBM fallback...", flush=True)
    meta_oof, meta_test_pred = run_meta_cv(meta_train, y, meta_test, folds, "mse")
    print(f"Metadata-only OOF RMSE: {rmse_score(y, meta_oof):.4f}", flush=True)

    sub = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"].values, "Pawpularity": meta_test_pred})
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved fallback submission.csv", flush=True)

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Using device: {device}", flush=True)

    n_train = len(train_df)
    all_ids = np.concatenate(
        [
            train_df["Id"].values.astype(str),
            test_df["Id"].values.astype(str),
        ]
    )
    all_dirs = np.concatenate(
        [
            np.full(n_train, TRAIN_DIR, dtype=object),
            np.full(len(test_df), TEST_DIR, dtype=object),
        ]
    )

    print("Extracting multi-encoder image embeddings...", flush=True)
    encoders, embeddings_train, embeddings_test = extract_embeddings(
        all_ids, all_dirs, n_train, device
    )

    if len(encoders) == 0:
        print(
            "No pretrained encoders available; keeping metadata-only submission.",
            flush=True,
        )
        final_oof = meta_oof
        final_test = meta_test_pred
        final_cv = rmse_score(y, meta_oof)
    else:
        print(f"Using encoders: {encoders}", flush=True)
        result = run_self_training_cv(
            train_df,
            test_df,
            folds,
            encoders,
            embeddings_train,
            embeddings_test,
            meta_train,
            meta_test,
        )

        for name, (oof, _) in result.items():
            print(f"{name} OOF RMSE: {rmse_score(y, oof):.4f}", flush=True)

        names = list(result.keys())
        oof_list = [result[n][0] for n in names]
        test_list = [result[n][1] for n in names]
        oof_list.append(meta_oof)
        test_list.append(meta_test_pred)
        names.append("meta")

        weights, final_cv = optimize_weights(oof_list, y)

        print("Blend weights:", flush=True)
        for name, w in zip(names, weights):
            print(f"  {name}: {w:.4f}", flush=True)

        final_test = np.zeros_like(test_list[0])
        for w, pred in zip(weights, test_list):
            final_test += w * pred
        final_test = np.clip(final_test, 0, 100)
        final_oof = np.zeros_like(oof_list[0])
        for w, pred in zip(weights, oof_list):
            final_oof += w * pred

    final_cv = rmse_score(y, np.clip(final_oof, 0, 100))
    print(f"Final 5-fold CV RMSE: {final_cv:.4f}", flush=True)

    sub = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Id": test_df["Id"].values,
            "Pawpularity": np.clip(final_test, 0, 100),
        }
    )
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved final submission.csv", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import random
import time
import traceback
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image, ImageOps

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from torch.optim import AdamW

from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb
import timm

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

META_COLS = [
    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",
    "Face",
    "Near",
    "Action",
    "Accessory",
    "Group",
    "Collage",
    "Human",
    "Occlusion",
    "Info",
    "Blur",
]
STAT_COLS = [
    "StatMean",
    "StatStd",
    "StatColorful",
    "StatEdge",
    "StatArrStd",
    "StatArrMean",
    "StatRange",
    "StatAspect",
]
TAB_COLS = META_COLS + STAT_COLS
TARGET = "Pawpularity"
IMAGE_DIR_TRAIN = "data/train"
IMAGE_DIR_TEST = "data/test"

IMG_SIZE = 224
BATCH_SIZE = 24
EPOCHS = 8
PATIENCE = 2
N_FOLDS = 5
SEED = 42
AUX_WEIGHT = 0.3
D_MODEL = 256
BACKBONE_LR = 5e-5
HEAD_LR = 1e-3
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4

IMAGENET_MEAN = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
IMAGENET_STD = [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]

DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
BACKBONE_NAME = None

try:
    IMG_RESAMPLE = Image.Resampling.BILINEAR
except AttributeError:
    IMG_RESAMPLE = Image.BILINEAR


def set_seed(seed=SEED):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = False


def rmse_score(y_true, y_pred):
    return float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)))


def compute_image_stats(df, image_dir):
    ids = df["Id"].values
    stats = np.zeros((len(df), 8), dtype=np.float32)

    for i, img_id in enumerate(ids):
        path = os.path.join(image_dir, img_id + ".jpg")
        try:
            with Image.open(path) as img:
                img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img).convert("RGB")
                w, h = img.size
                img_small = img.resize((48, 48), IMG_RESAMPLE)
                arr = np.asarray(img_small, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        except Exception:
            stats[i, :7] = 0.5
            stats[i, 7] = 1.0
            continue

        r = arr[..., 0]
        g = arr[..., 1]
        b = arr[..., 2]
        gray = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b

        rg = r - g
        yb = 0.5 * (r + g) - b
        colorfulness = np.sqrt(rg.std() ** 2 + yb.std() ** 2) + 0.3 * np.sqrt(
            rg.mean() ** 2 + yb.mean() ** 2
        )
        gy, gx = np.gradient(gray)
        edge = np.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy).mean()

        stats[i, 0] = gray.mean()
        stats[i, 1] = gray.std()
        stats[i, 2] = colorfulness
        stats[i, 3] = edge
        stats[i, 4] = arr.std()
        stats[i, 5] = arr.mean()
        stats[i, 6] = gray.max() - gray.min()
        stats[i, 7] = w / max(h, 1)

    return stats


def build_features(df, stats):
    X = df[META_COLS].values.astype(np.float32)
    n = X.shape[1]
    idx0, idx1 = np.triu_indices(n, k=1)
    interactions = X[:, idx0] * X[:, idx1]
    count = X.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return np.hstack([X, interactions, count, stats]).astype(np.float32)


def run_lightgbm_meta(train_df, test_df, train_stats, test_stats, folds):
    X_train = build_features(train_df, train_stats)
    X_test = build_features(test_df, test_stats)
    y = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)

    oof = np.zeros(len(train_df), dtype=np.float32)
    test_pred = np.zeros(len(test_df), dtype=np.float32)

    params = {
        "objective": "regression",
        "metric": "rmse",
        "learning_rate": 0.03,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "feature_fraction": 0.7,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": SEED,
    }

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(folds):
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_train[tr_idx], label=y[tr_idx])
        dva = lgb.Dataset(X_train[va_idx], label=y[va_idx], reference=dtr)
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=3000,
            valid_sets=[dva],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(150), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof[va_idx] = model.predict(X_train[va_idx], num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
        test_pred += model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) / len(
            folds
        )

    return np.clip(oof, 0, 100), np.clip(test_pred, 0, 100)


class PetDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, image_dir, is_train=False):
        self.ids = df["Id"].values
        self.image_dir = image_dir
        self.tab = df[TAB_COLS].values.astype(np.float32)

        if TARGET in df.columns:
            self.targets = df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32) / 100.0
        else:
            self.targets = np.zeros(len(df), dtype=np.float32)

        if is_train:
            self.transform = transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomResizedCrop(
                        size=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE),
                        scale=(0.6, 1.0),
                        ratio=(0.8, 1.25),
                    ),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.ColorJitter(
                        brightness=0.15, contrast=0.15, saturation=0.1, hue=0.03
                    ),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize(IMAGENET_MEAN, IMAGENET_STD),
                ]
            )
        else:
            self.transform = transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE)),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize(IMAGENET_MEAN, IMAGENET_STD),
                ]
            )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, self.ids[idx] + ".jpg")
        with Image.open(path) as img:
            img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img).convert("RGB")
        img = self.transform(img)

        tab = torch.from_numpy(self.tab[idx])
        target = torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float32)
        aux = tab[:12].clone()

        return img, tab, target, aux


class CrossModalPetModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, backbone_name, input_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            backbone_name,
            pretrained=True,
            features_only=True,
            out_indices=[3, 4],
        )

        all_chs = list(self.backbone.feature_info.channels())
        if len(all_chs) >= 5:
            ch3, ch4 = all_chs[3], all_chs[4]
        elif len(all_chs) >= 2:
            ch3, ch4 = all_chs[-2], all_chs[-1]
        else:
            ch3 = ch4 = all_chs[-1]

        self.ch3 = ch3
        self.ch4 = ch4
        d = D_MODEL

        self.proj3 = nn.Linear(ch3, d)
        self.proj4 = nn.Linear(ch4, d)

        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1024, d))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos_embed, mean=0.0, std=0.02)

        self.meta_embed = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, d),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(d, d),
        )
        self.q_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.kv_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.out_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            d, num_heads=8, batch_first=True, dropout=0.1
        )

        self.reg_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d + input_dim, 128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, 1),
        )

        self.aux_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(ch3 + ch4, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(128, 12),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        feats = self.backbone(img)

        if isinstance(feats, dict):
            f3 = feats["3"]
            f4 = feats["4"]
        elif isinstance(feats, (list, tuple)):
            f3, f4 = feats[0], feats[1]
        else:
            f3, f4 = feats, feats

        t3 = self.proj3(f3).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        t4 = self.proj4(f4).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        tokens = torch.cat([t3, t4], dim=1)
        tokens = tokens + self.pos_embed[:, : tokens.size(1), :].to(tokens.dtype)

        q0 = self.meta_embed(tab).unsqueeze(1)
        q = self.q_norm(q0)
        kv = self.kv_norm(tokens)

        attn_out, _ = self.cross_attn(q, kv, kv)
        out = self.out_norm(q0 + attn_out).squeeze(1)

        pred = self.reg_head(torch.cat([out, tab.to(out.dtype)], dim=1)).squeeze(-1)

        pool3 = torch.flatten(F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(f3, 1), 1)
        pool4 = torch.flatten(F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(f4, 1), 1)
        aux_logits = self.aux_head(torch.cat([pool3, pool4], dim=1))

        return pred, aux_logits


def predict(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    preds = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for img, tab, _, _ in loader:
            img = img.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            tab = tab.to(device, non_blocking=True)

            if device.type == "cuda":
                with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.float16):
                    pred, _ = model(img, tab)
                    pred_flip, _ = model(torch.flip(img, dims=[3]), tab)
                pred = ((pred.float() + pred_flip.float()) * 0.5) * 100.0
            else:
                pred, _ = model(img, tab)
                pred_flip, _ = model(torch.flip(img, dims=[3]), tab)
                pred = ((pred.float() + pred_flip.float()) * 0.5) * 100.0

            preds.append(pred.cpu().numpy())

    return np.clip(np.concatenate(preds), 0, 100)


def train_fold(fold, tr_df, va_df, te_df, device):
    set_seed(SEED + fold)

    train_ds = PetDataset(tr_df, IMAGE_DIR_TRAIN, is_train=True)
    valid_ds = PetDataset(va_df, IMAGE_DIR_TRAIN, is_train=False)
    test_ds = PetDataset(te_df, IMAGE_DIR_TEST, is_train=False)

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
        drop_last=True,
    )
    valid_loader = DataLoader(
        valid_ds,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        test_ds,
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=False,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
    )

    model = CrossModalPetModel(BACKBONE_NAME, len(TAB_COLS)).to(device)

    backbone_params = list(model.backbone.parameters())
    head_params = [
        p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if not n.startswith("backbone")
    ]

    optimizer = AdamW(
        [
            {
                "params": backbone_params,
                "lr": BACKBONE_LR,
                "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
            },
            {"params": head_params, "lr": HEAD_LR, "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY},
        ]
    )
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
        optimizer, T_max=EPOCHS, eta_min=1e-6
    )

    criterion_reg = nn.MSELoss()
    criterion_aux = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(enabled=(device.type == "cuda"))

    best_rmse = float("inf")
    best_state = None
    patience = 0
    use_cuda = device.type == "cuda"

    for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        running_loss = 0.0

        for img, tab, y, aux in train_loader:
            img = img.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            tab = tab.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            y = y.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            aux = aux.to(device, non_blocking=True)

            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

            if use_cuda:
                with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.float16):
                    pred, aux_logits = model(img, tab)
                loss = criterion_reg(pred.float(), y) + AUX_WEIGHT * criterion_aux(
                    aux_logits.float(), aux
                )
            else:
                pred, aux_logits = model(img, tab)
                loss = criterion_reg(pred.float(), y) + AUX_WEIGHT * criterion_aux(
                    aux_logits.float(), aux
                )

            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            if use_cuda:
                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()

            running_loss += loss.item()

        scheduler.step()

        val_pred = predict(model, valid_loader, device)
        val_rmse = rmse_score(va_df[TARGET].values, val_pred)
        print(
            f"Fold {fold + 1} epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS} "
            f"train_loss {running_loss / max(len(train_loader), 1):.4f} "
            f"val_rmse {val_rmse:.4f}",
            flush=True,
        )

        if val_rmse < best_rmse - 1e-4:
            best_rmse = val_rmse
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
            patience = 0

            patience += 1

                    f"Fold {fold + 1}: early stopping at epoch {epoch}",
                    flush=True,

        best_state = {
            k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
        }

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    val_pred = predict(model, valid_loader, device)
    test_pred = predict(model, test_loader, device)

    del model, best_state
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return val_pred, test_pred


def run_deep_cv(train_df, test_df, folds, device):
    oof = np.zeros(len(train_df), dtype=np.float32)
    test_pred = np.zeros(len(test_df), dtype=np.float32)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(folds):
        print(f"--- Cross-modal fold {fold + 1}/{N_FOLDS} ---", flush=True)
        tr_df = train_df.iloc[tr_idx]
        va_df = train_df.iloc[va_idx]
        start = time.time()

        try:
            val_pred, te_pred = train_fold(fold, tr_df, va_df, test_df, device)
        except Exception:
            traceback.print_exc()
            return None, None

        if val_pred is None:
            return None, None

        oof[va_idx] = val_pred
        test_pred += te_pred / len(folds)

        fold_rmse = rmse_score(train_df[TARGET].values[va_idx], val_pred)
        print(
            f"Fold {fold + 1} cross-modal OOF RMSE: {fold_rmse:.4f} "
            f"time: {time.time() - start:.1f}s",
            flush=True,
        )

    return oof, test_pred


def find_best_weight(p1, p2, y):
    best_w = 0.0
    best_rmse = float("inf")

    for w in np.linspace(0, 1, 101):
        pred = np.clip(w * p1 + (1 - w) * p2, 0, 100)
        current_rmse = rmse_score(y, pred)
        if current_rmse < best_rmse:
            best_rmse = current_rmse
            best_w = w

    return best_w, best_rmse


def choose_backbone():
    for name in ["efficientnet_b4", "efficientnet_b0", "resnet50"]:
        try:
            model = timm.create_model(
                name,
                pretrained=True,
                features_only=True,
                out_indices=[3, 4],
            )
            _ = model.feature_info.channels()
            del model
            print(f"Using pretrained backbone: {name}", flush=True)
            return name
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"Could not load {name}: {exc}", flush=True)
    return None


def main():
    global BACKBONE_NAME
    set_seed(SEED)

    train_df = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

    print(f"Train size: {len(train_df)}, Test size: {len(test_df)}", flush=True)

    folds = list(
        KFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED).split(train_df)
    )

    print("Computing image statistics...", flush=True)
    train_stats = compute_image_stats(train_df, IMAGE_DIR_TRAIN)
    test_stats = compute_image_stats(test_df, IMAGE_DIR_TEST)

    train_df = pd.concat(
        [train_df, pd.DataFrame(train_stats, columns=STAT_COLS)], axis=1
    )
    test_df = pd.concat([test_df, pd.DataFrame(test_stats, columns=STAT_COLS)], axis=1)

    lgb_oof, lgb_test = run_lightgbm_meta(
        train_df, test_df, train_stats, test_stats, folds
    )
    y = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)
    lgb_rmse = rmse_score(y, lgb_oof)
    print(f"LightGBM (metadata + image stats) OOF RMSE: {lgb_rmse:.4f}", flush=True)

    sub = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Id": test_df["Id"].values,
            "Pawpularity": lgb_test,
        }
    )
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved fallback LightGBM submission.csv", flush=True)

    BACKBONE_NAME = choose_backbone()
    if BACKBONE_NAME is None:
        print(
            "No pretrained backbone available; keeping LightGBM submission.", flush=True
        )
        return

    print("Starting cross-modal fine-tuning...", flush=True)
    deep_oof, deep_test = run_deep_cv(train_df, test_df, folds, DEVICE)

    if deep_oof is None or not np.isfinite(deep_oof).all():
        print("Deep training failed; keeping LightGBM submission.", flush=True)
        return

    deep_rmse = rmse_score(y, deep_oof)
    print(f"Cross-modal OOF RMSE: {deep_rmse:.4f}", flush=True)

    best_w, blend_rmse = find_best_weight(deep_oof, lgb_oof, y)
    print(f"Best deep blend weight: {best_w:.3f}", flush=True)
    print(f"Final blend OOF RMSE: {blend_rmse:.4f}", flush=True)

    final_test = np.clip(best_w * deep_test + (1 - best_w) * lgb_test, 0, 100)
    sub["Pawpularity"] = final_test
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved final submission.csv", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os

import time
import traceback
import warnings

import numpy as np

import torch.nn as nn

from torch.optim import AdamW

from sklearn.model_selection import KFold

import lightgbm as lgb
import timm

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

META_COLS = [
    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",
    "Face",
    "Near",
    "Action",
    "Accessory",
    "Group",
    "Collage",
    "Human",
    "Occlusion",
    "Info",
    "Blur",
]
STAT_COLS = [
    "StatMean",
    "StatStd",
    "StatColorful",
    "StatEdge",
    "StatArrStd",
    "StatArrMean",
    "StatRange",
    "StatAspect",
]
TAB_COLS = META_COLS + STAT_COLS
TARGET = "Pawpularity"
IMAGE_DIR_TRAIN = "data/train"
IMAGE_DIR_TEST = "data/test"

IMG_SIZE = 224
BATCH_SIZE = 24
EPOCHS = 8
PATIENCE = 2
N_FOLDS = 5
SEED = 42
AUX_WEIGHT = 0.3
D_MODEL = 256
BACKBONE_LR = 5e-5
HEAD_LR = 1e-3
WEIGHT_DECAY = 1e-4

IMAGENET_MEAN = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
IMAGENET_STD = [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]

DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
BACKBONE_NAME = None

try:
    IMG_RESAMPLE = Image.Resampling.BILINEAR
except AttributeError:
    IMG_RESAMPLE = Image.BILINEAR


def set_seed(seed=SEED):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = False


def rmse_score(y_true, y_pred):
    return float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)))


def compute_image_stats(df, image_dir):
    ids = df["Id"].values
    stats = np.zeros((len(df), 8), dtype=np.float32)

    for i, img_id in enumerate(ids):
        path = os.path.join(image_dir, img_id + ".jpg")
        try:
            with Image.open(path) as img:
                img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img).convert("RGB")
                w, h = img.size
                img_small = img.resize((48, 48), IMG_RESAMPLE)
                arr = np.asarray(img_small, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        except Exception:
            stats[i, :7] = 0.5
            stats[i, 7] = 1.0
            continue

        r = arr[..., 0]
        g = arr[..., 1]
        b = arr[..., 2]
        gray = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b

        rg = r - g
        yb = 0.5 * (r + g) - b
        colorfulness = np.sqrt(rg.std() ** 2 + yb.std() ** 2) + 0.3 * np.sqrt(
            rg.mean() ** 2 + yb.mean() ** 2
        )
        gy, gx = np.gradient(gray)
        edge = np.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy).mean()

        stats[i, 0] = gray.mean()
        stats[i, 1] = gray.std()
        stats[i, 2] = colorfulness
        stats[i, 3] = edge
        stats[i, 4] = arr.std()
        stats[i, 5] = arr.mean()
        stats[i, 6] = gray.max() - gray.min()
        stats[i, 7] = w / max(h, 1)

    return stats


def build_features(df, stats):
    X = df[META_COLS].values.astype(np.float32)
    n = X.shape[1]
    idx0, idx1 = np.triu_indices(n, k=1)
    interactions = X[:, idx0] * X[:, idx1]
    count = X.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return np.hstack([X, interactions, count, stats]).astype(np.float32)


def run_lightgbm_meta(train_df, test_df, train_stats, test_stats, folds):
    X_train = build_features(train_df, train_stats)
    X_test = build_features(test_df, test_stats)
    y = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)

    oof = np.zeros(len(train_df), dtype=np.float32)
    test_pred = np.zeros(len(test_df), dtype=np.float32)

    params = {
        "objective": "regression",
        "metric": "rmse",
        "learning_rate": 0.03,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "feature_fraction": 0.7,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": SEED,
    }

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(folds):
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_train[tr_idx], label=y[tr_idx])
        dva = lgb.Dataset(X_train[va_idx], label=y[va_idx], reference=dtr)
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=3000,
            valid_sets=[dva],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(150), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof[va_idx] = model.predict(X_train[va_idx], num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
        test_pred += model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) / len(
            folds
        )

    return np.clip(oof, 0, 100), np.clip(test_pred, 0, 100)


class PetDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, image_dir, is_train=False):
        self.ids = df["Id"].values
        self.image_dir = image_dir
        self.tab = df[TAB_COLS].values.astype(np.float32)

        if TARGET in df.columns:
            self.targets = df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32) / 100.0
        else:
            self.targets = np.zeros(len(df), dtype=np.float32)

        if is_train:
            self.transform = transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.RandomResizedCrop(
                        size=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE),
                        scale=(0.6, 1.0),
                        ratio=(0.8, 1.25),
                    ),
                    transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
                    transforms.ColorJitter(
                        brightness=0.15, contrast=0.15, saturation=0.1, hue=0.03
                    ),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize(IMAGENET_MEAN, IMAGENET_STD),
                ]
            )
        else:
            self.transform = transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE)),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize(IMAGENET_MEAN, IMAGENET_STD),
                ]
            )

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        path = os.path.join(self.image_dir, self.ids[idx] + ".jpg")
        with Image.open(path) as img:
            img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img).convert("RGB")
        img = self.transform(img)

        tab = torch.from_numpy(self.tab[idx])
        target = torch.tensor(self.targets[idx], dtype=torch.float32)
        aux = tab[:12].clone()

        return img, tab, target, aux


class CrossModalPetModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, backbone_name, input_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = timm.create_model(
            backbone_name,
            pretrained=True,
            features_only=True,
            out_indices=[3, 4],
        )

        all_chs = list(self.backbone.feature_info.channels())
        if len(all_chs) >= 5:
            ch3, ch4 = all_chs[3], all_chs[4]
        elif len(all_chs) >= 2:
            ch3, ch4 = all_chs[-2], all_chs[-1]
        else:
            ch3 = ch4 = all_chs[-1]

        self.ch3 = ch3
        self.ch4 = ch4
        d = D_MODEL

        # Use 1x1 convs to project 4D feature maps safely.
        self.proj3 = nn.Conv2d(ch3, d, 1)
        self.proj4 = nn.Conv2d(ch4, d, 1)

        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, 1024, d))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos_embed, mean=0.0, std=0.02)

        self.meta_embed = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, d),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(d, d),
        )
        self.q_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.kv_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.out_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            d, num_heads=8, batch_first=True, dropout=0.1
        )

        self.reg_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d + input_dim, 128),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, 1),
        )

        self.aux_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(ch3 + ch4, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.1),
            nn.Linear(128, 12),
        )

    def forward(self, img, tab):
        feats = self.backbone(img)

        if isinstance(feats, dict):
            f3 = feats["3"]
            f4 = feats["4"]
        elif isinstance(feats, (list, tuple)):
            f3, f4 = feats[0], feats[1]
        else:
            f3, f4 = feats, feats

        t3 = self.proj3(f3).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        t4 = self.proj4(f4).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        tokens = torch.cat([t3, t4], dim=1)
        tokens = tokens + self.pos_embed[:, : tokens.size(1), :].to(tokens.dtype)

        q0 = self.meta_embed(tab).unsqueeze(1)
        q = self.q_norm(q0)
        kv = self.kv_norm(tokens)

        attn_out, _ = self.cross_attn(q, kv, kv)
        out = self.out_norm(q0 + attn_out).squeeze(1)

        pred = self.reg_head(torch.cat([out, tab.to(out.dtype)], dim=1)).squeeze(-1)

        pool3 = torch.flatten(F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(f3, 1), 1)
        pool4 = torch.flatten(F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(f4, 1), 1)
        aux_logits = self.aux_head(torch.cat([pool3, pool4], dim=1))

        return pred, aux_logits

                pred = ((pred.float() + pred_flip.float()) * 0.5) * 100.0

            preds.append(pred.cpu().numpy())

def train_fold(fold, tr_df, va_df, te_df, device):

    ]

        [
            {

                "lr": BACKBONE_LR,

        ]

    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(

    )

    criterion_reg = nn.MSELoss()
    criterion_aux = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
    scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(enabled=(device.type == "cuda"))

    best_rmse = float("inf")
    best_state = None

        for img, tab, y, aux in train_loader:
            img = img.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            tab = tab.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            y = y.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            aux = aux.to(device, non_blocking=True)

            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

            if use_cuda:
                with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.float16):
                    pred, aux_logits = model(img, tab)
                loss = criterion_reg(pred.float(), y) + AUX_WEIGHT * criterion_aux(
                    aux_logits.float(), aux
                )
            else:
                pred, aux_logits = model(img, tab)
                loss = criterion_reg(pred.float(), y) + AUX_WEIGHT * criterion_aux(
                    aux_logits.float(), aux
                )

            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            if use_cuda:
                scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()

            running_loss += loss.item()

        scheduler.step()

        val_pred = predict(model, valid_loader, device)
        val_rmse = rmse_score(va_df[TARGET].values, val_pred)
        print(
            f"Fold {fold + 1} epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS} "
            f"train_loss {running_loss / max(len(train_loader), 1):.4f} "
            f"val_rmse {val_rmse:.4f}",
            flush=True,
        )

        if val_rmse < best_rmse - 1e-4:
            best_rmse = val_rmse
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
            patience = 0
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= PATIENCE:
                print(
                    f"Fold {fold + 1}: early stopping at epoch {epoch}",
                    flush=True,
                )
                break

    if best_state is None:
        best_state = {
            k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
        }

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    val_pred = predict(model, valid_loader, device)
    test_pred = predict(model, test_loader, device)

    del model, best_state
    if device.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return val_pred, test_pred


def run_deep_cv(train_df, test_df, folds, device):
    oof = np.zeros(len(train_df), dtype=np.float32)
    test_pred = np.zeros(len(test_df), dtype=np.float32)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(folds):
        print(f"--- Cross-modal fold {fold + 1}/{N_FOLDS} ---", flush=True)
        tr_df = train_df.iloc[tr_idx]
        va_df = train_df.iloc[va_idx]
        start = time.time()

        try:
            val_pred, te_pred = train_fold(fold, tr_df, va_df, test_df, device)
        except Exception:
            traceback.print_exc()
            return None, None

        if val_pred is None:
            return None, None

        oof[va_idx] = val_pred
        test_pred += te_pred / len(folds)

        fold_rmse = rmse_score(train_df[TARGET].values[va_idx], val_pred)
        print(
            f"Fold {fold + 1} cross-modal OOF RMSE: {fold_rmse:.4f} "
            f"time: {time.time() - start:.1f}s",
            flush=True,
        )

    return oof, test_pred


def find_best_weight(p1, p2, y):
    best_w = 0.0
    best_rmse = float("inf")

    for w in np.linspace(0, 1, 101):
        pred = np.clip(w * p1 + (1 - w) * p2, 0, 100)
        current_rmse = rmse_score(y, pred)
        if current_rmse < best_rmse:
            best_rmse = current_rmse
            best_w = w

    return best_w, best_rmse


def choose_backbone():
    for name in ["efficientnet_b4", "efficientnet_b0", "resnet50"]:
        try:
            model = timm.create_model(
                name,
                pretrained=True,
                features_only=True,
                out_indices=[3, 4],
            )
            _ = model.feature_info.channels()
            del model
            print(f"Using pretrained backbone: {name}", flush=True)
            return name
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"Could not load {name}: {exc}", flush=True)
    return None


def main():
    global BACKBONE_NAME
    set_seed(SEED)

    train_df = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

    print(f"Train size: {len(train_df)}, Test size: {len(test_df)}", flush=True)

    folds = list(
        KFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED).split(train_df)
    )

    print("Computing image statistics...", flush=True)
    train_stats = compute_image_stats(train_df, IMAGE_DIR_TRAIN)
    test_stats = compute_image_stats(test_df, IMAGE_DIR_TEST)

    train_df = pd.concat(
        [train_df, pd.DataFrame(train_stats, columns=STAT_COLS)], axis=1
    )
    test_df = pd.concat([test_df, pd.DataFrame(test_stats, columns=STAT_COLS)], axis=1)

    lgb_oof, lgb_test = run_lightgbm_meta(
        train_df, test_df, train_stats, test_stats, folds
    )
    y = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)
    lgb_rmse = rmse_score(y, lgb_oof)
    print(f"LightGBM (metadata + image stats) OOF RMSE: {lgb_rmse:.4f}", flush=True)

    sub = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Id": test_df["Id"].values,
            "Pawpularity": lgb_test,
        }
    )
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved fallback LightGBM submission.csv", flush=True)

    BACKBONE_NAME = choose_backbone()
    if BACKBONE_NAME is None:
        print(
            "No pretrained backbone available; keeping LightGBM submission.", flush=True
        )
        return

    if DEVICE.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    print("Starting cross-modal fine-tuning...", flush=True)
    deep_oof, deep_test = run_deep_cv(train_df, test_df, folds, DEVICE)

    if deep_oof is None or not np.isfinite(deep_oof).all():
        print("Deep training failed; keeping LightGBM submission.", flush=True)
        return

    deep_rmse = rmse_score(y, deep_oof)
    print(f"Cross-modal OOF RMSE: {deep_rmse:.4f}", flush=True)

    best_w, blend_rmse = find_best_weight(deep_oof, lgb_oof, y)
    print(f"Best deep blend weight: {best_w:.3f}", flush=True)
    print(f"Final blend OOF RMSE: {blend_rmse:.4f}", flush=True)

    final_test = np.clip(best_w * deep_test + (1 - best_w) * lgb_test, 0, 100)
    sub["Pawpularity"] = final_test
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved final submission.csv", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import random
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image, ImageOps

import torch
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge, RidgeCV

import lightgbm as lgb
import timm

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

SEED = 42
IMG_SIZE = 224
EMB_BATCH = 48
PCA_DIM = 128
N_FOLDS = 5
NUM_BOOST_ROUND = 1800
EARLY_STOPPING = 100

TARGET = "Pawpularity"
META_COLS = [
    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",
    "Face",
    "Near",
    "Action",
    "Accessory",
    "Group",
    "Collage",
    "Human",
    "Occlusion",
    "Info",
    "Blur",
]

IMAGE_DIR_TRAIN = "data/train"
IMAGE_DIR_TEST = "data/test"

IMAGENET_MEAN = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]
IMAGENET_STD = [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]

MODEL_CANDIDATES = [
    ("efficientnet_b0", 224),
    ("efficientnet_b3", 224),
    ("vit_base_patch16_224", 224),
    ("swin_base_patch4_window7_224", 224),
    ("convnext_base", 224),
    ("vit_large_patch14_clip_224", 224),
    ("vit_base_patch14_dinov2", 224),
]

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

meta_params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "learning_rate": 0.03,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 1,
    "lambda_l2": 1.0,
    "verbosity": -1,
    "seed": SEED,
}

emb_params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "learning_rate": 0.02,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 30,
    "feature_fraction": 0.3,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 1,
    "lambda_l2": 1.0,
    "verbosity": -1,
    "seed": SEED,
}

all_params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "learning_rate": 0.02,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 40,
    "feature_fraction": 0.25,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 1,
    "lambda_l2": 1.0,
    "verbosity": -1,
    "seed": SEED,
}


def set_seed(seed=SEED):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True


def rmse_score(y_true, y_pred):
    return float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)))


def build_tabular(df):
    X = df[META_COLS].values.astype(np.float32)
    n = X.shape[1]
    interactions = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            interactions.append((X[:, [i]] * X[:, [j]]).astype(np.float32))
    count = X.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True).astype(np.float32)
    if interactions:
        X = np.hstack([X] + interactions + [count])
    else:
        X = np.hstack([X, count])
    return X.astype(np.float32)


def compute_image_stats(df, image_dir):
    ids = df["Id"].values
    n = len(ids)
    stats = np.zeros((n, 8), dtype=np.float32)

    for i, img_id in enumerate(ids):
        path = os.path.join(image_dir, img_id + ".jpg")
        try:
            with Image.open(path) as img:
                img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img).convert("RGB")
                w, h = img.size
                small = img.resize((48, 48), Image.BILINEAR)
                arr = np.asarray(small, dtype=np.float32) / 255.0
        except Exception:
            stats[i] = 0.5
            stats[i, 7] = 1.0
            continue

        r = arr[..., 0]
        g = arr[..., 1]
        b = arr[..., 2]
        gray = 0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b

        rg = r - g
        yb = 0.5 * (r + g) - b
        colorfulness = np.sqrt(rg.std() ** 2 + yb.std() ** 2) + 0.3 * np.sqrt(
            rg.mean() ** 2 + yb.mean() ** 2
        )
        gy, gx = np.gradient(gray)
        edge = np.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy).mean()

        stats[i, 0] = gray.mean()
        stats[i, 1] = gray.std()
        stats[i, 2] = colorfulness
        stats[i, 3] = edge
        stats[i, 4] = arr.std()
        stats[i, 5] = arr.mean()
        stats[i, 6] = gray.max() - gray.min()
        stats[i, 7] = float(w) / max(h, 1)

    return stats


def try_load_model(name, size):
    del size
    aliases = [name]
    if name == "vit_large_patch14_clip_224":
        aliases.append("vit_large_patch14_clip_224.openai")
    if name == "vit_base_patch14_dinov2":
        aliases.append("vit_base_patch14_dinov2.lvd142m")

    for alias in aliases:
        try:
            model = timm.create_model(alias, pretrained=True, num_classes=0)
            model.to(device)
            model.eval()
            print(f"Loaded {alias}", flush=True)
            return model
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None


def _input_size_to_int(input_size):
    if input_size is None:
        return None
    if hasattr(input_size, "__len__"):
        if len(input_size) >= 3:
            return int(input_size[1])
        if len(input_size) >= 1:
            return int(input_size[0])
        return None
    try:
        return int(input_size)
    except Exception:
        return None


def get_model_input_size(model, fallback_size):
    for attr in ("default_cfg", "pretrained_cfg"):
        cfg = getattr(model, attr, None)
        if cfg is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(cfg, dict):
            val = _input_size_to_int(cfg.get("input_size"))
            if val is not None:
                return val
        else:
            val = _input_size_to_int(getattr(cfg, "input_size", None))
            if val is not None:
                return val

    patch_embed = getattr(model, "patch_embed", None)
    if patch_embed is not None:
        val = _input_size_to_int(getattr(patch_embed, "img_size", None))
        if val is not None:
            return val

    return fallback_size


class MultiViewDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, paths, transform0, transform1):
        self.paths = paths
        self.transform0 = transform0
        self.transform1 = transform1

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.paths)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        with Image.open(self.paths[idx]) as img:
            img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(img).convert("RGB")
        return torch.stack([self.transform0(img), self.transform1(img)], dim=0)


def model_features(model, x):
    out = model(x)
    if isinstance(out, (tuple, list)):
        out = out[0]
    if out.dim() == 4:
        out = out.mean(dim=[2, 3])
    elif out.dim() == 3:
        out = out.mean(dim=1)
    return out


def extract_embeddings(model, paths, size, batch_size=EMB_BATCH):
    transform0 = transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize((size, size)),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(IMAGENET_MEAN, IMAGENET_STD),
        ]
    )
    transform1 = transforms.Compose(
        [
            transforms.Resize(int(size * 1.25)),
            transforms.CenterCrop(size),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
            transforms.Normalize(IMAGENET_MEAN, IMAGENET_STD),
        ]
    )

    dataset = MultiViewDataset(paths, transform0, transform1)
    loader = DataLoader(
        dataset,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=False,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
    )

    all_feats = []
    for batch in loader:
        B = batch.shape[0]
        V = batch.shape[1]
        batch = batch.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        views = batch.view(B * V, batch.shape[2], batch.shape[3], batch.shape[4])

        with torch.no_grad():
            if device.type == "cuda":
                with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.float16):
                    f = model_features(model, views)
                    ff = model_features(model, torch.flip(views, dims=[3]))
            else:
                f = model_features(model, views)
                ff = model_features(model, torch.flip(views, dims=[3]))

        f = f.view(B, V, -1).float()
        ff = ff.view(B, V, -1).float()
        feat = (f + ff) * 0.5
        feat = feat.reshape(B, -1)
        all_feats.append(feat.detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float16))

    return np.concatenate(all_feats, axis=0)


def train_lgb(X_tr, X_va, X_te, y_tr, y_va, params):
    dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
    dva = lgb.Dataset(X_va, label=y_va, reference=dtr)
    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        dtr,
        num_boost_round=NUM_BOOST_ROUND,
        valid_sets=[dva],
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=EARLY_STOPPING),
            lgb.log_evaluation(0),
        ],
    )
    oof = model.predict(X_va, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    te = model.predict(X_te, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
    return oof, te


def build_groups(embeddings, train_tab, test_tab, tr_idx, va_idx):
    n_train = len(train_tab)

    X_tab_tr = train_tab[tr_idx].astype(np.float32)
    X_tab_va = train_tab[va_idx].astype(np.float32)
    X_tab_te = test_tab.astype(np.float32)

    groups = {"tab": {"tr": X_tab_tr, "va": X_tab_va, "te": X_tab_te}}
    pca_dict = {}

    for name, emb in embeddings.items():
        train_part = emb[:n_train].astype(np.float32)
        test_part = emb[n_train:].astype(np.float32)

        n_comp = min(PCA_DIM, train_part.shape[1], len(tr_idx) - 1)
        pca = PCA(n_components=n_comp, random_state=SEED)

        E_tr = pca.fit_transform(train_part[tr_idx])
        E_va = pca.transform(train_part[va_idx])
        E_te = pca.transform(test_part)

        pca_dict[name] = (E_tr, E_va, E_te)
        groups[name] = {
            "tr": np.hstack([E_tr, X_tab_tr]),
            "va": np.hstack([E_va, X_tab_va]),
            "te": np.hstack([E_te, X_tab_te]),
        }

    if pca_dict:
        groups["all"] = {
            "tr": np.hstack([pca_dict[name][0] for name in embeddings] + [X_tab_tr]),
            "va": np.hstack([pca_dict[name][1] for name in embeddings] + [X_tab_va]),
            "te": np.hstack([pca_dict[name][2] for name in embeddings] + [X_tab_te]),
        }

    return groups


def stack_and_evaluate(oof_matrix, test_matrix, y):
    n_models = oof_matrix.shape[1]

    avg_oof = oof_matrix.mean(axis=1)
    avg_test = test_matrix.mean(axis=1)
    avg_rmse = rmse_score(y, avg_oof)

    try:
        from scipy.optimize import nnls

        coef, _ = nnls(oof_matrix, y)
        if coef.sum() <= 0 or not np.isfinite(coef).all():
            coef = np.ones(n_models) / n_models
        else:
            coef = coef / coef.sum()

        nn_oof = oof_matrix @ coef
        nn_test = test_matrix @ coef
        nn_rmse = rmse_score(y, nn_oof)
    except Exception:
        coef = np.ones(n_models) / n_models
        nn_oof = avg_oof
        nn_test = avg_test
        nn_rmse = avg_rmse

    try:
        ridge = RidgeCV(alphas=[0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0], cv=3)
        ridge.fit(oof_matrix, y)
        rg_oof = ridge.predict(oof_matrix)
        rg_test = ridge.predict(test_matrix)
        rg_rmse = rmse_score(y, rg_oof)
    except Exception:
        rg_rmse = np.inf

    print(
        f"Blend candidates: avg={avg_rmse:.4f} nnls={nn_rmse:.4f} ridge={rg_rmse:.4f}",
        flush=True,
    )

    if rg_rmse < nn_rmse:
        return rg_test, rg_rmse, "RidgeCV"
    return nn_test, nn_rmse, "NNLS"


def main():
    set_seed(SEED)

    train_df = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

    n_train = len(train_df)
    n_test = len(test_df)
    y = train_df[TARGET].values.astype(np.float32)

    print("Computing metadata features and image statistics...", flush=True)
    train_tab = np.hstack(
        [build_tabular(train_df), compute_image_stats(train_df, IMAGE_DIR_TRAIN)]
    )
    test_tab = np.hstack(
        [build_tabular(test_df), compute_image_stats(test_df, IMAGE_DIR_TEST)]
    )

    folds = list(
        KFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED).split(train_df)
    )

    train_ids = train_df["Id"].astype(str).values
    test_ids = test_df["Id"].astype(str).values
    all_paths = [
        os.path.join(IMAGE_DIR_TRAIN, img_id + ".jpg") for img_id in train_ids
    ] + [os.path.join(IMAGE_DIR_TEST, img_id + ".jpg") for img_id in test_ids]

    embeddings = {}
    for name, fallback_size in MODEL_CANDIDATES:
        model = try_load_model(name, fallback_size)
        if model is None:
            print(f"Could not load {name}; skipping", flush=True)
            continue

        size = get_model_input_size(model, fallback_size)
        print(f"Using {name} at input size {size}", flush=True)

        print(f"Extracting embeddings with {name} ...", flush=True)
        emb = extract_embeddings(model, all_paths, size)
        embeddings[name] = emb
        print(f"{name} embedding shape: {emb.shape}", flush=True)

        del model
        if device.type == "cuda":
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    specs = [("lgb_tab", "tab", "lgb", meta_params)]
    if embeddings:
        for name in embeddings:
            specs.append((f"lgb_{name}", name, "lgb", emb_params))
        specs.append(("lgb_all", "all", "lgb", all_params))
        specs.append(("ridge_all", "all", "ridge", None))

    oof_matrix = np.zeros((n_train, len(specs)), dtype=np.float64)
    test_matrix = np.zeros((n_test, len(specs)), dtype=np.float64)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(folds):
        print(f"--- Fold {fold + 1}/{N_FOLDS} ---", flush=True)
        groups = build_groups(embeddings, train_tab, test_tab, tr_idx, va_idx)

        for si, spec in enumerate(specs):
            name, group, kind, params = spec
            X_tr = groups[group]["tr"].astype(np.float32)
            X_va = groups[group]["va"].astype(np.float32)
            X_te = groups[group]["te"].astype(np.float32)

            if kind == "lgb":
                oof, te = train_lgb(X_tr, X_va, X_te, y[tr_idx], y[va_idx], params)
            else:
                ridge = Ridge(alpha=10.0)
                ridge.fit(X_tr, y[tr_idx])
                oof = ridge.predict(X_va)
                te = ridge.predict(X_te)

            oof_matrix[va_idx, si] = oof
            test_matrix[:, si] += te / N_FOLDS

import os
import gc
import time
import math
import itertools
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image

from scipy.stats import rankdata, norm
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
import scipy.sparse as sp

import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import torchvision.transforms as transforms

import timm
import lightgbm as lgb
import xgboost as xgb

from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import RidgeCV, Ridge
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsRegressor, NearestNeighbors
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

SEED = 42
N_FOLDS = 5
PCA_DIM = 180
GRAPH_K = 15
GRAPH_ITERS = 20

DATA_DIR = Path("./data")
TRAIN_IMG_DIR = DATA_DIR / "train"
TEST_IMG_DIR = DATA_DIR / "test"

META_COLS = [
    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",
    "Face",
    "Near",
    "Action",
    "Accessory",
    "Group",
    "Collage",
    "Human",
    "Occlusion",
    "Info",
    "Blur",
]

MODEL_SPECS = [
    ("vit_base_patch14_dinov2.lvd142m", 16),
    ("convnext_base.fb_in22k_ft_in1k", 32),
    ("swin_base_patch4_window7_224", 32),
    ("efficientnet_b3", 64),
]


def set_seed(seed=SEED):
    os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def rmse(y_true, y_pred):
    return float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)))


def save_submission(test_df, pred):
    pred = np.clip(np.asarray(pred, dtype=np.float32), 0.0, 100.0)
    sub = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"].values, "Pawpularity": pred})
    sample_path = DATA_DIR / "sample_submission.csv"
    if sample_path.exists():
        sample = pd.read_csv(sample_path, usecols=["Id"])
        sub = sample.merge(sub, on="Id", how="left")
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)


class ImagePathDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, paths, transform):
        self.paths = [str(p) for p in paths]
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.paths)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        try:
            img = Image.open(self.paths[idx]).convert("RGB")
        except Exception:
            img = Image.new("RGB", (224, 224), (128, 128, 128))
        if self.transform is not None:
            img = self.transform(img)
        return img


def build_metadata_features(df):
    meta = df[META_COLS].copy().astype(np.float32)
    for c1, c2 in itertools.combinations(META_COLS, 2):
        meta[f"{c1}_{c2}"] = meta[c1] * meta[c2]
    meta["meta_count"] = meta[META_COLS].sum(axis=1)
    return meta.values.astype(np.float32)


def compute_image_stats(paths):
    stats = np.zeros((len(paths), 7), dtype=np.float32)
    for i, p in enumerate(paths):
        try:
            img = Image.open(p).convert("RGB")
            img = img.resize((64, 64))
            gray = np.asarray(img.convert("L"), dtype=np.float32)
            hsv = np.asarray(img.convert("HSV"), dtype=np.float32)

            dx = float(np.abs(np.diff(gray, axis=1)).mean())
            dy = float(np.abs(np.diff(gray, axis=0)).mean())

            hist = np.histogram(gray, bins=16, range=(0, 255), density=True)[0]
            hist = hist[hist > 0]
            ent = float(-(hist * np.log(hist)).sum()) if len(hist) else 0.0

            stats[i] = [
                float(gray.mean()),
                float(gray.std()),
                dx,
                dy,
                float(hsv[:, :, 1].mean()),
                float(hsv[:, :, 2].mean()),
                ent,
            ]
        except Exception:
            continue
    return stats


def extract_embeddings(paths, device):
    all_embs = []
    used_models = []

    for model_name, batch_size in MODEL_SPECS:
        try:
            model = timm.create_model(model_name, pretrained=True, num_classes=0)
            model.eval().to(device)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Skipping {model_name}: {e}")
            continue

        cfg = model.default_cfg
        try:
            transform = timm.data.create_transform(
                input_size=tuple(cfg["input_size"]),
                is_training=False,
                mean=cfg["mean"],
                std=cfg["std"],
                interpolation=cfg["interpolation"],
            )
        except Exception:
            input_size = tuple(cfg.get("input_size", (3, 224, 224)))
            h, w = input_size[1], input_size[2]
            transform = transforms.Compose(
                [
                    transforms.Resize(
                        (h, w), interpolation=transforms.InterpolationMode.BILINEAR
                    ),
                    transforms.ToTensor(),
                    transforms.Normalize(
                        mean=cfg.get("mean", (0.485, 0.456, 0.406)),
                        std=cfg.get("std", (0.229, 0.224, 0.225)),
                    ),
                ]
            )

        dataset = ImagePathDataset(paths, transform)
        loader = DataLoader(
            dataset,
            batch_size=batch_size,
            shuffle=False,
            num_workers=4,
            pin_memory=(device.type == "cuda"),
        )

        embs = []
        use_amp = device.type == "cuda"
        with torch.inference_mode():
            for batch in loader:
                batch = batch.to(device, non_blocking=True)
                if use_amp:
                    with torch.autocast(device_type="cuda", dtype=torch.float16):
                        feat = model(batch)
                else:
                    feat = model(batch)

                if isinstance(feat, (tuple, list)):
                    feat = feat[0]
                if feat.dim() == 4:
                    feat = feat.mean(dim=(2, 3))
                elif feat.dim() == 3:
                    feat = feat.mean(dim=1)

                feat = torch.nn.functional.normalize(feat, p=2, dim=1)
                embs.append(feat.float().cpu().numpy())

        emb = np.vstack(embs).astype(np.float32)
        all_embs.append(emb)
        used_models.append(model_name)
        print(f"Extracted {model_name}: {emb.shape}")

        del model, loader, dataset
        gc.collect()
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    if not all_embs:
        return None, []

    return np.hstack(all_embs).astype(np.float32), used_models


class RankGauss:
    def __init__(self, y):
        y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
        self.sorted_y = np.sort(y)
        n = len(y)
        ranks = (rankdata(y) - 0.5) / n
        self.z = norm.ppf(ranks)

    def transform_eval(self, y):
        y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
        p = np.interp(y, self.sorted_y, np.linspace(0, 1, len(self.sorted_y)))
        p = np.clip(p, 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6)
        return norm.ppf(p)

    def inverse(self, z):
        p = norm.cdf(np.asarray(z, dtype=np.float64))
        p = np.clip(p, 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6)
        return np.interp(p, np.linspace(0, 1, len(self.sorted_y)), self.sorted_y)


def make_lgb_params(objective="regression"):
    params = {
        "objective": objective,
        "metric": "rmse",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": SEED,
        "n_jobs": -1,
        "n_estimators": 800,
    }
    if objective == "huber":
        params["alpha"] = 1.0
    return params


def train_lgb_fold(Xtr, ytr, Xval, yval, Xtest, objective="regression"):
    params = make_lgb_params(objective)
    model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**params)
    model.fit(
        Xtr,
        ytr,
        eval_set=[(Xval, yval)],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(100), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
    )
    val_pred = model.predict(Xval, num_iteration=model.best_iteration_)
    test_pred = model.predict(Xtest, num_iteration=model.best_iteration_)
    return val_pred, test_pred


def train_lgb_rank_fold(Xtr, ytr, Xval, yval, Xtest):
    rg = RankGauss(ytr)
    params = make_lgb_params("regression")
    model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(**params)
    zval = rg.transform_eval(yval)
    model.fit(
        Xtr,
        rg.z,
        eval_set=[(Xval, zval)],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(100), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
    )
    val_pred = rg.inverse(model.predict(Xval, num_iteration=model.best_iteration_))
    test_pred = rg.inverse(model.predict(Xtest, num_iteration=model.best_iteration_))
    return val_pred, test_pred


def train_xgb_fold(Xtr, ytr, Xval, yval, Xtest):
    model = xgb.XGBRegressor(
        n_estimators=800,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_depth=5,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_lambda=1.0,
        tree_method="hist",
        random_state=SEED,
        verbosity=0,
        early_stopping_rounds=100,
        eval_metric="rmse",
    )
    model.fit(Xtr, ytr, eval_set=[(Xval, yval)], verbose=False)
    best_iter = getattr(model, "best_iteration", None)
    if best_iter is None:
        best_iter = model.n_estimators
    val_pred = model.predict(Xval, iteration_range=(0, best_iter + 1))
    test_pred = model.predict(Xtest, iteration_range=(0, best_iter + 1))
    return val_pred, test_pred


def train_ridge_fold(Xtr, ytr, Xval, Xtest):
    pipe = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=1.0))
    pipe.fit(Xtr, ytr)
    return pipe.predict(Xval), pipe.predict(Xtest)


def train_knn_fold(Xtr, ytr, Xval, Xtest):
    model = KNeighborsRegressor(
        n_neighbors=15, weights="distance", metric="cosine", n_jobs=-1
    )
    model.fit(Xtr, ytr)
    return model.predict(Xval), model.predict(Xtest)


def build_graph(P):
    return P


def run_label_propagation(P, y, fold_splits, n_test):
    n_train = len(y)
    n_total = P.shape[0]
    oof = np.zeros(n_train, dtype=np.float64)
    test_pred = np.zeros(n_test, dtype=np.float64)

    for trn_idx, val_idx in fold_splits:
        f = np.zeros(n_total, dtype=np.float64)
        f[trn_idx] = y[trn_idx]
        unlabeled = np.ones(n_total, dtype=bool)
        unlabeled[trn_idx] = False
        f[unlabeled] = np.mean(y[trn_idx])

        for _ in range(GRAPH_ITERS):
            f = P @ f
            f[trn_idx] = y[trn_idx]

        oof[val_idx] = f[val_idx]
        test_pred += f[n_train:] / len(fold_splits)

    return oof, test_pred


def build_graph_affinity(Z, k=GRAPH_K):
    Z = Z.astype(np.float32)
    nn = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=k + 1, metric="cosine", n_jobs=-1)
    nn.fit(Z)
    dist, ind = nn.kneighbors(Z)

    dist = dist[:, 1:]
    ind = ind[:, 1:]

    bandwidth = float(np.median(dist))
    if bandwidth < 1e-6:
        bandwidth = 1.0

    vals = np.exp(-dist / bandwidth).ravel()
    rows = np.repeat(np.arange(len(Z)), k)
    cols = ind.ravel()
    W = csr_matrix((vals, (rows, cols)), shape=(len(Z), len(Z)))

    deg = np.asarray(W.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    deg[deg < 1e-8] = 1.0
    P = sp.diags(1.0 / deg) @ W
    return P


def run_metadata_lgb(train_df, test_df, meta_train, meta_test, stats_train, stats_test):
    print(
        "No pretrained image embeddings available. Using metadata+stats LightGBM fallback."
    )

    X = np.hstack([meta_train, stats_train]).astype(np.float32)
    X_test = np.hstack([meta_test, stats_test]).astype(np.float32)
    y = train_df["Pawpularity"].to_numpy(np.float32)

    params = {
        "objective": "regression",
        "metric": "rmse",
        "learning_rate": 0.03,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": SEED,
    }

    kf = KFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    oof = np.zeros(len(train_df), dtype=np.float64)
    test_pred = np.zeros(len(test_df), dtype=np.float64)

    for trn_idx, val_idx in kf.split(X):
        dtrn = lgb.Dataset(X[trn_idx], y[trn_idx])
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X[val_idx], y[val_idx])
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtrn,
            num_boost_round=1000,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(100), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof[val_idx] = model.predict(X[val_idx], num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
        test_pred += model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration) / N_FOLDS

    print(f"Fallback 5-Fold CV RMSE: {rmse(y, oof):.5f}")
    save_submission(test_df, test_pred)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    set_seed()

    train_df = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "test.csv")

    global META_COLS
    META_COLS = [c for c in META_COLS if c in train_df.columns]

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Device: {device}")

    meta_train = build_metadata_features(train_df)
    meta_test = build_metadata_features(test_df)

    train_paths = [TRAIN_IMG_DIR / f"{i}.jpg" for i in train_df["Id"]]
    test_paths = [TEST_IMG_DIR / f"{i}.jpg" for i in test_df["Id"]]
    all_paths = train_paths + test_paths

    print("Computing image statistics...")
    stats_all = compute_image_stats(all_paths)
    stats_train = stats_all[: len(train_df)]
    stats_test = stats_all[len(train_df) :]

    print("Extracting pretrained image embeddings...")
    E_all, used_models = extract_embeddings(all_paths, device)
    if E_all is None:
        run_metadata_lgb(
            train_df, test_df, meta_train, meta_test, stats_train, stats_test
        )
        return

    E_train = E_all[: len(train_df)]
    E_test = E_all[len(train_df) :]
    y = train_df["Pawpularity"].to_numpy(np.float32)
    n_train = len(train_df)
    n_test = len(test_df)

    print("Building transductive graph affinity...")
    pca_graph = PCA(
        n_components=min(128, E_all.shape[1], len(E_all) - 1),
        random_state=SEED,
    ).fit(E_all)
    Z_graph = pca_graph.transform(E_all)
    Z_graph = Z_graph / (np.linalg.norm(Z_graph, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-8)
    P = build_graph_affinity(Z_graph, k=GRAPH_K)

    kf = KFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    fold_splits = list(kf.split(np.arange(n_train)))

    print("Running graph label propagation...")
    graph_oof, graph_test = run_label_propagation(P, y, fold_splits, n_test)
    print(f"Graph OOF RMSE: {rmse(y, graph_oof):.4f}")

    base_keys = [
        "lgb_all_l2",
        "lgb_all_huber",
        "lgb_rank",
        "lgb_embed_l2",
        "lgb_meta_l2",
        "xgb_all",
        "ridge_all",
        "knn_all",
    ]

    oofs = {k: np.zeros(n_train, dtype=np.float64) for k in base_keys}
    test_preds = {k: np.zeros(n_test, dtype=np.float64) for k in base_keys}

    for fold, (trn_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(fold_splits):
        print(f"--- Fold {fold + 1}/{N_FOLDS} ---")

        pca = PCA(
            n_components=min(PCA_DIM, len(trn_idx) - 1),
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        train_pca = pca.fit_transform(E_train[trn_idx])
        val_pca = pca.transform(E_train[val_idx])
        test_pca = pca.transform(E_test)

        train_meta_stats = np.hstack([meta_train[trn_idx], stats_train[trn_idx]])
        val_meta_stats = np.hstack([meta_train[val_idx], stats_train[val_idx]])
        test_meta_stats = np.hstack([meta_test, stats_test])

        X_all_tr = np.hstack([train_pca, train_meta_stats])
        X_all_val = np.hstack([val_pca, val_meta_stats])
        X_all_test = np.hstack([test_pca, test_meta_stats])

        X_embed_tr = train_pca
        X_embed_val = val_pca
        X_embed_test = test_pca

        X_meta_tr = train_meta_stats
        X_meta_val = val_meta_stats
        X_meta_test = test_meta_stats

        y_tr = y[trn_idx]
        y_val = y[val_idx]

        # LGB L2 on all features
        val_pred, test_pred = train_lgb_fold(
            X_all_tr, y_tr, X_all_val, y_val, X_all_test, "regression"
        )
        oofs["lgb_all_l2"][val_idx] = val_pred
        test_preds["lgb_all_l2"] += test_pred / N_FOLDS

        # LGB Huber on all features
        val_pred, test_pred = train_lgb_fold(
            X_all_tr, y_tr, X_all_val, y_val, X_all_test, "huber"
        )
        oofs["lgb_all_huber"][val_idx] = val_pred
        test_preds["lgb_all_huber"] += test_pred / N_FOLDS

        # LGB on rank-Gauss target
        val_pred, test_pred = train_lgb_rank_fold(
            X_all_tr, y_tr, X_all_val, y_val, X_all_test
        )
        oofs["lgb_rank"][val_idx] = val_pred
        test_preds["lgb_rank"] += test_pred / N_FOLDS

        # LGB on embeddings only
        val_pred, test_pred = train_lgb_fold(
            X_embed_tr, y_tr, X_embed_val, y_val, X_embed_test, "regression"
        )
        oofs["lgb_embed_l2"][val_idx] = val_pred
        test_preds["lgb_embed_l2"] += test_pred / N_FOLDS

        # LGB on metadata + stats only
        val_pred, test_pred = train_lgb_fold(
            X_meta_tr, y_tr, X_meta_val, y_val, X_meta_test, "regression"
        )
        oofs["lgb_meta_l2"][val_idx] = val_pred
        test_preds["lgb_meta_l2"] += test_pred / N_FOLDS

        # XGBoost on all features
        val_pred, test_pred = train_xgb_fold(
            X_all_tr, y_tr, X_all_val, y_val, X_all_test
        )
        oofs["xgb_all"][val_idx] = val_pred
        test_preds["xgb_all"] += test_pred / N_FOLDS

        # Ridge on all features
        val_pred, test_pred = train_ridge_fold(X_all_tr, y_tr, X_all_val, X_all_test)
        oofs["ridge_all"][val_idx] = val_pred
        test_preds["ridge_all"] += test_pred / N_FOLDS

        # KNN on all features
        val_pred, test_pred = train_knn_fold(X_all_tr, y_tr, X_all_val, X_all_test)
        oofs["knn_all"][val_idx] = val_pred
        test_preds["knn_all"] += test_pred / N_FOLDS

    for k in base_keys:
        print(f"{k} OOF RMSE: {rmse(y, oofs[k]):.4f}")

    print("Fitting final RidgeCV stacker...")
    stack_X = np.column_stack([oofs[k] for k in base_keys] + [graph_oof])
    stack_test_X = np.column_stack([test_preds[k] for k in base_keys] + [graph_test])

    stacker = RidgeCV(alphas=[0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0], cv=5)
    stacker.fit(stack_X, y)
    stack_oof_pred = stacker.predict(stack_X)
    final_cv = rmse(y, stack_oof_pred)
    print(f"5-Fold CV RMSE (stacked OOF): {final_cv:.5f}")

    test_pred = stacker.predict(stack_test_X)
    save_submission(test_df, test_pred)

    print(f"Total time: {(time.time() - t0) / 60:.1f} min")
