from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB, MultinomialNB
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

SEED = 42
N_SPLITS = 5
SVD_COMPONENTS = 160
LM_FEATURES = 12  # word(3 raw + 3 diffs) + char(3 raw + 3 diffs)


def punctuation_analyzer(text):
    return re.findall(r"[!?.,;:()\[\]\"'—-]+", text)


def build_style_features(texts):
    s = pd.Series(texts).fillna("")
    lower = s.str.lower()
    words = lower.str.split()

    df = pd.DataFrame(index=np.arange(len(texts)))
    df["num_chars"] = s.str.len().astype(np.float64)
    df["num_words"] = words.str.len().astype(np.float64)
    df["unique_words"] = words.apply(lambda ws: len(set(ws))).astype(np.float64)
    df["unique_ratio"] = df["unique_words"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)
    df["avg_word_len"] = df["num_chars"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["sentences"] = s.str.count(r"[.!?]+").astype(np.float64)
    df["words_per_sentence"] = df["num_words"] / (df["sentences"] + 1e-5)

    df["exclams"] = s.str.count("!").astype(np.float64)
    df["questions"] = s.str.count(r"\?").astype(np.float64)
    df["periods"] = s.str.count(r"\.").astype(np.float64)
    df["commas"] = s.str.count(",").astype(np.float64)
    df["semicolons"] = s.str.count(";").astype(np.float64)
    df["colons"] = s.str.count(":").astype(np.float64)
    df["dbl_quotes"] = s.str.count('"').astype(np.float64)
    df["single_quotes"] = s.str.count("'").astype(np.float64)
    df["dashes"] = s.str.count(r"[-–—]").astype(np.float64)
    df["ellipses"] = s.str.count(r"\.\.\.").astype(np.float64)
    df["punct_count"] = (
        df["periods"]
        + df["commas"]
        + df["semicolons"]
        + df["colons"]
        + df["exclams"]
        + df["questions"]
        + df["dbl_quotes"]
        + df["single_quotes"]
        + df["dashes"]
    )

    def _stop_count(text):
        toks = text.lower().split()
        return sum(1 for w in toks if w.strip(".,;:!?\"()[]-'") in ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    df["stop_count"] = s.apply(_stop_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["stop_ratio"] = df["stop_count"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["first_person"] = lower.str.count(r"\b(i|me|my|mine|we|our|ours|us)\b").astype(

    ).astype(np.float64)

    df["contractions"] = lower.str.count(r"\b\w+n't\b|\b\w+'(s|re|ve|d|ll|m)\b").astype(
        np.float64
    )

    def _cap_count(text):
        return sum(1 for w in text.split() if len(w) > 1 and w[0].isupper())

    df["caps"] = s.apply(_cap_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["cap_ratio"] = df["caps"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)
    df["digits"] = s.str.count(r"\d").astype(np.float64)

    def _long_count(text):
        return sum(1 for w in text.split() if len(w) >= 7)

    df["long_words"] = s.apply(_long_count).astype(np.float64)

    return p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

def build_style_features(texts):
    s = pd.Series(texts).fillna("")
    lower = s.str.lower()
    words = lower.str.split()

    df = pd.DataFrame(index=np.arange(len(texts)))

    df["num_chars"] = s.str.len().astype(np.float64)
    df["num_words"] = words.str.len().astype(np.float64)
    df["unique_words"] = words.apply(lambda ws: len(set(ws))).astype(np.float64)
    df["unique_ratio"] = df["unique_words"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)
    df["avg_word_len"] = df["num_chars"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["sentences"] = s.str.count(r"[.!?]+").astype(np.float64)
    df["words_per_sentence"] = df["num_words"] / (df["sentences"] + 1e-5)

    df["exclams"] = s.str.count("!").astype(np.float64)
    df["questions"] = s.str.count(r"\?").astype(np.float64)
    df["periods"] = s.str.count(r"\.").astype(np.float64)
    df["commas"] = s.str.count(",").astype(np.float64)
    df["semicolons"] = s.str.count(";").astype(np.float64)
    df["colons"] = s.str.count(":").astype(np.float64)
    df["dbl_quotes"] = s.str.count('"').astype(np.float64)
    df["single_quotes"] = s.str.count("'").astype(np.float64)
    df["dashes"] = s.str.count(r"[-–—]").astype(np.float64)
    df["ellipses"] = s.str.count(r"\.\.\.").astype(np.float64)
    df["punct_count"] = (
        df["periods"]
        + df["commas"]
        + df["semicolons"]
        + df["colons"]
        + df["exclams"]
        + df["questions"]
        + df["dbl_quotes"]
        + df["single_quotes"]
        + df["dashes"]
    )

    def _stop_count(text):
        toks = text.lower().split()
        return sum(1 for w in toks if w.strip(".,;:!?\"()[]-'") in ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    df["stop_count"] = s.apply(_stop_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["stop_ratio"] = df["stop_count"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["first_person"] = lower.str.count(r"\b(i|me|my|mine|we|our|ours|us)\b").astype(
        np.float64
    )
    df["second_person"] = lower.str.count(
        r"\b(you|your|yours|thou|thee|thy|thine)\b"

    df["third_person"] = lower.str.count(
        r"\b(he|him|his|she|her|hers|they|them|their|theirs|it|its)\b"
    ).astype(np.float64)

    df["contractions"] = lower.str.count(r"\b\w+n't\b|\b\w+'(s|re|ve|d|ll|m)\b").astype(
        np.float64
    )

    def _cap_count(text):
        return sum(1 for w in text.split() if len(w) > 1 and w[0].isupper())

    df["caps"] = s.apply(_cap_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["cap_ratio"] = df["caps"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["digits"] = s.str.count(r"\d").astype(np.float64)

    def _long_count(text):
        return sum(1 for w in text.split() if len(w) >= 7)

    df["long_words"] = s.apply(_long_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["long_word_ratio"] = df["long_words"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

        "which",
        "whom",
        "whose",

        "shall",
        "never",

    ]
    for marker in markers:
        df[f"m_{marker}"] = lower.str.count(r"\b" + marker + r"\b").astype(np.float64)

    return df


def compute_bm25(X, k1=1.6, b=0.75):
    X = X.tocsr().astype(np.float64)
    N = X.shape[0]
    df = np.asarray((X > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    idf = np.log((N - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5) + 1.0)
    row_sums = np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    avgdl = row_sums.mean()

    row_indices = np.repeat(np.arange(N), np.diff(X.indptr))
    denom = X.data + k1 * (1.0 - b + b * row_sums[row_indices] / (avgdl + 1e-6))
    bm25_data = X.data * (k1 + 1.0) / denom * idf[X.indices]
    return csr_matrix((bm25_data, X.indices, X.indptr), shape=X.shape)


def compute_nb_ratios(X_counts, y, alpha=1.0, clip=5.0):
    V = X_counts.shape[1]
    ratios = []
    for cls in range(3):
        pos = np.asarray(X_counts[y == cls].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
        neg = np.asarray(X_counts[y != cls].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
        total_pos = pos.sum()
        total_neg = neg.sum()

        p_pos = (pos + alpha) / (total_pos + alpha * V)
        p_neg = (neg + alpha) / (total_neg + alpha * V)
        ratio = np.log(p_pos / p_neg)
        ratio = np.clip(ratio, -clip, clip)
        ratios.append(ratio)
    return ratios


def make_nb_aug(X_counts, ratios):
    parts = []
    for ratio in ratios:
        parts.append(X_counts @ diags(ratio))
    return hstack(parts).tocsr()


def build_meta_features(prob_dict, names):
    parts = []
    for name in names:
        p = np.clip(prob_dict[name], 1e-9, 1.0 - 1e-9)
        parts.append(p)
        parts.append(np.log(p / (1.0 - p)))
    return np.hstack(parts)


def temperature_scale(p, T):
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)
    logits = np.log(p)
    logits /= T
    logits -= logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    exp_logits = np.exp(logits)
    return exp_logits / exp_logits.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import gc
import time
from collections import Counter

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, hstack, diags
from sklearn.base import clone
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD, NMF

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
    CountVectorizer,

)
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB, MultinomialNB
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

SEED = 42
N_SPLITS = 5
np.random.seed(SEED)
start_time = time.time()


def build_style_features(texts):
    s = pd.Series(texts).fillna("")
    lower = s.str.lower()
    words = lower.str.split()

    df = pd.DataFrame(index=np.arange(len(texts)))

    df["num_chars"] = s.str.len().astype(np.float64)
    df["num_words"] = words.str.len().astype(np.float64)
    df["unique_words"] = words.apply(lambda ws: len(set(ws))).astype(np.float64)
    df["unique_ratio"] = df["unique_words"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)
    df["avg_word_len"] = df["num_chars"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["sentences"] = s.str.count(r"[.!?]+").astype(np.float64)
    df["words_per_sentence"] = df["num_words"] / (df["sentences"] + 1e-5)

    df["exclams"] = s.str.count("!").astype(np.float64)
    df["questions"] = s.str.count(r"\?").astype(np.float64)
    df["periods"] = s.str.count(r"\.").astype(np.float64)
    df["commas"] = s.str.count(",").astype(np.float64)
    df["semicolons"] = s.str.count(";").astype(np.float64)
    df["colons"] = s.str.count(":").astype(np.float64)
    df["dbl_quotes"] = s.str.count('"').astype(np.float64)
    df["single_quotes"] = s.str.count("'").astype(np.float64)
    df["dashes"] = s.str.count(r"[-–—]").astype(np.float64)
    df["ellipses"] = s.str.count(r"\.\.\.").astype(np.float64)
    df["punct_count"] = (
        df["periods"]
        + df["commas"]
        + df["semicolons"]
        + df["colons"]
        + df["exclams"]
        + df["questions"]
        + df["dbl_quotes"]
        + df["single_quotes"]
        + df["dashes"]
    )

    def _stop_count(text):
        toks = text.lower().split()
        return sum(1 for w in toks if w.strip(".,;:!?\"()[]-'") in ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    df["stop_count"] = s.apply(_stop_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["stop_ratio"] = df["stop_count"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["first_person"] = lower.str.count(r"\b(i|me|my|mine|we|our|ours|us)\b").astype(
        np.float64
    )
    df["second_person"] = lower.str.count(
        r"\b(you|your|yours|thou|thee|thy|thine)\b"
    ).astype(np.float64)
    df["third_person"] = lower.str.count(
        r"\b(he|him|his|she|her|hers|they|them|their|theirs|it|its)\b"
    ).astype(np.float64)

    df["contractions"] = lower.str.count(r"\b\w+n't\b|\b\w+'(s|re|ve|d|ll|m)\b").astype(
        np.float64
    )

    def _hapax_count(ws):
        if not ws:
            return 0
        c = Counter(ws)
        return sum(1 for v in c.values() if v == 1)

    df["hapax"] = words.apply(_hapax_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["hapax_ratio"] = df["hapax"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    def _cap_count(text):
        return sum(1 for w in text.split() if len(w) > 1 and w[0].isupper())

    df["caps"] = s.apply(_cap_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["cap_ratio"] = df["caps"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["digits"] = s.str.count(r"\d").astype(np.float64)

    def _long_count(text):
        return sum(1 for w in text.split() if len(w) >= 7)

    df["long_words"] = s.apply(_long_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["long_word_ratio"] = df["long_words"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    markers = [
        "which",
        "whom",
        "whose",
        "upon",
        "shall",
        "never",
        "nothing",
        "fear",
        "dark",
        "night",
        "every",
        "such",
        "only",
        "still",
        "yet",
        "might",
        "could",
        "would",
        "must",
        "one",
    ]
    for marker in markers:
        df[f"m_{marker}"] = lower.str.count(r"\b" + marker + r"\b").astype(np.float64)

    return df


def compute_bm25(X, k1=1.6, b=0.75):
    X = X.tocsr().astype(np.float64)
    N = X.shape[0]
    df = np.asarray((X > 0).sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    idf = np.log((N - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5) + 1.0)
    row_sums = np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    avgdl = row_sums.mean()

    n_rows = X.shape[0]
    row_indices = np.repeat(np.arange(n_rows), np.diff(X.indptr))
    denom = X.data + k1 * (1.0 - b + b * row_sums[row_indices] / (avgdl + 1e-6))
    bm25_data = X.data * (k1 + 1.0) / denom * idf[X.indices]
    return csr_matrix((bm25_data, X.indices, X.indptr), shape=X.shape)


def compute_nb_ratios(X_counts, y, alpha=1.0, clip=5.0):
    V = X_counts.shape[1]
    ratios = []
    for cls in range(3):
        pos = np.asarray(X_counts[y == cls].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
        neg = np.asarray(X_counts[y != cls].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
        total_pos = pos.sum()
        total_neg = neg.sum()

        p_pos = (pos + alpha) / (total_pos + alpha * V)
        p_neg = (neg + alpha) / (total_neg + alpha * V)
        ratio = np.log(p_pos / p_neg)
        ratio = np.clip(ratio, -clip, clip)
        ratios.append(ratio)
    return ratios


def make_nb_aug(X_counts, ratios):
    parts = []
    for ratio in ratios:
        parts.append(X_counts @ diags(ratio))
    return hstack(parts).tocsr()


def build_meta_features(prob_dict, names):
    parts = []
    for name in names:
        p = np.clip(prob_dict[name], 1e-9, 1.0 - 1e-9)
        parts.append(p)
        parts.append(np.log(p / (1.0 - p)))
    return np.hstack(parts)


def temperature_scale(probs, T):
    p = np.clip(probs, 1e-12, 1.0)
    logits = np.log(p) / T
    logits -= logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    exp = np.exp(logits)
    return exp / exp.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import gc
import time

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb

from scipy.sparse import hstack as sp_hstack, diags
from sklearn.base import clone
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
    CountVectorizer,
    TfidfVectorizer,
)
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB, MultinomialNB
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, normalize
from sklearn.semi_supervised import LabelSpreading

SEED = 42
N_SPLITS = 5
np.random.seed(SEED)
start_time = time.time()


def build_style_features(texts):
    s = pd.Series(texts).fillna("")
    lower = s.str.lower()
    words = lower.str.split()

    df = pd.DataFrame(index=np.arange(len(texts)))

    df["num_chars"] = s.str.len().astype(np.float64)
    df["num_words"] = words.str.len().astype(np.float64)
    df["unique_words"] = words.apply(lambda ws: len(set(ws))).astype(np.float64)
    df["unique_ratio"] = df["unique_words"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)
    df["avg_word_len"] = df["num_chars"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["sentences"] = s.str.count(r"[.!?]+").astype(np.float64)
    df["words_per_sentence"] = df["num_words"] / (df["sentences"] + 1e-5)

    df["exclams"] = s.str.count("!").astype(np.float64)
    df["questions"] = s.str.count(r"\?").astype(np.float64)
    df["periods"] = s.str.count(r"\.").astype(np.float64)
    df["commas"] = s.str.count(",").astype(np.float64)
    df["semicolons"] = s.str.count(";").astype(np.float64)
    df["colons"] = s.str.count(":").astype(np.float64)
    df["dbl_quotes"] = s.str.count('"').astype(np.float64)
    df["single_quotes"] = s.str.count("'").astype(np.float64)
    df["dashes"] = s.str.count(r"[-–—]").astype(np.float64)
    df["ellipses"] = s.str.count(r"\.\.\.").astype(np.float64)
    df["punct_count"] = (
        df["periods"]
        + df["commas"]
        + df["semicolons"]
        + df["colons"]
        + df["exclams"]
        + df["questions"]
        + df["dbl_quotes"]
        + df["single_quotes"]
        + df["dashes"]
    )

    def _stop_count(text):
        toks = text.lower().split()
        return sum(1 for w in toks if w.strip(".,;:!?\"()[]-'") in ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    df["stop_count"] = s.apply(_stop_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["stop_ratio"] = df["stop_count"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["first_person"] = lower.str.count(r"\b(i|me|my|mine|we|our|ours|us)\b").astype(
        np.float64
    )
    df["second_person"] = lower.str.count(
        r"\b(you|your|yours|thou|thee|thy|thine)\b"
    ).astype(np.float64)
    df["third_person"] = lower.str.count(
        r"\b(he|him|his|she|her|hers|they|them|their|theirs|it|its)\b"
    ).astype(np.float64)

    df["contractions"] = lower.str.count(r"\b\w+n't\b|\b\w+'(s|re|ve|d|ll|m)\b").astype(
        np.float64
    )

    def _cap_count(text):
        return sum(1 for w in text.split() if len(w) > 1 and w[0].isupper())

    df["caps"] = s.apply(_cap_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["cap_ratio"] = df["caps"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    df["digits"] = s.str.count(r"\d").astype(np.float64)

    def _long_count(text):
        return sum(1 for w in text.split() if len(w) >= 7)

    df["long_words"] = s.apply(_long_count).astype(np.float64)
    df["long_word_ratio"] = df["long_words"] / (df["num_words"] + 1e-5)

    markers = [
        "which",
        "whom",
        "whose",
        "upon",
        "shall",
        "never",
        "nothing",
        "fear",
        "dark",
        "night",
        "every",
        "such",
        "only",
        "still",
        "yet",
        "might",
        "could",
        "would",
        "must",
        "one",
    ]
    for marker in markers:
        df[f"m_{marker}"] = lower.str.count(r"\b" + marker + r"\b").astype(np.float64)

    return df


def compute_nb_ratios(X_counts, y, alpha=1.0, clip=5.0):
    V = X_counts.shape[1]
    ratios = []
    for cls in range(3):
        pos = np.asarray(X_counts[y == cls].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
        neg = np.asarray(X_counts[y != cls].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
        total_pos = pos.sum()
        total_neg = neg.sum()

        p_pos = (pos + alpha) / (total_pos + alpha * V)
        p_neg = (neg + alpha) / (total_neg + alpha * V)
        ratio = np.log(p_pos / p_neg)
        ratio = np.clip(ratio, -clip, clip)
        ratios.append(ratio)
    return ratios


def make_nb_aug(X_counts, ratios):
    parts = []
    for ratio in ratios:
        parts.append(X_counts @ diags(ratio))
    return sp_hstack(parts).tocsr()


def softmax_rows(X):
    X = X - X.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    e = np.exp(X)
    return e / e.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def centroid_probas(X_tr, y_tr, X_val, X_test, temperature=10.0):
    X_tr = normalize(X_tr.astype(np.float64))
    X_val = normalize(X_val.astype(np.float64))
    X_test = normalize(X_test.astype(np.float64))

    centroids = []
    for cls in range(3):
        cent = np.asarray(X_tr[y_tr == cls].mean(axis=0)).ravel()
        norm = np.linalg.norm(cent)
        if norm > 1e-8:
            cent = cent / norm
        centroids.append(cent)

    C = np.vstack(centroids)
    val_score = X_val @ C.T
    test_score = X_test @ C.T
    return softmax_rows(temperature * val_score), softmax_rows(temperature * test_score)


def build_meta_features(prob_dict, names):
    parts = []
    for name in names:
        p = np.clip(prob_dict[name], 1e-9, 1.0 - 1e-9)
        parts.append(p)
        parts.append(np.log(p / (1.0 - p)))
    return np.hstack(parts)

X_char_tfidf_train = X_char_tfidf_all[:n_train].tocsr()
X_char_tfidf_test = X_char_tfidf_all[n_train:].tocsr()
X_word_count_train = X_word_count_all[:n_train].tocsr()
X_word_count_test = X_word_count_all[n_train:].tocsr()
X_char_count_train = X_char_count_all[:n_train].tocsr()

X_tfidf_train = X_tfidf_all[:n_train].tocsr()
X_tfidf_test = X_tfidf_all[n_train:].tocsr()

km_all = kmeans.transform(X_svd_all)

base_names = list(dict.fromkeys(base_names))

test_preds = {name: np.zeros((len(test_df), 3)) for name in base_names}

    print(f"Fold {fold + 1}/{N_SPLITS}")

    for name, model, feat_key in base_configs:

meta_lgb_oof = np.clip(meta_lgb_oof, 1e-9, 1.0 - 1e-9)

print(f"LGB meta CV logloss: {lgb_cv:.6f}")

import sys
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb

from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import ComplementNB
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

SEED = 42
N_FOLDS = 5
CLASS_ORDER = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
MODEL_NAMES = ["word_lr", "char_lr", "word_nb", "char_nb", "svd_lgb"]


def normalize_prob(p):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float64)
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-10, 1.0 - 1e-10)
    return p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def flatten_preds(preds):
    # preds: (n, 3, num_models) -> (n, num_models * 3) with model-major order
    return preds.transpose(0, 2, 1).reshape(preds.shape[0], -1)


def get_dense_features(texts):
    texts = texts.astype(str)

    char_len = texts.str.len().astype(float)

    word_lists = texts.str.split()
    word_count = word_lists.str.len().fillna(0).astype(float)

    avg_word_len = word_lists.apply(
        lambda lst: float(np.mean([len(w) for w in lst])) if len(lst) > 0 else 0.0
    )

    unique_ratio = word_lists.apply(
        lambda lst: float(len(set(lst)) / len(lst)) if len(lst) > 0 else 0.0
    )

    stopwords = (
        texts.str.lower()
        .str.count(
            r"\b(the|and|of|to|in|was|that|with|had|as|for|it|his|her|not|but|at|by|from|on|a|an|or|be|were|have|has|this|they|he|she|i|we)\b"
        )
        .astype(float)
    )

    punct = texts.str.count(r"[.,;:!?()\[\]-]").astype(float)
    commas = texts.str.count(",").astype(float)
    exclaims = texts.str.count(r"[!?]").astype(float)
    capitals = texts.str.count(r"[A-Z]").astype(float)
    quotes = texts.str.count('"').astype(float) + texts.str.count("'").astype(float)

    return np.column_stack(
        [
            char_len,
            word_count,
            avg_word_len,
            unique_ratio,
            stopwords,
            punct,
            commas,
            exclaims,
            capitals,
            quotes,
        ]
    ).astype(np.float64)


def _fit_lr_with_dense(
    vec, clf, Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr, dense_tr, dense_val, dense_te
):
    Xtr = vec.fit_transform(Xtr_text).tocsr()
    Xval = vec.transform(Xval_text).tocsr()
    Xte = vec.transform(Xte_text).tocsr()

    if dense_tr is not None:
        scaler = StandardScaler().fit(dense_tr)
        Xtr = hstack([Xtr, csr_matrix(scaler.transform(dense_tr))]).tocsr()
        Xval = hstack([Xval, csr_matrix(scaler.transform(dense_val))]).tocsr()
        Xte = hstack([Xte, csr_matrix(scaler.transform(dense_te))]).tocsr()

    clf.fit(Xtr, ytr)
    return clf.predict_proba(Xval), clf.predict_proba(Xte)


def _fit_nb(vec, clf, Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr, **kwargs):
    Xtr = vec.fit_transform(Xtr_text).tocsr()
    Xval = vec.transform(Xval_text).tocsr()
    Xte = vec.transform(Xte_text).tocsr()

    clf.fit(Xtr, ytr)
    return clf.predict_proba(Xval), clf.predict_proba(Xte)


def _fit_svd_lgb(Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr, dense_tr, dense_val, dense_te):
    vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        max_df=0.95,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=120000,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=200, random_state=SEED)

    clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=400,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=31,
        subsample=0.8,
        subsample_freq=1,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        random_state=SEED,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )

    Xtr_sp = vec.fit_transform(Xtr_text).tocsr()
    Xval_sp = vec.transform(Xval_text).tocsr()
    Xte_sp = vec.transform(Xte_text).tocsr()

    Xtr_svd = svd.fit_transform(Xtr_sp)
    Xval_svd = svd.transform(Xval_sp)
    Xte_svd = svd.transform(Xte_sp)

    Xtr_comb = np.hstack([Xtr_svd, dense_tr])
    Xval_comb = np.hstack([Xval_svd, dense_val])
    Xte_comb = np.hstack([Xte_svd, dense_te])

    scaler = StandardScaler().fit(Xtr_comb)
    Xtr_comb = scaler.transform(Xtr_comb)
    Xval_comb = scaler.transform(Xval_comb)
    Xte_comb = scaler.transform(Xte_comb)

    clf.fit(Xtr_comb, ytr)
    return clf.predict_proba(Xval_comb), clf.predict_proba(Xte_comb)


def fit_model(name, Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr, dense_tr, dense_val, dense_te):
    if name == "word_lr":
        vec = TfidfVectorizer(
            ngram_range=(1, 2),
            min_df=3,
            max_df=0.95,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            max_features=120000,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
        clf = OneVsRestClassifier(
            LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="liblinear", max_iter=1000)
        )
        return _fit_lr_with_dense(
            vec, clf, Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr, dense_tr, dense_val, dense_te
        )

    elif name == "char_lr":
        vec = TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(2, 5),
            min_df=3,
            max_df=0.95,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            max_features=200000,
            dtype=np.float32,
        )
        clf = OneVsRestClassifier(
            LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="liblinear", max_iter=1000)
        )
        return _fit_lr_with_dense(
            vec, clf, Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr, dense_tr, dense_val, dense_te
        )

    elif name == "word_nb":
        vec = CountVectorizer(
            ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=3, max_df=0.95, max_features=120000
        )
        clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(ComplementNB(alpha=0.5), cv=3, method="sigmoid")
        return _fit_nb(vec, clf, Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr)

    elif name == "char_nb":
        vec = CountVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(2, 5),
            min_df=3,
            max_df=0.95,
            max_features=200000,
        )
        clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(ComplementNB(alpha=0.5), cv=3, method="sigmoid")
        return _fit_nb(vec, clf, Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr)

    elif name == "svd_lgb":
        return _fit_svd_lgb(
            Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr, dense_tr, dense_val, dense_te
        )

    raise ValueError(f"Unknown model: {name}")


def main():
    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

    X = train["text"].fillna("")
    X_test = test["text"].fillna("")

    y_num = train["author"].map({"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}).astype(int).values

    n_train = len(X)
    n_test = len(X_test)

    all_text = pd.concat([X, X_test], ignore_index=True)
    dense_all = get_dense_features(all_text)
    dense_train_all = dense_all[:n_train]
    dense_test_all = dense_all[n_train:]

    oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3, len(MODEL_NAMES)))
    test_avg = np.zeros((n_test, 3, len(MODEL_NAMES)))

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y_num)):
        Xtr_text = X.iloc[tr_idx]
        Xval_text = X.iloc[va_idx]
        Xte_text = X_test

        dense_tr = dense_train_all[tr_idx]
        dense_val = dense_train_all[va_idx]
        dense_te = dense_test_all

        ytr = y_num[tr_idx]

        for m_idx, name in enumerate(MODEL_NAMES):
            p_val, p_test = fit_model(
                name, Xtr_text, Xval_text, Xte_text, ytr, dense_tr, dense_val, dense_te
            )
            oof[va_idx, :, m_idx] = normalize_prob(p_val)
            test_avg[:, :, m_idx] += normalize_prob(p_test) / N_FOLDS

        print(f"Fold {fold + 1}/{N_FOLDS} done", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)

    print("Base model out-of-fold log losses:")
    base_scores = []
    for m_idx, name in enumerate(MODEL_NAMES):
        p = normalize_prob(oof[:, :, m_idx])
        score = log_loss(y_num, p)
        base_scores.append(score)
        print(f"  {name}: {score:.5f}")

    # Uniform ensemble
    uniform_oof = normalize_prob(oof.mean(axis=2))
    uniform_cv = log_loss(y_num, uniform_oof)
    print(f"Uniform blend CV logloss: {uniform_cv:.5f}")

    # Logistic stacking on out-of-fold probabilities
    X_meta = flatten_preds(oof)
    oof_meta = np.zeros((n_train, 3))

    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED + 1)
    for tr_idx, va_idx in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y_num):
        meta = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        meta.fit(X_meta[tr_idx], y_num[tr_idx])
        oof_meta[va_idx] = meta.predict_proba(X_meta[va_idx])

    meta_cv = log_loss(y_num, normalize_prob(oof_meta))
    print(f"Stacked meta CV logloss: {meta_cv:.5f}")

    # Choose final model
    if meta_cv < uniform_cv:
        selected = "stacked_meta"
        final_cv = meta_cv

        meta_full = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        meta_full.fit(X_meta, y_num)
        test_meta = flatten_preds(test_avg)
        final_proba = normalize_prob(meta_full.predict_proba(test_meta))
    else:
        selected = "uniform_blend"
        final_cv = uniform_cv
        final_proba = normalize_prob(test_avg.mean(axis=2))

    print(f"Final selected model: {selected}")
    print(f"Final 5-fold CV logloss: {final_cv:.5f}")

    # Save submission
    submission = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": test["id"].values,
            "EAP": final_proba[:, 0],
            "HPL": final_proba[:, 1],
            "MWS": final_proba[:, 2],
        }
    )
    submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved submission.csv")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import re

from collections import Counter

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.sparse import hstack
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer, TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def set_seed(seed=42):
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


set_seed(42)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Constants
MAX_F = 30000
N_SPLITS = 5
EMBED_DIM = 128
HASH_SIZE = 100000
EPOCHS = 3
BATCH_SIZE = 128
N_CLASSES = 3

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

train["text"] = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
test["text"] = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str)

class_names = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
class_to_id = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(class_names)}
y = train["author"].map(class_to_id).values.astype(np.int64)

n_train = len(train)
n_test = len(test)

all_text = np.concatenate([train["text"].values, test["text"].values]).astype(str)

# Sparse feature sets
word_tfidf_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    max_features=MAX_F,
)
word_count_vec = CountVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
    binary=True,
    max_features=MAX_F,
)

char_tfidf_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    max_features=MAX_F,
)
char_count_vec = CountVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    min_df=3,
    max_df=0.95,
    binary=True,
    max_features=MAX_F,
)

X_wt_all = word_tfidf_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
X_wc_all = word_count_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
X_ct_all = char_tfidf_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
X_cc_all = char_count_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

X_wt_train = X_wt_all[:n_train]
X_wt_test = X_wt_all[n_train:]
X_wc_train = X_wc_all[:n_train]
X_wc_test = X_wc_all[n_train:]
X_ct_train = X_ct_all[:n_train]
X_ct_test = X_ct_all[n_train:]
X_cc_train = X_cc_all[:n_train]
X_cc_test = X_cc_all[n_train:]

# Neural hashed n-gram feature construction
WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9']+")


def fnv1a(s):
    h = 2166136261
    for ch in s.encode("utf-8"):
        h ^= ch
        h = (h * 16777619) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h


word_counts = Counter()
for text in all_text:
    word_counts.update(WORD_RE.findall(text.lower()))

word2id = {"<UNK>": 0}
for w, c in word_counts.items():
    if c >= 2:
        word2id[w] = len(word2id)

HASH_BASE = len(word2id)
feature_lists = []

for text in all_text:
    text_low = text.lower()
    tokens = WORD_RE.findall(text_low)

    ids = [word2id.get(t, 0) for t in tokens]

    # Word bigrams via hashing
    for i in range(len(tokens) - 1):
        ids.append(
            HASH_BASE + (fnv1a("w:" + tokens[i] + " " + tokens[i + 1]) % HASH_SIZE)
        )

    # Character 3/4/5-grams per token via hashing
    for token in tokens:
        padded = " " + token + " "
        for n in (3, 4, 5):
            for i in range(len(padded) - n + 1):
                ids.append(HASH_BASE + (fnv1a("c:" + padded[i : i + n]) % HASH_SIZE))

    if not ids:
        ids = [0]

    feature_lists.append(np.array(ids, dtype=np.int64))


def collate_batch(batch_indices):
    lengths = np.array([len(feature_lists[i]) for i in batch_indices], dtype=np.int64)
    input_ids = np.concatenate([feature_lists[i] for i in batch_indices]).astype(
        np.int64
    )
    offsets = np.zeros(len(batch_indices), dtype=np.int64)
    if len(batch_indices) > 1:
        offsets[1:] = np.cumsum(lengths)[:-1]
    return (
        torch.tensor(input_ids, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
        torch.tensor(offsets, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
    )


class FastTextClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, embed_dim, num_classes=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.emb = nn.EmbeddingBag(vocab_size, embed_dim, mode="mean")
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.3)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes)

    def forward(self, input_ids, offsets):
        x = self.emb(input_ids, offsets)
        x = F.relu(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.dropout(x)
        return self.fc2(x)


def train_nn(train_idx, val_idx):
    model = FastTextClassifier(HASH_BASE + HASH_SIZE, EMBED_DIM).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    steps_per_epoch = int(np.ceil(len(train_idx) / BATCH_SIZE))
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
        optimizer, T_max=EPOCHS * steps_per_epoch
    )

    for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
        shuffled = train_idx.copy()
        np.random.shuffle(shuffled)
        model.train()
        for start in range(0, len(shuffled), BATCH_SIZE):
            batch_idx = shuffled[start : start + BATCH_SIZE]
            input_ids, offsets = collate_batch(batch_idx)
            labels = torch.tensor(y[batch_idx], dtype=torch.long, device=device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = model(input_ids, offsets)
            loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, labels)
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()

    model.eval()
    val_probs = np.zeros((len(val_idx), N_CLASSES))
    with torch.no_grad():
        for start in range(0, len(val_idx), 256):
            batch_idx = val_idx[start : start + 256]
            input_ids, offsets = collate_batch(batch_idx)
            logits = model(input_ids, offsets)
            val_probs[start : start + len(batch_idx)] = (
                F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
            )

    test_probs = np.zeros((n_test, N_CLASSES))
    with torch.no_grad():
        for start in range(0, n_test, 256):
            end = min(start + 256, n_test)
            batch_idx = n_train + np.arange(start, end)
            input_ids, offsets = collate_batch(batch_idx)
            logits = model(input_ids, offsets)
            test_probs[start:end] = F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()

    return val_probs, test_probs


def lr_fit_predict(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, C):
    clf = LogisticRegression(C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4)
    clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    return clf.predict_proba(X_va), clf.predict_proba(X_te)


def nb_fit_predict(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te):
    clf = MultinomialNB(alpha=1.0)
    clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
    return clf.predict_proba(X_va), clf.predict_proba(X_te)


def nbsvm_fit_predict(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te):
    nbs = []
    transformed_parts = []

    for c in range(N_CLASSES):
        nb = MultinomialNB(alpha=1.0)
        nb.fit(X_tr, (y_tr == c).astype(np.int64))
        nbs.append(nb)
        r = nb.feature_log_prob_[1] - nb.feature_log_prob_[0]
        transformed_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))

    X_tr_nb = hstack(transformed_parts).tocsr()
    X_va_nb = hstack(
        [X_va.multiply(nb.feature_log_prob_[1] - nb.feature_log_prob_[0]) for nb in nbs]
    ).tocsr()
    X_te_nb = hstack(
        [X_te.multiply(nb.feature_log_prob_[1] - nb.feature_log_prob_[0]) for nb in nbs]
    ).tocsr()

    clf = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4)
    clf.fit(X_tr_nb, y_tr)
    return clf.predict_proba(X_va_nb), clf.predict_proba(X_te_nb)


sklearn_configs = [
    ("word_lr", X_wt_train, X_wt_test, "lr"),
    ("char_lr", X_ct_train, X_ct_test, "lr"),
    ("word_nb", X_wc_train, X_wc_test, "nb"),
    ("char_nb", X_cc_train, X_cc_test, "nb"),
    ("word_nbsvm", X_wc_train, X_wc_test, "nbsvm"),

    "char_nb",

test_preds = {name: np.zeros((n_test, N_CLASSES)) for name in names}

        if kind == "lr":

        elif kind == "nb":

        else:

        oof[name][va_idx] = pred_va
        test_preds[name] += pred_te / N_SPLITS

    set_seed(42 + fold)
    pred_va, pred_te = train_nn(tr_idx, va_idx)
    oof["nn_fasttext"][va_idx] = pred_va
    test_preds["nn_fasttext"] += pred_te / N_SPLITS

    print(f"  {name}: {log_loss(y, p, labels=[0, 1, 2]):.5f}")

test_stack = np.stack([test_preds[name] for name in names], axis=0)


def softmax(z):
    z = z - np.max(z)
    e = np.exp(z)
    return e / e.sum()


def objective(z):
    w = softmax(z)
    pred = np.tensordot(w, oof_stack, axes=(0, 0))
    pred = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    return log_loss(y, pred, labels=[0, 1, 2])


res = minimize(
    objective,
    np.zeros(len(names)),
    method="Nelder-Mead",
    options={"maxiter": 2000, "xatol": 1e-10, "fatol": 1e-10},
)

weights = softmax(res.x)
print("\nOptimized ensemble weights:")
for name, w in zip(names, weights):
    print(f"  {name}: {w:.4f}")


def apply_temperature(pred, T):
    p = np.clip(pred, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    p = np.power(p, 1.0 / T)
    p = p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return p

best_T = 1.0
best_loss = log_loss(y, np.clip(final_oof, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15), labels=[0, 1, 2])

print(f"5-fold CV ensemble log loss: {best_loss:.5f}")

for i, cname in enumerate(class_names):
    submission[cname] = final_test[:, i]

submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
print("Saved submission.csv")

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
folds = list(skf.split(train_text, y))


def make_stylo(texts):
    s = pd.Series(texts)
    lower = s.str.lower()
    words = s.str.split()
    n_words = words.str.len()

    d = {}
    d["len"] = s.str.len()
    d["n_words"] = n_words
    d["avg_word_len"] = d["len"] / np.maximum(n_words, 1)
    d["n_unique_words"] = [len(set(TOKEN_RE.findall(t.lower()))) for t in texts]
    d["n_sentences"] = s.str.count(r"[.!?]")
    d["n_capitals"] = s.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    d["n_digits"] = s.str.count(r"\d")
    d["n_quotes"] = s.str.count('"') + s.str.count("'") + s.str.count("’")
    d["n_apost"] = s.str.count("'") + s.str.count("’")
    d["has_quote"] = (s.str.count('"') > 0).astype(int)
    d["has_apost"] = (d["n_apost"] > 0).astype(int)

    for p in [".", ",", "!", "?", ";", ":", "(", ")", "-"]:
        d["punct_" + p] = s.str.count(re.escape(p))

    for w in [
        "said",
        "upon",
        "never",
        "which",
        "that",
        "would",
        "could",
        "man",
        "time",
        "eyes",
        "strange",
        "night",
        "long",
        "shall",
        "must",
    ]:
        d["w_" + w] = lower.str.count(r"\b" + w + r"\b")

    d["n_negations"] = lower.str.count(r"\bnot\b|\bnever\b|\bno\b|\bnor\b")

        oof[va] = model.predict_proba(X[va])
        test_pred += model.predict_proba(X_test) / len(folds)
    return oof, test_pred


def cv_nbsvm(X, X_test, alpha=1.0, C=1.0):
    oof = np.zeros((X.shape[0], len(CLASSES)))
    test_pred = np.zeros((X_test.shape[0], len(CLASSES)))
    for tr, va in folds:
        Xtr = X[tr]
        ytr = y[tr]
        ratios = []
        for j in range(len(CLASSES)):
            p = np.asarray(Xtr[ytr == j].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
            q = np.asarray(Xtr[ytr != j].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
            p = p / p.sum()
            q = q / q.sum()
            ratios.append(np.log(p / q).astype(np.float32))

        diag0 = sp.diags(ratios[0])
        diag1 = sp.diags(ratios[1])
        diag2 = sp.diags(ratios[2])

        Xtr_nb = sp.hstack([Xtr.dot(diag0), Xtr.dot(diag1), Xtr.dot(diag2)]).tocsr()
        Xva_nb = sp.hstack(
            [X[va].dot(diag0), X[va].dot(diag1), X[va].dot(diag2)]
        ).tocsr()
        Xte_nb = sp.hstack(
            [X_test.dot(diag0), X_test.dot(diag1), X_test.dot(diag2)]
        ).tocsr()

        model = LogisticRegression(
            C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=LR_MAX_ITER, tol=LR_TOL
        )
        model.fit(Xtr_nb, ytr)
        oof[va] = model.predict_proba(Xva_nb)
        test_pred += model.predict_proba(Xte_nb) / len(folds)
    return oof, test_pred

        )

class AttentionBiLSTM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size,
        embed_dim=EMBED_DIM,
        hidden_dim=HIDDEN_DIM,
        n_classes=3,
        dropout=0.3,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(embed_dim, hidden_dim, bidirectional=True, batch_first=True)
        self.attn_score = nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, 1, bias=False)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 4, n_classes),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        mask = x != 0
        mask = mask.clone()
        mask[:, 0] = mask[:, 0] | (~mask.any(dim=1))
        mask_float = mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()

        emb = self.dropout(self.embedding(x))
        out, _ = self.lstm(emb)

        scores = self.attn_score(out).squeeze(-1)
        scores = scores.masked_fill(~mask, -1e9)
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(scores, dim=1).unsqueeze(-1)
        context = (out * attn_weights).sum(dim=1)

        out_masked = out * mask_float
        maxpooled, _ = out_masked.max(dim=1)
        rep = torch.cat([context, maxpooled], dim=1)
        return self.classifier(rep)


def predict_loader(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            xb = batch[0].to(device)
            logits = model(xb)
            preds.append(torch.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(preds)


def run_neural(X_seq, y, X_seq_test):
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    oof = np.zeros((X_seq.shape[0], len(CLASSES)))
    test_pred = np.zeros((X_seq_test.shape[0], len(CLASSES)))
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    for fold_idx, (tr, va) in enumerate(folds):
        torch.manual_seed(42 + fold_idx)
        model = AttentionBiLSTM(len(vocab)).to(device)
        optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
        scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
            optimizer, T_max=MAX_EPOCHS
        )

        train_ds = TensorDataset(torch.tensor(X_seq[tr]), torch.tensor(y[tr]))
        val_ds = TensorDataset(torch.tensor(X_seq[va]), torch.tensor(y[va]))
        test_ds = TensorDataset(
            torch.tensor(X_seq_test), torch.zeros(len(X_seq_test), dtype=torch.long)
        )

        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(42 + fold_idx)
        train_loader = DataLoader(
            train_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, generator=g
        )
        val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=False)
        test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=False)

        best_loss = float("inf")
        best_state = None
        patience = 0

        for epoch in range(MAX_EPOCHS):
            model.train()
            for xb, yb in train_loader:
                xb = xb.to(device)
                yb = yb.to(device)
                optimizer.zero_grad()
                out = model(xb)
                loss = criterion(out, yb)
                loss.backward()
                nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0)
                optimizer.step()

            val_pred = predict_loader(model, val_loader, device)
            val_loss = log_loss(y[va], np.clip(val_pred, EPS, 1.0 - EPS))
            scheduler.step()

            if val_loss < best_loss:
                best_loss = val_loss
                best_state = {k: v.clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
                patience = 0
            else:
                patience += 1
                if patience >= 1:
                    break

        if best_state is not None:
            model.load_state_dict(best_state)

        oof[va] = predict_loader(model, val_loader, device)
        test_pred += predict_loader(model, test_loader, device) / len(folds)

        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    return oof, test_pred

import gc
import os
import random
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM"] = "false"

SEED = 42
N_FOLDS = 5
EPOCHS = 4
MAX_LEN = 192
BATCH_SIZE = 32
LR = 2e-5
MODEL_NAME = "roberta-base"
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

try:
    from transformers import (
        AutoTokenizer,
        AutoModelForSequenceClassification,
        get_linear_schedule_with_warmup,
    )

    HAS_TRANSFORMERS = True
    try:
        import transformers as _transformers

        _transformers.logging.set_verbosity_error()
    except Exception:
        pass
except Exception:
    HAS_TRANSFORMERS = False
    print("[Info] Transformers not available; will use fallback TF-IDF + LR.")


def set_seed(seed):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


class SimpleDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, input_ids, attention_mask, labels=None):
        self.input_ids = input_ids
        self.attention_mask = attention_mask
        self.labels = labels

    def __len__(self):
        return self.input_ids.size(0)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {
            "input_ids": self.input_ids[idx],
            "attention_mask": self.attention_mask[idx],
        }
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = self.labels[idx]
        return item


def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred):
    y_pred = np.clip(y_pred, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return log_loss(y_true, y_pred, labels=[0, 1, 2])


@torch.no_grad()
def predict_probabilities(model, dataloader):
    model.eval()
    all_probs = []
    for batch in dataloader:
        input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(DEVICE)
        attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(DEVICE)
        outputs = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
        logits = outputs.logits if hasattr(outputs, "logits") else outputs[0]
        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1).cpu().numpy()
        all_probs.append(probs)
    return np.concatenate(all_probs, axis=0)


def save_submission(test_ids, test_preds):
    test_preds = np.asarray(test_preds, dtype=np.float64)
    test_preds = np.clip(test_preds, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)
    test_preds = test_preds / test_preds.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    sub = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "id": test_ids,
            "EAP": test_preds[:, 0],
            "HPL": test_preds[:, 1],
            "MWS": test_preds[:, 2],
        }
    )
    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv ({len(sub)} rows)")


def get_tokenizer():
    try:
        tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
        dummy = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            MODEL_NAME, num_labels=3
        )
        del dummy
        gc.collect()
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
        return tokenizer
    except Exception as e:
        print("[Info] Could not load pretrained transformer; using fallback.")
        print(f"[Info] {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}")
        return None


def train_transformer_fold(tr_texts, tr_labels, val_texts, val_labels, tokenizer, fold):
    set_seed(SEED + fold + 1)

    tr_enc = tokenizer(
        tr_texts,
        max_length=MAX_LEN,
        truncation=True,
        padding="max_length",
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    val_enc = tokenizer(
        val_texts,
        max_length=MAX_LEN,
        truncation=True,
        padding="max_length",
        return_tensors="pt",
    )

    train_ds = SimpleDataset(
        tr_enc["input_ids"],
        tr_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(tr_labels, dtype=torch.long),
    )
    val_ds = SimpleDataset(
        val_enc["input_ids"],
        val_enc["attention_mask"],
        torch.tensor(val_labels, dtype=torch.long),
    )
    train_dl = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=0)
    val_dl = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)

    model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME, num_labels=3)
    model.to(DEVICE)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=0.01)
    total_steps = len(train_dl) * EPOCHS
    warmup_steps = int(0.1 * total_steps)
    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer,
        num_warmup_steps=warmup_steps,
        num_training_steps=total_steps,
    )

    best_loss = float("inf")
    best_state = None
    patience = 2
    wait = 0

    for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        running_loss = 0.0

        for batch in train_dl:
            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(DEVICE)
            attention_mask = batch["attention_mask"].to(DEVICE)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(DEVICE)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                labels=labels,
            )
            loss = outputs.loss if hasattr(outputs, "loss") else outputs[0]
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()

            running_loss += loss.item() * input_ids.size(0)

        train_loss = running_loss / len(tr_labels)
        val_probs = predict_probabilities(model, val_dl)
        val_score = compute_log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)

        print(
            f"  Epoch {epoch}/{EPOCHS}: train_loss={train_loss:.4f}, val_log_loss={val_score:.4f}"
        )

        if val_score < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_score
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
            wait = 0
        else:
            wait += 1
            if wait >= patience:
                print(f"  Early stopping at epoch {epoch}")
                break

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    val_probs = predict_probabilities(model, val_dl)
    return model, val_probs


def run_transformer_cv(train_texts, y, test_texts, test_ids, tokenizer):
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    oof = np.zeros((len(train_texts), 3), dtype=np.float32)
    test_preds = np.zeros((len(test_texts), 3), dtype=np.float32)
    cv_scores = []

    test_enc = tokenizer(
        test_texts,
        max_length=MAX_LEN,
        truncation=True,
        padding="max_length",
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    test_ds = SimpleDataset(test_enc["input_ids"], test_enc["attention_mask"], None)
    test_dl = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)

    for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train_texts, y)):
        print(f"\nFold {fold + 1}/{N_FOLDS}")

        tr_texts_fold = [train_texts[i] for i in tr_idx]
        val_texts_fold = [train_texts[i] for i in val_idx]
        tr_labels_fold = y[tr_idx]
        val_labels_fold = y[val_idx]

        model, val_probs = train_transformer_fold(
            tr_texts_fold,
            tr_labels_fold,
            val_texts_fold,
            val_labels_fold,
            tokenizer,
            fold,
        )

        oof[val_idx] = val_probs
        fold_loss = compute_log_loss(val_labels_fold, val_probs)
        cv_scores.append(fold_loss)
        print(f"Fold {fold + 1} log loss: {fold_loss:.6f}")

        test_preds += predict_probabilities(model, test_dl) / N_FOLDS

        del model
        gc.collect()
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    cv_mean = float(np.mean(cv_scores))
    cv_std = float(np.std(cv_scores))
    oof_loss = compute_log_loss(y, oof)

    print(f"\n5-Fold CV log loss (mean): {cv_mean:.6f} +/- {cv_std:.6f}")
    print(f"5-Fold CV log loss (OOF): {oof_loss:.6f}")

    save_submission(test_ids, test_preds)


def run_fallback(train_texts, y, test_texts, test_ids):
    from scipy.sparse import hstack
    from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
    from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    oof = np.zeros((len(train_texts), 3), dtype=np.float64)
    test_preds = np.zeros((len(test_texts), 3), dtype=np.float64)
    cv_scores = []

    for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train_texts, y)):
        print(f"\nFallback Fold {fold + 1}/{N_FOLDS}")

        tr_texts_fold = [train_texts[i] for i in tr_idx]
        val_texts_fold = [train_texts[i] for i in val_idx]

        word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
            ngram_range=(1, 2),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=100000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
        )
        char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
            analyzer="char_wb",
            ngram_range=(2, 5),
            min_df=2,
            max_features=100000,
            sublinear_tf=True,
            lowercase=True,
            strip_accents="unicode",
        )

        X_word_tr = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(tr_texts_fold)
        X_word_val = word_vectorizer.transform(val_texts_fold)
        X_word_te = word_vectorizer.transform(test_texts)

        X_char_tr = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(tr_texts_fold)
        X_char_val = char_vectorizer.transform(val_texts_fold)
        X_char_te = char_vectorizer.transform(test_texts)

        X_tr = hstack([X_word_tr, X_char_tr]).tocsr()
        X_val = hstack([X_word_val, X_char_val]).tocsr()
        X_te = hstack([X_word_te, X_char_te]).tocsr()

import os
import time
import warnings

os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HUB_OFFLINE"] = "1"
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.sparse as sp
import torch
import lightgbm as lgb

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

SEED = 42
N_SPLITS = 5
MAX_LEN = 192
TRANSFORMER_BATCH_SIZE = 16
TRANSFORMER_EPOCHS = 3
TRANSFORMER_LR = 2e-5

np.random.seed(SEED)
torch.manual_seed(SEED)


def handcrafted_features(texts: pd.Series) -> np.ndarray:
    """Fast stylometric features for LightGBM."""
    words = texts.str.split()
    num_words = words.str.len().astype(np.float32)
    num_unique = words.apply(lambda x: len(set(x))).astype(np.float32)
    avg_word_len = words.apply(
        lambda x: np.mean([len(w) for w in x]) if len(x) else 0.0
    ).astype(np.float32)
    num_chars = texts.str.len().astype(np.float32)
    stop_count = texts.apply(
        lambda s: sum(1 for w in s.split() if w.lower() in ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)
    ).astype(np.float32)

    df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "num_chars": num_chars,
            "num_words": num_words,
            "num_unique": num_unique,
            "avg_word_len": avg_word_len,
            "stopword_count": stop_count,
            "stopword_ratio": stop_count / (num_words + 1e-6),
            "unique_ratio": num_unique / (num_words + 1e-6),
            "exclam": texts.str.count("!").astype(np.float32),
            "quest": texts.str.count(r"\?").astype(np.float32),
            "comma": texts.str.count(",").astype(np.float32),
            "semicolon": texts.str.count(";").astype(np.float32),
            "colon": texts.str.count(":").astype(np.float32),
            "quote": texts.str.count('"').astype(np.float32),
            "apostrophe": texts.str.count("'").astype(np.float32),
            "digit": texts.str.count(r"\d").astype(np.float32),
            "caps": texts.str.count(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b").astype(np.float32),
            "sentence": texts.str.count(r"[.!?]").astype(np.float32) + 1.0,
        }
    )
    return df.values.astype(np.float32)


def predict_transformer_probs(model, dataset, device, batch_size=64):
    model.eval()
    probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
            dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False
        ):
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            outputs = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
            p = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=-1)
            probs.append(p.cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(probs)


def train_transformer(
    model, train_ds, val_ds, test_ds, device, val_labels, epochs=TRANSFORMER_EPOCHS
):
    model.to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        model.parameters(), lr=TRANSFORMER_LR, weight_decay=0.01
    )
    total_steps = (
        (len(train_ds) + TRANSFORMER_BATCH_SIZE - 1) // TRANSFORMER_BATCH_SIZE
    ) * epochs
    warmup_steps = max(1, int(total_steps * 0.1))

    from transformers import get_linear_schedule_with_warmup

    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer, num_warmup_steps=warmup_steps, num_training_steps=total_steps
    )
    loss_fn = torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)

    best_loss = float("inf")
    best_state = None
    no_improve = 0
    patience = 2

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for batch in torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
            train_ds, batch_size=TRANSFORMER_BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True
        ):
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
            loss = loss_fn(outputs.logits, labels)
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()

        val_probs = predict_transformer_probs(model, val_ds, device)
        val_loss = log_loss(val_labels, val_probs)

        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
            no_improve = 0
        else:
            no_improve += 1
            if no_improve >= patience:
                break

    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    val_probs = predict_transformer_probs(model, val_ds, device)
    test_probs = predict_transformer_probs(model, test_ds, device)
    return val_probs, test_probs


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

train["text"] = train["text"].astype(str)
test["text"] = test["text"].astype(str)

train_text = train["text"]
test_text = test["text"]

le = LabelEncoder()
y = le.fit_transform(train["author"].values)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Try to enable a pretrained transformer if GPU is available
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRANSFORMER_NAME = None
tokenizer = None
transformer_available = False

if torch.cuda.is_available():
    try:
        from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

        for candidate in [
            "distilbert-base-uncased",
            "roberta-base",
            "bert-base-uncased",
        ]:
            try:
                tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(candidate)
                model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
                    candidate, num_labels=3
                )
                TRANSFORMER_NAME = candidate
                tokenizer = tok
                transformer_available = True
                del model
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
                break
            except Exception:
                continue
    except Exception:
        transformer_available = False
else:
    print("CUDA not detected; transformer is skipped.")

print(f"GPU available: {torch.cuda.is_available()}")
print(f"Transformer available: {transformer_available}")

base_names = ["combo_lr", "char_lr", "lgb_svd"]
if transformer_available:
    base_names.append("transformer")
n_base = len(base_names)

if transformer_available:
    enc_train = tokenizer(
        train_text.tolist(),
        max_length=MAX_LEN,
        truncation=True,
        padding="max_length",
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
    enc_test = tokenizer(
        test_text.tolist(),
        max_length=MAX_LEN,
        truncation=True,
        padding="max_length",
        return_tensors="pt",
    )
else:
    enc_train = None
    enc_test = None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5-fold base model predictions
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
oof_stack = np.zeros((len(train), n_base * 3))
test_stack = np.zeros((len(test), n_base * 3))

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_SPLITS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

for fold, (trn_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train_text, y), 1):
    fold_start = time.time()
    print(f"Fold {fold}/{N_SPLITS} start", flush=True)

    Xtr_text = train_text.iloc[trn_idx]
    Xva_text = train_text.iloc[val_idx]
    ytr = y[trn_idx]
    yva = y[val_idx]

    word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=120000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        lowercase=True,
    )
    char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=150000,
        lowercase=True,
    )

    Xw_tr = word_vec.fit_transform(Xtr_text)
    Xw_va = word_vec.transform(Xva_text)
    Xw_te = word_vec.transform(test_text)

    Xc_tr = char_vec.fit_transform(Xtr_text)
    Xc_va = char_vec.transform(Xva_text)
    Xc_te = char_vec.transform(test_text)

    X_tr = sp.hstack([Xw_tr, Xc_tr]).tocsr()
    X_va = sp.hstack([Xw_va, Xc_va]).tocsr()
    X_te = sp.hstack([Xw_te, Xc_te]).tocsr()

    # Combined word + char logistic regression
    lr_combo = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=500)
    lr_combo.fit(X_tr, ytr)
    p_combo_va = lr_combo.predict_proba(X_va)
    p_combo_te = lr_combo.predict_proba(X_te)

    # Character-only logistic regression
    lr_char = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=500)
    lr_char.fit(Xc_tr, ytr)
    p_char_va = lr_char.predict_proba(Xc_va)
    p_char_te = lr_char.predict_proba(Xc_te)

    # SVD + handcrafted features for LightGBM
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=60, algorithm="randomized", random_state=SEED)
    svd_tr = svd.fit_transform(X_tr).astype(np.float32)
    svd_va = svd.transform(X_va).astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te).astype(np.float32)

    h_tr = handcrafted_features(Xtr_text)
    h_va = handcrafted_features(Xva_text)
    h_te = handcrafted_features(test_text)

    X_lgb_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, h_tr])
    X_lgb_va = np.hstack([svd_va, h_va])
    X_lgb_te = np.hstack([svd_te, h_te])

    dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_lgb_tr, label=ytr)
    dva = lgb.Dataset(X_lgb_va, label=yva, reference=dtr)

    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": 3,
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 15,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": SEED,
    }

    bst = lgb.train(
        lgb_params,
        dtr,
        num_boost_round=800,
        valid_sets=[dva],
        callbacks=[
            lgb.early_stopping(100, verbose=False),
            lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
        ],
    )
    p_lgb_va = bst.predict(X_lgb_va, num_iteration=bst.best_iteration)
    p_lgb_te = bst.predict(X_lgb_te, num_iteration=bst.best_iteration)

    val_preds = np.hstack([p_combo_va, p_char_va, p_lgb_va])
    test_preds = np.hstack([p_combo_te, p_char_te, p_lgb_te])

    # Transformer fine-tuning
    if transformer_available:
        device = torch.device("cuda")
        model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            TRANSFORMER_NAME, num_labels=3
        )

        train_ds = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(
            enc_train["input_ids"][trn_idx],
            enc_train["attention_mask"][trn_idx],
            torch.tensor(ytr, dtype=torch.long),
        )
        val_ds = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(
            enc_train["input_ids"][val_idx],
            enc_train["attention_mask"][val_idx],
            torch.tensor(yva, dtype=torch.long),
        )
        test_ds = torch.utils.data.TensorDataset(
            enc_test["input_ids"], enc_test["attention_mask"]
        )

        p_tfm_va, p_tfm_te = train_transformer(
            model, train_ds, val_ds, test_ds, device, yva
        )
        val_preds = np.hstack([val_preds, p_tfm_va])
        test_preds = np.hstack([test_preds, p_tfm_te])

        del model
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    oof_stack[val_idx] = val_preds
    test_stack += test_preds

    fold_seconds = time.time() - fold_start
    print(f"Fold {fold}/{N_SPLITS} done in {fold_seconds:.1f}s", flush=True)

test_stack /= N_SPLITS

meta_cv_pred = np.zeros((len(train), 3))

for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
    class_idx = list(le.classes_).index(col)
    submission[col] = test_prob[:, class_idx]

submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

import warnings

import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline

import lightgbm as lgb


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)
    all_text = pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0).fillna("")

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=80000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=80000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=150000,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=100000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_tr_word = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_char_cnt, all_word_cnt

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word, X_tr_char]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word, X_te_char]).tocsr()

    print("Building SVD features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=80, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_tr = svd.fit_transform(X_tr_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    X_dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, style_tr.values]).astype(np.float32)
    X_dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, style_te.values]).astype(np.float32)

    model_names = [
        "lr_all",
        "lr_char",
        "sgd_all",
        "mnb_ch",
        "cnb_w",
        "bnb_ch",
        "bnb_w",
        "lgb",
    ]

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import time
import re
from collections import Counter

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

import lightgbm as lgb


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sentences"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps_words"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )
    feats["stop_ratio"] = feats["n_stop"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_digit"] = text.str.count(r"\d")
    feats["n_double_quote"] = text.str.count('"')
    feats["n_single_quote"] = text.str.count("'")
    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z']+|[0-9]+")


class TextDS(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, token_ids):
        self.token_ids = token_ids

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.token_ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        toks = self.token_ids[idx]
        if len(toks) == 0:
            toks = [0]
        return torch.tensor(toks, dtype=torch.long), idx


def collate_batch(batch):
    all_tokens = []
    offsets = []
    local_ids = []
    cur = 0
    for toks, lidx in batch:
        if len(toks) == 0:
            toks = torch.tensor([0], dtype=torch.long)
        all_tokens.append(toks)
        offsets.append(cur)
        cur += len(toks)
        local_ids.append(lidx)

    input_tensor = torch.cat(all_tokens)
    offsets_tensor = torch.tensor(offsets, dtype=torch.long)
    local_ids_tensor = torch.tensor(local_ids, dtype=torch.long)
    return input_tensor, offsets_tensor, local_ids_tensor


class EmbeddingBagClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, emb_dim=128, hidden=64, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.emb = nn.EmbeddingBag(vocab_size, emb_dim, mode="mean", padding_idx=0)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(emb_dim, hidden)
        self.act = nn.ReLU()
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden, 3)

    def forward(self, input_tensor, offsets):
        x = self.emb(input_tensor, offsets)
        x = self.drop(x)
        x = self.act(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.drop(x)
        return self.fc2(x)


def predict_nn(model, loader, n_rows, device):
    model.eval()
    pred = np.zeros((n_rows, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    with torch.no_grad():
        for input_tensor, offsets, local_ids in loader:
            logits = model(input_tensor.to(device), offsets.to(device))
            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
            pred[local_ids.numpy()] = probs
    return pred


def train_neural(tr_idx, val_idx, token_ids, y, vocab_size, device, fold, test_loader):
    train_ds = TextDS([token_ids[i] for i in tr_idx])
    val_ds = TextDS([token_ids[i] for i in val_idx])

    torch.manual_seed(2024 + fold)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        train_ds, batch_size=128, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_batch
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        val_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_batch
    )

    model = EmbeddingBagClassifier(vocab_size).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=8)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    best_state = None
    best_loss = float("inf")
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(8):
        model.train()
        for input_tensor, offsets, local_ids in train_loader:
            yb = torch.tensor(
                y[tr_idx[local_ids.numpy()]], dtype=torch.long, device=device
            )
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = model(input_tensor.to(device), offsets.to(device))
            loss = criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0)
            optimizer.step()

        scheduler.step()

        val_probs = predict_nn(model, val_loader, len(val_idx), device)
        val_loss = log_loss(y[val_idx], normalize_rows(val_probs))
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 2:
                break

    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    val_probs = predict_nn(model, val_loader, len(val_idx), device)
    test_probs = predict_nn(model, test_loader, len(test_loader.dataset), device)
    return val_probs, test_probs
