import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis

import lightgbm as lgb


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def make_nbsvm_features(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, alpha=1.0):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    tr_parts, va_parts, te_parts = [], [], []
    n_features = X_tr.shape[1]

    for c in classes:
        mask = y_tr == c
        pos = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        neg = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha

        r = np.log(pos / (pos.sum() + alpha * n_features)) - np.log(
            neg / (neg.sum() + alpha * n_features)
        )
        r = r.astype(np.float32)

        tr_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))
        va_parts.append(X_va.multiply(r))
        te_parts.append(X_te.multiply(r))

    return hstack(tr_parts).tocsr(), hstack(va_parts).tocsr(), hstack(te_parts).tocsr()


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    splits = list(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y))

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)
    all_text = pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0).fillna("")

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=80000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=80000,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=100000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=150000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_tr_word_tf = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_tf = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_tf = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_tf = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_word_cnt, all_char_cnt

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word_tf, X_tr_char_tf]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word_tf, X_te_char_tf]).tocsr()

    print("Building SVD features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_tr = svd.fit_transform(X_tr_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    X_dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, style_tr.values]).astype(np.float32)
    X_dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, style_te.values]).astype(np.float32)

    base_names = [
        "lr_all",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_word",
        "lr_svd",
        "sgd_all",
        "mnb_w",
        "mnb_c",
        "cnb_w",
        "cnb_c",
        "bnb_w",
        "bnb_c",
        "nbsvm_w",
        "lgb_svd",
        "mlp_svd",
        "knn_svd",
        "lda_svd",

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(splits):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        m = LogisticRegression(

        )

        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_tf[val])
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_tf) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on word TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_word_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_tf[val])
        test_pred["lr_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_tf) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on SVD + stylometric features
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_svd"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val])
        test_pred["lr_svd"] += m.predict_proba(X_dense_te) / n_splits

        )

    final_test = normalize_rows(meta_pipe.predict_proba(X_meta_test).astype(np.float32))

from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

import lightgbm as lgb

try:
    from xgboost import XGBClassifier

    HAS_XGB = True
except Exception:
    HAS_XGB = False


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    row_sum = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sum[row_sum == 0] = 1.0
    return P / row_sum


def safe_log_loss(y, P):
    return log_loss(y, normalize_rows(np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)))


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)
    all_text = (
        pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0)
        .reset_index(drop=True)
        .fillna("")
    )

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=140000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 6),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=140000,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=120000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=160000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_tr_word = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word, X_tr_char]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word, X_te_char]).tocsr()

    print("Building SVD/LDA dense features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=120, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_tr = svd.fit_transform(X_tr_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

    lda = LatentDirichletAllocation(
        n_components=12,
        learning_method="batch",
        max_iter=10,
        random_state=42,
    )
    lda.fit(all_word_cnt)
    lda_tr = lda.transform(all_word_cnt[:n_train]).astype(np.float32)
    lda_te = lda.transform(all_word_cnt[n_train:]).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    X_dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, lda_tr, style_tr.values]).astype(np.float32)
    X_dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, lda_te, style_te.values]).astype(np.float32)

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_word_cnt, all_char_cnt

    model_names = [
        "lr_word",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_all",
        "sgd_all",
        "mnb_word",
        "mnb_char",
        "cnb_word",
        "cnb_char",
        "bnb_word",
        "bnb_char",
        "lgb_dense",
        "mlp_dense",
        "knn_dense",
        "lr_svd",
    ]
    if HAS_XGB:
        model_names.append("xgb_dense")

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y)):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        # Logistic regression on word + trigram TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=5.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_word[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word[val])
        test_pred["lr_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on character TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=5.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_char[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char[val])
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on word + char TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["lr_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        # SGD logistic regression on combined TF-IDF
        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss", alpha=1e-4, max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["sgd_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["sgd_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        # Multinomial NB on word counts
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["mnb_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        # Multinomial NB on char counts
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["mnb_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        # Complement NB on word counts
        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["cnb_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        # Complement NB on char counts
        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["cnb_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        # Bernoulli NB on word counts
        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["bnb_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        # Bernoulli NB on char counts
        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["bnb_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        # LightGBM on dense SVD + LDA + stylometric features
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[val], y_val)
        params = {
            "objective": "multiclass",
            "num_class": 3,
            "metric": "multi_logloss",
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "feature_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_freq": 1,
            "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
            "lambda_l2": 1.0,
            "verbosity": -1,
            "seed": 42,
            "num_threads": 4,
        }
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_dense"][val] = (
            np.asarray(model.predict(X_dense_tr[val])).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        )
        test_pred["lgb_dense"] += (
            np.asarray(model.predict(X_dense_te)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # XGBoost on dense features
        if HAS_XGB:
            m = XGBClassifier(
                n_estimators=1000,
                max_depth=4,
                learning_rate=0.05,
                subsample=0.8,
                colsample_bytree=0.8,
                objective="multi:softprob",
                num_class=3,
                eval_metric="mlogloss",
                tree_method="hist",
                n_jobs=4,
                random_state=42,
                early_stopping_rounds=50,
            )
            m.fit(
                X_dense_tr[tr],
                y_tr,
                eval_set=[(X_dense_tr[val], y_val)],
                verbose=False,
            )
            oof["xgb_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
            test_pred["xgb_dense"] += (
                m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
            )

        # MLP on scaled dense features
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            MLPClassifier(
                hidden_layer_sizes=(128, 64),
                max_iter=200,
                early_stopping=True,
                n_iter_no_change=10,
                random_state=42,
            ),
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mlp_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["mlp_dense"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # KNN on scaled dense features
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=45, weights="distance", n_jobs=-1),
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["knn_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["knn_dense"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Logistic regression on scaled dense features
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            LogisticRegression(
                C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
            ),
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_svd"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_svd"] += m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

    print("\nBase model CV log losses:", flush=True)
    for name in model_names:
        cv = safe_log_loss(y, oof[name])
        print(f"  {name}: {cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    avg_oof = np.mean([oof[name] for name in model_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
    avg_cv = safe_log_loss(y, avg_oof)
    print(f"Simple average CV log loss: {avg_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Meta features: raw probabilities, log probabilities, and entropy
    X_meta = np.hstack([oof[name] for name in model_names]).astype(np.float32)
    X_meta = np.hstack(
        [
            X_meta,
            np.log(np.clip(X_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            -np.sum(
                X_meta * np.log(np.clip(X_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1, keepdims=True
            ),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[name] for name in model_names]).astype(
        np.float32
    )
    X_meta_test = np.hstack(
        [
            X_meta_test,
            np.log(np.clip(X_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            -np.sum(
                X_meta_test * np.log(np.clip(X_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)),
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True,
            ),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    Cs = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0]

    meta_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    blend_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    test_pred_stack = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    blend_weights = []

    def optimize_blend(idx):
        n_models = len(model_names)

        def loss(w):
            P = np.zeros((idx.size, 3), dtype=np.float64)
            for m_i, name in enumerate(model_names):
                P += w[m_i] * oof[name][idx].astype(np.float64)
            return log_loss(y[idx], normalize_rows(P))

        x0 = np.ones(n_models) / n_models
        res = minimize(
            loss,
            x0,
            method="SLSQP",
            bounds=[(0.0, 1.0)] * n_models,
            constraints={"type": "eq", "fun": lambda w: np.sum(w) - 1.0},
            options={"maxiter": 500, "ftol": 1e-12},
        )
        return res.x, res.fun

    print("Fitting meta-model with nested 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for tr_m, val_m in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y):
        # Select C for logistic stacker using inner 3-fold CV
        inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=7)
        best_C = Cs[0]
        best_score = 1e9
        for C in Cs:
            scores = []
            for itr, iva in inner_skf.split(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m]):
                lr_tmp = LogisticRegression(
                    C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4
                )
                lr_tmp.fit(X_meta[tr_m][itr], y[tr_m][itr])
                scores.append(
                    log_loss(
                        y[tr_m][iva],
                        normalize_rows(lr_tmp.predict_proba(X_meta[tr_m][iva])),
                    )
                )
            mean_score = np.mean(scores)
            if mean_score < best_score:
                best_score = mean_score
                best_C = C

        lr_stack = LogisticRegression(C=best_C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4)
        lr_stack.fit(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m])
        meta_oof[val_m] = lr_stack.predict_proba(X_meta[val_m])
        test_pred_stack += (
            normalize_rows(lr_stack.predict_proba(X_meta_test)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # Optimize convex blend on only the meta-train fold
        wts, _ = optimize_blend(tr_m)
        blend_weights.append(wts)
        P_val = np.zeros((val_m.size, 3), dtype=np.float64)
        for m_i, name in enumerate(model_names):
            P_val += wts[m_i] * oof[name][val_m].astype(np.float64)
        blend_oof[val_m] = normalize_rows(P_val).astype(np.float32)

    stack_cv = safe_log_loss(y, meta_oof)
    blend_cv = safe_log_loss(y, blend_oof)
    print(f"Stacked CV log loss: {stack_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"Convex blend CV log loss: {blend_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    if stack_cv <= blend_cv:
        final_test = normalize_rows(test_pred_stack)
        final_cv = stack_cv
        print("Using stacked meta-model for final submission.", flush=True)
    else:
        final_test = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float64)
        for wts in blend_weights:
            P_te = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float64)
            for m_i, name in enumerate(model_names):
                P_te += wts[m_i] * test_pred[name].astype(np.float64)
            final_test += normalize_rows(P_te) / len(blend_weights)
        final_test = normalize_rows(final_test)
        final_cv = blend_cv
        print("Using convex blend for final submission.", flush=True)

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Final 5-fold CV log loss: {final_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

try:

def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    row_sum = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sum[row_sum == 0] = 1.0
    return P / row_sum


def safe_log_loss(y, P):
    return log_loss(y, normalize_rows(np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)))


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


class BiLSTMClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, embed_dim=128, hidden_dim=128, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(embed_dim, hidden_dim, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)
        self.attn = nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, 1)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, 3)

    def forward(self, input_ids, mask):
        emb = self.dropout(self.embedding(input_ids))
        lstm_out, _ = self.lstm(emb)
        scores = self.attn(lstm_out).squeeze(-1)
        scores = scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, -1e9)
        attn = torch.softmax(scores, dim=1)
        ctx = (lstm_out * attn.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1)
        return self.fc(self.dropout(ctx))


def prepare_deep_data(all_text, device):
    use_pretrained = HAVE_TRANSFORMERS and device.type == "cuda"

    if use_pretrained:
        try:
            checkpoint = "distilbert-base-uncased"
            tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint, local_files_only=True)
            enc = tokenizer(
                list(all_text),
                padding="max_length",
                truncation=True,
                max_length=192,
                return_tensors="pt",
            )
            print("Using cached distilbert-base-uncased for deep model.", flush=True)
            return (
                "transformer",
                enc["input_ids"],
                enc["attention_mask"],
                tokenizer,
                checkpoint,
                None,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            print(
                f"Pretrained transformer unavailable ({e}); using BiLSTM.", flush=True
            )

    print("Preparing BiLSTM word sequence features...", flush=True)
    token_pattern = re.compile(r"[a-z']+")
    counts = Counter()
    for text in all_text:
        counts.update(token_pattern.findall(text.lower()))

    vocab = [w for w, c in counts.items() if c >= 2]
    word2idx = {w: i + 2 for i, w in enumerate(vocab)}
    vocab_size = len(vocab) + 2
    max_len = 128
    n = len(all_text)

    ids = np.zeros((n, max_len), dtype=np.int64)
    mask = np.zeros_like(ids)

    for i, text in enumerate(all_text):
        tokens = token_pattern.findall(text.lower())[:max_len]
        if tokens:
            seq = [word2idx.get(t, 1) for t in tokens]
            ids[i, : len(seq)] = seq
            mask[i, : len(seq)] = 1

    return (
        "bilstm",
        torch.tensor(ids),
        torch.tensor(mask),
        None,
        None,
        vocab_size,
    )


@torch.no_grad()
def predict_transformer(model, loader, device, need_loss=True):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    total_loss = 0.0
    total = 0

    for input_ids, attention_mask, labels in loader:
        input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
        attention_mask = attention_mask.to(device)
        logits = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask).logits
        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        preds.append(probs)

        if need_loss:
            loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, labels.to(device))
            total_loss += loss.item() * input_ids.size(0)
            total += input_ids.size(0)

    probs = np.vstack(preds)
    if need_loss:
        return total_loss / total, probs
    return 0.0, probs


def train_transformer_fold(
    input_ids, attention_mask, tokenizer, checkpoint, tr, val, y, device, n_train
):
    from transformers import get_linear_schedule_with_warmup

    y_tr = torch.tensor(y[tr], dtype=torch.long)
    y_val = torch.tensor(y[val], dtype=torch.long)

    train_ds = TensorDataset(input_ids[tr], attention_mask[tr], y_tr)
    val_ds = TensorDataset(input_ids[val], attention_mask[val], y_val)
    test_ds = TensorDataset(
        input_ids[n_train:],
        attention_mask[n_train:],
        torch.zeros(len(input_ids) - n_train, dtype=torch.long),
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=64, shuffle=False)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=64, shuffle=False)

    model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        checkpoint, num_labels=3, local_files_only=True
    ).to(device)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01)
    epochs = 4
    total_steps = len(train_loader) * epochs

    try:
        scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
            optimizer, int(0.1 * total_steps), total_steps
        )
    except AttributeError:
        scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR(
            optimizer,
            lambda step: min(1.0, (step + 1) / max(int(0.1 * total_steps), 1))
            * (1 - step / total_steps),
        )

    best_loss = float("inf")
    best_state = None
    bad_epochs = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for input_ids_b, attention_mask_b, labels_b in train_loader:
            input_ids_b = input_ids_b.to(device)
            attention_mask_b = attention_mask_b.to(device)
            labels_b = labels_b.to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(
                input_ids=input_ids_b, attention_mask=attention_mask_b, labels=labels_b
            )
            loss = outputs.loss
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()

        val_loss, _ = predict_transformer(model, val_loader, device, need_loss=True)

        if best_state is None or val_loss < best_loss - 1e-4:
            best_loss = val_loss
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
            bad_epochs = 0
        else:
            bad_epochs += 1
            if bad_epochs >= 2:
                break

    model.load_state_dict({k: v.to(device) for k, v in best_state.items()})
    _, val_probs = predict_transformer(model, val_loader, device, need_loss=True)
    _, test_probs = predict_transformer(model, test_loader, device, need_loss=False)

    return val_probs.astype(np.float32), test_probs.astype(np.float32)


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate_bilstm(model, loader, device, need_loss=True):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    total_loss = 0.0
    total = 0

    for input_ids, mask, labels in loader:
        input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
        mask = mask.to(device)
        logits = model(input_ids, mask)
        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        preds.append(probs)

        if need_loss:
            loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, labels.to(device))
            total_loss += loss.item() * input_ids.size(0)
            total += input_ids.size(0)

    probs = np.vstack(preds)
    if need_loss:
        return total_loss / total, probs
    return 0.0, probs


def train_bilstm_fold(input_ids, mask, tr, val, y, device, vocab_size, n_train):
    y_tr = torch.tensor(y[tr], dtype=torch.long)
    y_val = torch.tensor(y[val], dtype=torch.long)

    train_ds = TensorDataset(input_ids[tr], mask[tr], y_tr)
    val_ds = TensorDataset(input_ids[val], mask[val], y_val)
    test_ds = TensorDataset(
        input_ids[n_train:],
        mask[n_train:],
        torch.zeros(len(input_ids) - n_train, dtype=torch.long),
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=128, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=False)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=False)

    model = BiLSTMClassifier(vocab_size=vocab_size).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    epochs = 8
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
        optimizer, max_lr=2e-3, total_steps=len(train_loader) * epochs, pct_start=0.1
    )

    best_loss = float("inf")
    best_state = None
    bad_epochs = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for input_ids_b, mask_b, labels_b in train_loader:
            input_ids_b = input_ids_b.to(device)
            mask_b = mask_b.to(device)
            labels_b = labels_b.to(device)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = model(input_ids_b, mask_b)
            loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, labels_b)
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()

        val_loss, _ = evaluate_bilstm(model, val_loader, device, need_loss=True)

        if best_state is None or val_loss < best_loss - 1e-4:
            best_loss = val_loss
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
            bad_epochs = 0
        else:
            bad_epochs += 1
            if bad_epochs >= 2:
                break

    model.load_state_dict({k: v.to(device) for k, v in best_state.items()})
    _, val_probs = evaluate_bilstm(model, val_loader, device, need_loss=True)
    _, test_probs = evaluate_bilstm(model, test_loader, device, need_loss=False)

    return val_probs.astype(np.float32), test_probs.astype(np.float32)


def train_deep_fold(
    mode,
    input_ids,
    mask,
    tokenizer,
    checkpoint,
    tr,
    val,
    y,
    device,
    n_train,
    vocab_size,
):
    if mode == "transformer":
        return train_transformer_fold(
            input_ids, mask, tokenizer, checkpoint, tr, val, y, device, n_train
        )
    else:
        return train_bilstm_fold(
            input_ids, mask, tr, val, y, device, vocab_size, n_train
        )

        min_df=2,

    X_tr_word = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()

    X_tr_char = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word, X_tr_char]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word, X_te_char]).tocsr()

    print("Building SVD/LDA dense features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=120, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_tr = svd.fit_transform(X_tr_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

    lda = LatentDirichletAllocation(
        n_components=12, learning_method="batch", max_iter=10, random_state=42
    )
    lda.fit(all_word_cnt)
    lda_tr = lda.transform(all_word_cnt[:n_train]).astype(np.float32)
    lda_te = lda.transform(all_word_cnt[n_train:]).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    X_dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, lda_tr, style_tr.values]).astype(np.float32)
    X_dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, lda_te, style_te.values]).astype(np.float32)

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_word_cnt, all_char_cnt

    model_names = [

        "mnb_char",

        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char[val])
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char) / n_splits

        )

        oof["lr_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])

        m = SGDClassifier(

        )

        oof["mnb_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])

        oof["cnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["cnb_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        oof["cnb_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])

        oof["bnb_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])

        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)

        m = make_pipeline(

        try:

            -np.sum(

                axis=1,
                keepdims=True,
            ),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    Cs = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0]

    meta_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    blend_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    test_pred_stack = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    blend_weights = []

    def optimize_blend(idx):
        n_models = len(model_names)

        def loss(w):
            P = np.zeros((idx.size, 3), dtype=np.float64)
            for m_i, name in enumerate(model_names):
                P += w[m_i] * oof[name][idx].astype(np.float64)
            return log_loss(y[idx], normalize_rows(P))

        x0 = np.ones(n_models) / n_models
        res = minimize(
            loss,
            x0,
            method="SLSQP",
            bounds=[(0.0, 1.0)] * n_models,
            constraints={"type": "eq", "fun": lambda w: np.sum(w) - 1.0},
            options={"maxiter": 500, "ftol": 1e-12},
        )
        return res.x, res.fun

    print("Fitting meta-model with nested 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for tr_m, val_m in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y):
        inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=7)
        best_C = Cs[0]
        best_score = 1e9
        for C in Cs:
            scores = []
            for itr, iva in inner_skf.split(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m]):
                lr_tmp = LogisticRegression(
                    C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4
                )
                lr_tmp.fit(X_meta[tr_m][itr], y[tr_m][itr])
                scores.append(
                    log_loss(
                        y[tr_m][iva],
                        normalize_rows(lr_tmp.predict_proba(X_meta[tr_m][iva])),
                    )
                )
            mean_score = np.mean(scores)
            if mean_score < best_score:
                best_score = mean_score
                best_C = C

        lr_stack = LogisticRegression(C=best_C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4)
        lr_stack.fit(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m])
        meta_oof[val_m] = lr_stack.predict_proba(X_meta[val_m])
        test_pred_stack += (
            normalize_rows(lr_stack.predict_proba(X_meta_test)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        wts, _ = optimize_blend(tr_m)
        blend_weights.append(wts)
        P_val = np.zeros((val_m.size, 3), dtype=np.float64)
        for m_i, name in enumerate(model_names):
            P_val += wts[m_i] * oof[name][val_m].astype(np.float64)
        blend_oof[val_m] = normalize_rows(P_val).astype(np.float32)

    stack_cv = safe_log_loss(y, meta_oof)
    blend_cv = safe_log_loss(y, blend_oof)
    print(f"Stacked CV log loss: {stack_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"Convex blend CV log loss: {blend_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    if stack_cv <= blend_cv:
        final_test = normalize_rows(test_pred_stack)
        final_cv = stack_cv
        print("Using stacked meta-model for final submission.", flush=True)
    else:
        final_test = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float64)
        for wts in blend_weights:
            P_te = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float64)
            for m_i, name in enumerate(model_names):
                P_te += wts[m_i] * test_pred[name].astype(np.float64)
            final_test += normalize_rows(P_te) / len(blend_weights)
        final_test = normalize_rows(final_test)
        final_cv = blend_cv
        print("Using convex blend for final submission.", flush=True)

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Final 5-fold CV log loss: {final_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

import time
import re
from collections import Counter

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack

    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD, LatentDirichletAllocation
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier

    HAS_XGB = False

import torch

from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    row_sum = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sum[row_sum == 0] = 1.0
    return P / row_sum


def safe_log_loss(y, P):
    return log_loss(y, normalize_rows(np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)))


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def build_token_sequences(texts, max_features=12000, max_len=90):
    token_re = re.compile(r"[a-z']+")

    def tokenize(s):
        return [t for t in token_re.findall(s.lower())]

    counter = Counter()
    for s in texts:
        counter.update(tokenize(s))

    common = [w for w, c in counter.most_common(max_features) if c >= 2]
    vocab = {w: i + 2 for i, w in enumerate(common)}

    sequences = []
    for s in texts:
        ids = [vocab.get(t, 1) for t in tokenize(s)][:max_len]
        if len(ids) < max_len:
            ids = ids + [0] * (max_len - len(ids))
        sequences.append(ids)

    return np.asarray(sequences, dtype=np.int64), len(vocab) + 2


class TransformerClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size,
        max_len,
        embed_dim=64,
        num_heads=4,
        num_layers=2,
        ff_dim=128,
        dropout=0.2,
        num_classes=3,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, embed_dim) * 0.02)
        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, max_len + 1, embed_dim))

        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=embed_dim,
            nhead=num_heads,
            dim_feedforward=ff_dim,
            dropout=dropout,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(embed_dim, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        mask = x == 0
        batch = x.size(0)

        emb = self.embedding(x)
        cls_tokens = self.cls_token.expand(batch, -1, -1)
        emb = torch.cat([cls_tokens, emb], dim=1)

        cls_mask = torch.zeros(batch, 1, dtype=torch.bool, device=x.device)
        mask = torch.cat([cls_mask, mask], dim=1)

        emb = emb + self.pos_embed[:, : emb.size(1), :]
        emb = self.dropout(emb)
        out = self.encoder(emb, src_key_padding_mask=mask)

        return self.fc(self.dropout(out[:, 0, :]))


def train_transformer_fold(
    X_tr, y_tr, X_val, y_val, X_test, device, is_gpu, vocab_size, max_len
):
    torch.manual_seed(42)

    if is_gpu:
        embed_dim, num_layers, ff_dim, max_epochs, patience, batch_size = (
            128,
            3,
            256,
            12,
            3,
            256,
        )
    else:
        embed_dim, num_layers, ff_dim, max_epochs, patience, batch_size = (
            64,
            2,
            128,
            8,
            2,
            128,
        )

    model = TransformerClassifier(
        vocab_size,
        max_len,
        embed_dim=embed_dim,
        num_heads=4,
        num_layers=num_layers,
        ff_dim=ff_dim,
        dropout=0.2,
    ).to(device)

    dataset = TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(X_tr, dtype=torch.long),
        torch.tensor(y_tr, dtype=torch.long),
    )
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, drop_last=False)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=max_epochs)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    val_ids = torch.tensor(X_val, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
    val_labels = torch.tensor(y_val, dtype=torch.long, device=device)

    best_loss = 1e9
    best_state = None
    bad = 0

    for epoch in range(max_epochs):
        model.train()
        for xb, yb in loader:
            xb = xb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            yb = yb.to(device, non_blocking=True)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            logits = model(xb)
            loss = criterion(logits, yb)
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        scheduler.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_logits = model(val_ids)
            val_loss = criterion(val_logits, val_labels).item()

        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            best_state = {k: v.detach().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
            bad = 0
        else:
            bad += 1
            if bad >= patience:
                break

    if best_state is None:
        best_state = {k: v.detach().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        val_probs = torch.softmax(model(val_ids), dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        te_ids = torch.tensor(X_test, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
        te_probs = torch.softmax(model(te_ids), dim=1).cpu().numpy()

    return val_probs, te_probs

            )

        # MLP on scaled dense features
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            MLPClassifier(
                hidden_layer_sizes=(128, 64),
                max_iter=200,
                early_stopping=True,
                n_iter_no_change=10,
                random_state=42,
            ),
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mlp_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["mlp_dense"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # KNN on scaled dense features
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=45, weights="distance", n_jobs=-1),
        )

        oof["knn_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["knn_dense"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Logistic regression on scaled dense features
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            LogisticRegression(
                C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
            ),
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_svd"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_svd"] += m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        # Transformer encoder from scratch
        transformer_val, transformer_test = train_transformer_fold(
            X_seq_tr_all[tr],
            y_tr,
            X_seq_tr_all[val],
            y_val,
            X_seq_te_all,
            device,
            is_gpu,
            vocab_size,
            max_len,
        )
        oof["transformer"][val] = transformer_val.astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["transformer"] += transformer_test.astype(np.float32) / n_splits

    print("\nBase model CV log losses:", flush=True)
    for name in model_names:
        cv = safe_log_loss(y, oof[name])
        print(f"  {name}: {cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    avg_oof = np.mean([oof[name] for name in model_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)

    print(f"Simple average CV log loss: {avg_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Meta features: raw probabilities, log probabilities, and entropy
    X_meta = np.hstack([oof[name] for name in model_names]).astype(np.float32)
    X_meta = np.hstack(
        [
            X_meta,
            np.log(np.clip(X_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            -np.sum(
                X_meta * np.log(np.clip(X_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1, keepdims=True
            ),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[name] for name in model_names]).astype(
        np.float32
    )
    X_meta_test = np.hstack(
        [
            X_meta_test,
            np.log(np.clip(X_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            -np.sum(
                X_meta_test * np.log(np.clip(X_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)),
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True,
            ),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    Cs = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0]

    meta_oof_logit = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    test_pred_logit = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32)

            P = np.zeros((idx.size, 3), dtype=np.float64)
            for m_i, name in enumerate(model_names):
                P += w[m_i] * oof[name][idx].astype(np.float64)
            return log_loss(y[idx], normalize_rows(P))

        res = minimize(
            loss,
            x0,
            method="SLSQP",
            bounds=[(0.0, 1.0)] * n_models,
            constraints={"type": "eq", "fun": lambda w: np.sum(w) - 1.0},

            lgb_stack_params,
            lgb.Dataset(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m]),

        )

            np.asarray(lgb_stack_model.predict(X_meta[val_m])).reshape(-1, 3)
        ).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred_lgb += (
            normalize_rows(
                np.asarray(lgb_stack_model.predict(X_meta_test)).reshape(-1, 3)
            ).astype(np.float32)

        )

        # MLP stacker
        mlp_stack = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            MLPClassifier(
                hidden_layer_sizes=(32, 16),
                alpha=1e-3,
                max_iter=300,
                early_stopping=True,
                n_iter_no_change=10,
                random_state=42,
            ),
        )
        mlp_stack.fit(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m])
        meta_oof_mlp[val_m] = mlp_stack.predict_proba(X_meta[val_m]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred_mlp += (
            normalize_rows(mlp_stack.predict_proba(X_meta_test)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # Convex blend optimized on meta-train fold
        wts, _ = optimize_blend(tr_m)
        blend_weights.append(wts)
        P_val = np.zeros((val_m.size, 3), dtype=np.float64)
        for m_i, name in enumerate(model_names):
            P_val += wts[m_i] * oof[name][val_m].astype(np.float64)
        blend_oof[val_m] = normalize_rows(P_val).astype(np.float32)

        P_te = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float64)
        for m_i, name in enumerate(model_names):
            P_te += wts[m_i] * test_pred[name].astype(np.float64)
        test_pred_blend += normalize_rows(P_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

    stack_logit_cv = safe_log_loss(y, meta_oof_logit)
    stack_lgb_cv = safe_log_loss(y, meta_oof_lgb)
    stack_mlp_cv = safe_log_loss(y, meta_oof_mlp)
    blend_cv = safe_log_loss(y, blend_oof)

    print(f"Logistic stacker CV log loss: {stack_logit_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"LightGBM stacker CV log loss: {stack_lgb_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"MLP stacker CV log loss: {stack_mlp_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"Convex blend CV log loss: {blend_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    candidates = [
        ("logistic_stack", stack_logit_cv, test_pred_logit),
        ("lgb_stack", stack_lgb_cv, test_pred_lgb),
        ("mlp_stack", stack_mlp_cv, test_pred_mlp),
        ("convex_blend", blend_cv, test_pred_blend),
    ]
    best_name, final_cv, final_test = min(candidates, key=lambda x: x[1])
    final_test = normalize_rows(final_test)

    print(
        f"Best meta-learner: {best_name} with CV log loss: {final_cv:.6f}", flush=True
    )

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import time
import math
from collections import Counter

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack

from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD, LatentDirichletAllocation
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

import lightgbm as lgb

try:
    from xgboost import XGBClassifier

    HAS_XGB = True
except Exception:
    HAS_XGB = False


PAD_LEFT = "^"
PAD_RIGHT = "$"


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    row_sum = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sum[row_sum == 0] = 1.0
    return P / row_sum


def safe_log_loss(y, P):
    return log_loss(y, normalize_rows(np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)))


def padded_text(text, n):
    return PAD_LEFT * (n - 1) + str(text).lower() + PAD_RIGHT * (n - 1)


def ngrams_from_padded(s, n):
    return [s[i : i + n] for i in range(len(s) - n + 1)]


def build_char_lm_counts(train_texts, y, n):
    author_texts = [[] for _ in range(3)]
    for text, label in zip(train_texts, y):
        author_texts[int(label)].append(str(text).lower())

    lm_counts = []
    for a in range(3):
        c4 = Counter()
        c3 = Counter()
        for text in author_texts[a]:
            spad = padded_text(text, n)
            c4.update(ngrams_from_padded(spad, n))
            c3.update(ngrams_from_padded(spad, n - 1))
        lm_counts.append((c4, c3))
    return lm_counts


def compute_lm_features(texts, lm_counts, vocab_size):
    smooth = 0.5
    n = 4
    out = np.zeros((len(texts), 3), dtype=np.float32)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        spad = padded_text(text, n)
        ng4 = ngrams_from_padded(spad, n)
        if len(ng4) == 0:
            continue
        denom = len(ng4)
        for a, (cnt4, cnt3) in enumerate(lm_counts):
            lp = 0.0
            for ng in ng4:
                c4 = cnt4.get(ng, 0)
                ctx = ng[:-1]
                c3 = cnt3.get(ctx, 0)
                p = (c4 + smooth) / (c3 + smooth * vocab_size)
                lp += math.log(p)
            out[i, a] = lp / denom
    return out


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

    all_text = (
        pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0)
        .reset_index(drop=True)
        .fillna("")
    )

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=140000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 6),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=140000,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=120000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=160000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_tr_word = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word, X_tr_char]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word, X_te_char]).tocsr()

    print("Building character language-model features...", flush=True)
    train_texts = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).tolist()
    test_texts = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).tolist()

    charset = set()
    for text in all_text:
        charset.update(str(text).lower())
    charset.update([PAD_LEFT, PAD_RIGHT])
    vocab_size = len(charset)

    lm_counts = build_char_lm_counts(train_texts, y, 4)

    lm_te = compute_lm_features(test_texts, lm_counts, vocab_size)

    print("Building SVD/LDA dense features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=120, n_iter=5, random_state=42)

    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

    lda = LatentDirichletAllocation(
        n_components=12,
        learning_method="batch",
        max_iter=10,
        random_state=42,
    )
    lda.fit(all_word_cnt)
    lda_tr = lda.transform(all_word_cnt[:n_train]).astype(np.float32)
    lda_te = lda.transform(all_word_cnt[n_train:]).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    X_dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, lda_tr, style_tr.values, lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
    X_dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, lda_te, style_te.values, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

    X_lm_style_tr = np.hstack([style_tr.values, lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
    X_lm_style_te = np.hstack([style_te.values, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_word_cnt, all_char_cnt

    model_names = [
        "lr_word",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_all",
        "sgd_all",
        "cal_mnb_word",
        "cal_mnb_char",
        "cal_cnb_word",
        "cal_cnb_char",
        "cal_bnb_word",

        "lgb_dense",

        model_names.append("xgb_dense")

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y)):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        # Logistic regression on word TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=5.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_word[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word[val])
        test_pred["lr_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on character TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=5.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_char[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char[val])
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on word + char TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["lr_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        # SGD logistic regression on combined TF-IDF
        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss", alpha=1e-4, max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )

        test_pred["sgd_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        # Calibrated Multinomial NB on word counts
        m = CalibratedClassifierCV(MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1), method="sigmoid", cv=3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cal_mnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["cal_mnb_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import time

from collections import Counter

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import hstack

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (

)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis

import lightgbm as lgb

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z']+|[0-9]+")


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sentences"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps_words"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )
    feats["stop_ratio"] = feats["n_stop"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_digit"] = text.str.count(r"\d")
    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


class CharLM:
    def __init__(self, texts, order=4, alpha=0.01):
        self.order = order
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.counts = Counter()
        self.contexts = Counter()

        for s in texts:
            t = " " + str(s).lower() + " "
            for i in range(len(t) - order + 1):
                gram = t[i : i + order]
                self.counts[gram] += 1
                self.contexts[gram[: order - 1]] += 1

        self.vocab_size = len(self.counts)

    def score(self, s):
        t = " " + str(s).lower() + " "
        order = self.order
        counts = self.counts
        contexts = self.contexts
        alpha = self.alpha
        vocab = self.vocab_size
        lp = 0.0
        cnt = 0
        for i in range(len(t) - order + 1):
            gram = t[i : i + order]
            num = counts.get(gram, 0) + alpha
            den = contexts.get(gram[: order - 1], 0) + alpha * vocab
            lp += math.log(num / den)
            cnt += 1
        return lp / cnt if cnt else 0.0


class WordLM:
    def __init__(self, texts, alpha=0.01):
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.unigrams = Counter()
        self.bigrams = Counter()
        self.contexts = Counter()

        for s in texts:
            toks = ["<s>"] + TOKEN_RE.findall(str(s).lower()) + ["</s>"]
            for tok in toks:
                self.unigrams[tok] += 1
            for i in range(len(toks) - 1):
                self.bigrams[(toks[i], toks[i + 1])] += 1
                self.contexts[toks[i]] += 1

        self.vocab_size = len(self.unigrams)

    def score(self, s):
        toks = ["<s>"] + TOKEN_RE.findall(str(s).lower()) + ["</s>"]
        lp = 0.0
        cnt = 0
        alpha = self.alpha
        vocab = self.vocab_size
        bigrams = self.bigrams
        contexts = self.contexts
        for i in range(len(toks) - 1):
            num = bigrams.get((toks[i], toks[i + 1]), 0) + alpha
            den = contexts.get(toks[i], 0) + alpha * vocab
            lp += math.log(num / den)
            cnt += 1
        return lp / cnt if cnt else 0.0


def build_lm_features_for_fold(train_texts, y, tr_idx, transform_texts):
    n = len(transform_texts)
    feats = np.zeros((n, 6), dtype=np.float32)

    for a in range(3):
        author_idx = [i for i in tr_idx if y[i] == a]
        author_texts = [train_texts[i] for i in author_idx]

        char_lm = CharLM(author_texts, order=4, alpha=0.01)
        word_lm = WordLM(author_texts, alpha=0.01)

        for row, s in enumerate(transform_texts):
            feats[row, a] = char_lm.score(s)
            feats[row, 3 + a] = word_lm.score(s)

    return feats


CHARS = " abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789.,;:!?'\"-$&()[]/*"
CHAR2ID = {c: i + 2 for i, c in enumerate(CHARS)}
CHAR2ID["<pad>"] = 0
CHAR2ID["<unk>"] = 1


def to_char_ids(s, max_len=200):
    ids = []
    for ch in str(s).lower():
        ids.append(CHAR2ID.get(ch, 1))
        if len(ids) >= max_len:
            break
    if len(ids) < max_len:
        ids.extend([0] * (max_len - len(ids)))
    return ids


class CharDS(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, X, y=None):
        self.X = torch.tensor(np.asarray(X, dtype=np.int64))
        self.y = None
        if y is not None:
            self.y = torch.tensor(np.asarray(y, dtype=np.int64))

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.X)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        if self.y is None:
            return self.X[idx]
        return self.X[idx], self.y[idx]


class CharCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, emb_dim=48, num_filters=48, hidden=96, dropout=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, emb_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Conv1d(emb_dim, num_filters, k) for k in [2, 3, 4, 5]]
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(num_filters * 4, hidden)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden, 3)

    def forward(self, x):
        e = self.embedding(x).transpose(1, 2)
        convs = [F.relu(conv(e)).max(dim=2).values for conv in self.convs]
        out = torch.cat(convs, dim=1)
        out = self.dropout(F.relu(self.fc1(out)))
        return self.fc2(out)


def predict_char_cnn(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            if isinstance(batch, (list, tuple)):
                x = batch[0]
            else:
                x = batch
            logits = model(x.to(device))
            probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
            preds.append(probs)
    return np.vstack(preds).astype(np.float32)


def train_char_cnn_fold(X, y, tr_idx, val_idx, X_te, device, fold):
    torch.manual_seed(2024 + fold)

    model = CharCNN(len(CHAR2ID)).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    train_ds = CharDS(X[tr_idx], y[tr_idx])
    val_ds = CharDS(X[val_idx], y[val_idx])
    test_ds = CharDS(X_te)

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=False)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=256, shuffle=False)

    best_loss = 1e9
    best_state = None
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(5):
        model.train()
        for xb, yb in train_loader:
            xb = xb.to(device)
            yb = yb.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss = criterion(model(xb), yb)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0)
            optimizer.step()

        val_probs = predict_char_cnn(model, val_loader, device)
        val_loss = log_loss(y[val_idx], normalize_rows(val_probs))

        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            patience = 0
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 2:
                break

    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    val_probs = predict_char_cnn(model, val_loader, device)
    test_probs = predict_char_cnn(model, test_loader, device)
    return val_probs, test_probs

    print("Preparing character CNN data...", flush=True)
    X_char = np.array([to_char_ids(s, 200) for s in all_text_list], dtype=np.int64)
    X_char_te = X_char[n_train:]

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Using device: {device}", flush=True)

    model_names = [
        "lr_wc_tfidf",
        "lr_word_tfidf",
        "lr_char_tfidf",
        "nb_word",
        "nb_char",
        "cnb_word",
        "bnb_word",
        "bnb_char",
        "lr_dense",
        "lda_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "char_cnn",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    train_texts = train["text"].tolist()

    for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y)):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/5", flush=True)

        y_tr = y[tr_idx]
        y_val = y[val_idx]

        # Fold-specific language-model features
        lm_full = build_lm_features_for_fold(train_texts, y, tr_idx, all_text_list)
        lm_tr = lm_full[:n_train]
        lm_te = lm_full[n_train:]

        X_dense_tr_fold = np.hstack([dense_base_tr, lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        X_dense_te_fold = np.hstack([dense_base_te, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Logistic regression on word + char TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4)
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["lr_wc_tfidf"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val_idx])
        test_pred["lr_wc_tfidf"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / 5

        # Logistic regression on word TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4)
        m.fit(X_tr_word[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word_tfidf"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word[val_idx])
        test_pred["lr_word_tfidf"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word) / 5

        # Logistic regression on character TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4)
        m.fit(X_tr_char[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char_tfidf"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char[val_idx])
        test_pred["lr_char_tfidf"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char) / 5

        # Naive Bayes variants
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.15)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["nb_word"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val_idx])
        test_pred["nb_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / 5

        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.15)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["nb_char"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val_idx])
        test_pred["nb_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / 5

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_word"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val_idx])
        test_pred["cnb_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / 5

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_word"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val_idx])
        test_pred["bnb_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / 5

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_char"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val_idx])
        test_pred["bnb_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / 5

        # Dense logistic regression
        dense_lr = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4),
                ),
            ]
        )
        dense_lr.fit(X_dense_tr_fold[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["lr_dense"][val_idx] = dense_lr.predict_proba(X_dense_tr_fold[val_idx])
        test_pred["lr_dense"] += dense_lr.predict_proba(X_dense_te_fold) / 5

        # LDA on dense features
        dense_lda = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
