def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def make_nbsvm_features(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, alpha=1.0):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    tr_parts, va_parts, te_parts = [], [], []
    n_features = X_tr.shape[1]

    for c in classes:
        mask = y_tr == c
        pos = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        neg = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha

        r = np.log(pos / (pos.sum() + alpha * n_features)) - np.log(
            neg / (neg.sum() + alpha * n_features)
        )
        r = r.astype(np.float32)

        tr_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))
        va_parts.append(X_va.multiply(r))
        te_parts.append(X_te.multiply(r))

    return hstack(tr_parts).tocsr(), hstack(va_parts).tocsr(), hstack(te_parts).tocsr()


def knn_probabilities(dist, idx, y_onehot):
    weights = (1.0 / (dist + 1e-8)).astype(np.float32)
    neighbor_labels = y_onehot[idx].astype(np.float32)
    p = np.einsum("nkc,nk->nc", neighbor_labels, weights)
    return p / weights.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def author_lm_scores(Xtr, ytr, Xnew, alpha=0.3):
    """Smoothed per-author n-gram log-likelihood scores for examples in Xnew.

    Xtr and Xnew are sparse count matrices with the same feature vocabulary.
    Author counts are estimated only from Xtr, so validation/test features do not
    leak labels.
    """
    classes = np.unique(ytr)
    logp_cols = []
    for c in classes:
        counts = (
            np.asarray(Xtr[ytr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64) + alpha
        )
        total = counts.sum()
        logp_cols.append(np.log(counts / total).astype(np.float32))
    logp_matrix = np.column_stack(logp_cols)

    scores = Xnew.dot(logp_matrix)
    if hasattr(scores, "toarray"):
        scores = scores.toarray()
    scores = np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float32).reshape(Xnew.shape[0], len(classes))

    lengths = np.asarray(Xnew.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    scores = scores / np.maximum(lengths[:, None], 1)
    return scores.astype(np.float32)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    splits = list(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y))

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)
    all_text = pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0).fillna("")

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=80000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=80000,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=100000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=150000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_tr_word_tf = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_tf = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_tf = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_tf = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_word_cnt, all_char_cnt

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word_tf, X_tr_char_tf]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word_tf, X_te_char_tf]).tocsr()

    print("Building SVD features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_tr = svd.fit_transform(X_tr_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    X_dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, style_tr.values]).astype(np.float32)
    X_dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, style_te.values]).astype(np.float32)

    base_names = [
        "lr_all",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_word",
        "lr_svd",
        "sgd_all",
        "mnb_w",
        "mnb_c",
        "cnb_w",
        "cnb_c",
        "bnb_w",
        "bnb_c",
        "nbsvm_w",
        "lgb_svd",
        "mlp_svd",
        "knn_svd",
        "lda_svd",
        "knn_tfidf5",
        "knn_tfidf30",
        "lr_centroid",
        "lr_lm",
        "lr_dl",
        "lgb_dl",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(splits):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        # Logistic regression on word + char TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["lr_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on char TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_char_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_tf[val])
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_tf) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on word TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_word_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_tf[val])
        test_pred["lr_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_tf) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on SVD + stylometric features
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_svd"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val])
        test_pred["lr_svd"] += m.predict_proba(X_dense_te) / n_splits

        # SGD logistic regression on combined TF-IDF
        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss", alpha=1e-4, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["sgd_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["sgd_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        # Multinomial NB / Complement NB / Bernoulli NB variants
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["mnb_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.15)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_c"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["mnb_c"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["cnb_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_c"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["cnb_c"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["bnb_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_c"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["bnb_c"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        # NBSVM-style logistic regression on word counts
        X_tr_nb, X_val_nb, X_te_nb = make_nbsvm_features(
            X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, X_tr_word_cnt[val], X_te_word_cnt
        )
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_nb, y_tr)
        oof["nbsvm_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_val_nb)
        test_pred["nbsvm_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_nb) / n_splits

        # LightGBM on dense features
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[val], y_val)
        params = {
            "objective": "multiclass",
            "num_class": 3,
            "metric": "multi_logloss",
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "feature_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_freq": 1,
            "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
            "lambda_l2": 1.0,
            "verbosity": -1,
            "seed": 42,
            "num_threads": 4,
        }
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_svd"][val] = (
            np.asarray(model.predict(X_dense_tr[val])).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        )
        test_pred["lgb_svd"] += (
            np.asarray(model.predict(X_dense_te)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # MLP on dense features
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "mlp",
                    MLPClassifier(
                        hidden_layer_sizes=(128, 64),
                        activation="relu",
                        alpha=1e-3,
                        batch_size=256,
                        learning_rate_init=1e-3,
                        max_iter=400,
                        early_stopping=True,
                        n_iter_no_change=10,
                        random_state=42,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mlp_svd"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val])
        test_pred["mlp_svd"] += m.predict_proba(X_dense_te) / n_splits

        # KNN on dense features
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "knn",
                    KNeighborsClassifier(
                        n_neighbors=25, weights="distance", p=2, n_jobs=4
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["knn_svd"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val])
        test_pred["knn_svd"] += m.predict_proba(X_dense_te) / n_splits

        # LDA on dense features
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                ("lda", LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto")),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lda_svd"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val])
        test_pred["lda_svd"] += m.predict_proba(X_dense_te) / n_splits

        # KNN on TF-IDF
        nn = NearestNeighbors(
            n_neighbors=30, metric="cosine", algorithm="brute", n_jobs=4
        )
        nn.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr])
        dist_val, idx_val = nn.kneighbors(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        dist_te, idx_te = nn.kneighbors(X_te_tfidf)

        y_tr_onehot = np.zeros((len(y_tr), 3), dtype=np.float32)
        y_tr_onehot[np.arange(len(y_tr)), y_tr] = 1.0

        for k, knn_name in [(5, "knn_tfidf5"), (30, "knn_tfidf30")]:
            p_val = knn_probabilities(dist_val[:, :k], idx_val[:, :k], y_tr_onehot)
            p_te = knn_probabilities(dist_te[:, :k], idx_te[:, :k], y_tr_onehot)
            oof[knn_name][val] = p_val.astype(np.float32)
            test_pred[knn_name] += p_te.astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        # Class-centroid cosine similarity features
        Xtr_norm = normalize(X_tr_tfidf[tr], norm="l2", axis=1)
        Xval_norm = normalize(X_tr_tfidf[val], norm="l2", axis=1)
        Xte_norm = normalize(X_te_tfidf, norm="l2", axis=1)

        sums = []
        counts = []
        for c in range(3):
            mask = y_tr == c
            sums.append(
                np.asarray(Xtr_norm[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float32)
            )
            counts.append(int(mask.sum()))

        sims_tr = np.zeros((len(y_tr), 3), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(3):
            proj = np.asarray(Xtr_norm @ sums[c]).ravel().astype(np.float32)
            mask = y_tr == c
            sims_tr[mask, c] = (proj[mask] - 1.0) / max(counts[c] - 1, 1)
            sims_tr[~mask, c] = proj[~mask] / max(counts[c], 1)

        row_norms = np.asarray(Xtr_norm.multiply(Xtr_norm).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        zero_rows = row_norms < 1e-8
        if zero_rows.any():
            sims_tr[zero_rows, :] = 0.0

        sims_val = np.zeros((Xval_norm.shape[0], 3), dtype=np.float32)
        sims_te = np.zeros((Xte_norm.shape[0], 3), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(3):
            sims_val[:, c] = np.asarray(Xval_norm @ sums[c]).ravel() / counts[c]
            sims_te[:, c] = np.asarray(Xte_norm @ sums[c]).ravel() / counts[c]

        lr_cent = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        lr_cent.fit(sims_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_centroid"][val] = lr_cent.predict_proba(sims_val).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_centroid"] += (
            lr_cent.predict_proba(sims_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # --- New fold-safe LM features ---
        word_tr = X_tr_word_cnt[tr]
        word_val = X_tr_word_cnt[val]
        word_te = X_te_word_cnt

        char_tr = X_tr_char_cnt[tr]
        char_val = X_tr_char_cnt[val]
        char_te = X_te_char_cnt

        lm_tr = np.hstack(
            [
                author_lm_scores(word_tr, y_tr, word_tr),
                author_lm_scores(char_tr, y_tr, char_tr),
            ]
        ).astype(np.float32)
        lm_val = np.hstack(
            [
                author_lm_scores(word_tr, y_tr, word_val),
                author_lm_scores(char_tr, y_tr, char_val),
            ]
        ).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te = np.hstack(
            [
                author_lm_scores(word_tr, y_tr, word_te),
                author_lm_scores(char_tr, y_tr, char_te),
            ]
        ).astype(np.float32)

        # Logistic regression on LM likelihood features only
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm"][val] = m.predict_proba(lm_val).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_lm"] += m.predict_proba(lm_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        # Dense features + LM features
        X_dl_tr = np.hstack([X_dense_tr[tr], lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        X_dl_val = np.hstack([X_dense_tr[val], lm_val]).astype(np.float32)
        X_dl_te = np.hstack([X_dense_te, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Logistic regression on dense + LM
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dl_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_dl"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dl_val).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_dl"] += m.predict_proba(X_dl_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        # LightGBM on dense + LM
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dl_tr, y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dl_val, y_val)
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_dl"][val] = (
            np.asarray(model.predict(X_dl_val)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        )
        test_pred["lgb_dl"] += (
            np.asarray(model.predict(X_dl_te)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

    simple_avg_pred = np.mean([oof[n] for n in base_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
    simple_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(simple_avg_pred))
    print(f"Base model simple average CV log loss: {simple_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Build meta features: raw probabilities + log probabilities + entropy
    raw_meta = np.hstack([oof[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = oof[name]
        entropy_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta = np.column_stack(entropy_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta = np.hstack([raw_meta, log_meta, entropy_meta]).astype(np.float32)

    raw_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta_test = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_test_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = test_pred[name]
        entropy_test_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta_test = np.column_stack(entropy_test_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([raw_meta_test, log_meta_test, entropy_meta_test]).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    print("Stacking with logistic regression...", flush=True)

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors

import lightgbm as lgb


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )
    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def make_nbsvm_features(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, alpha=1.0):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    tr_parts, va_parts, te_parts = [], [], []
    n_features = X_tr.shape[1]

    for c in classes:
        mask = y_tr == c
        pos = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        neg = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha

        r = np.log(pos / (pos.sum() + alpha * n_features)) - np.log(
            neg / (neg.sum() + alpha * n_features)
        )
        r = r.astype(np.float32)

        tr_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))
        va_parts.append(X_va.multiply(r))
        te_parts.append(X_te.multiply(r))

    return hstack(tr_parts).tocsr(), hstack(va_parts).tocsr(), hstack(te_parts).tocsr()


def build_lm_features(C_tr, y_tr, C_va, C_te, alpha=1.0):
    """Per-author smoothed n-gram log-likelihood features.

    Uses only the training-fold counts to build each author LM.
    For training rows, the row's own count is removed from its true
    author's LM by an exact leave-one-out correction.
    """
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    n_features = C_tr.shape[1]

    tr_sum = np.asarray(C_tr.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    va_sum = np.asarray(C_va.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    te_sum = np.asarray(C_te.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

    tr_feats = np.zeros((C_tr.shape[0], len(classes)), dtype=np.float32)
    va_feats = np.zeros((C_va.shape[0], len(classes)), dtype=np.float32)
    te_feats = np.zeros((C_te.shape[0], len(classes)), dtype=np.float32)

    for i, c in enumerate(classes):
        mask = y_tr == c

        raw_sum = np.asarray(C_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
        T = raw_sum + alpha
        total_T = raw_sum.sum() + alpha * n_features
        logp = np.log(T / total_T).astype(np.float32)

        # Validation and test features are always scored by a model fit only
        # on the current training fold.
        va_feats[:, i] = (
            np.asarray(C_va @ logp).ravel() / np.maximum(va_sum, 1)
        ).astype(np.float32)
        te_feats[:, i] = (
            np.asarray(C_te @ logp).ravel() / np.maximum(te_sum, 1)
        ).astype(np.float32)

        # Training features: use leave-one-out for the row's own author class.
        base = np.asarray(C_tr @ logp).ravel()

        # Exact correction for own-class rows:
        # log(T - row_count) = log(T) + log(1 - row_count / T)
        C_own = C_tr[mask].copy()
        Tj = T[C_own.indices]
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            C_own.data = C_own.data * np.log(1.0 - C_own.data / Tj)
        corr = np.asarray(C_own.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

        total_loo = total_T - tr_sum[mask]
        avg_loo = (
            base[mask] / np.maximum(tr_sum[mask], 1)
            + corr / np.maximum(tr_sum[mask], 1)
            - np.log(np.maximum(total_loo, 1e-12))
        )
        tr_feats[mask, i] = avg_loo.astype(np.float32)

        # For other classes, this row was never included in their counts.
        tr_feats[~mask, i] = (base[~mask] / np.maximum(tr_sum[~mask], 1)).astype(
            np.float32
        )

    return tr_feats, va_feats, te_feats


def knn_probabilities(dist, idx, y_onehot):
    weights = (1.0 / (dist + 1e-8)).astype(np.float32)
    neighbor_labels = y_onehot[idx].astype(np.float32)
    p = np.einsum("nkc,nk->nc", neighbor_labels, weights)
    return p / weights.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    splits = list(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y))

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)
    all_text = pd.concat(
        [train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0, ignore_index=True
    ).fillna("")

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=80000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=80000,
    )

    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=80000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=80000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_tr_word_tf = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_tf = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_tf = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_tf = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_word_cnt, all_char_cnt

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word_tf, X_tr_char_tf]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word_tf, X_te_char_tf]).tocsr()

    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_tr = svd.fit_transform(X_tr_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    base_names = [
        "lr_all",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_word",
        "sgd_all",
        "mnb_w",
        "cnb_c",
        "bnb_w",
        "nbsvm_w",
        "lr_lm",
        "lr_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "knn_tfidf",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(splits):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        # --- Sparse TF-IDF / count base models ---
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["lr_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_char_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_tf[val])
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_tf) / n_splits

        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_word_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_tf[val])
        test_pred["lr_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_tf) / n_splits

        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss", alpha=1e-4, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["sgd_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["sgd_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["mnb_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_c"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["cnb_c"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["bnb_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        X_tr_nb, X_val_nb, X_te_nb = make_nbsvm_features(
            X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, X_tr_word_cnt[val], X_te_word_cnt
        )
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_nb, y_tr)
        oof["nbsvm_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_val_nb)
        test_pred["nbsvm_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_nb) / n_splits

        # --- Fold-safe author LM features + dense models ---
        lm_word_tr, lm_word_va, lm_word_te = build_lm_features(
            X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, X_tr_word_cnt[val], X_te_word_cnt, alpha=1.0
        )
        lm_char_tr, lm_char_va, lm_char_te = build_lm_features(
            X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr, X_tr_char_cnt[val], X_te_char_cnt, alpha=0.7
        )

        lm_tr = np.hstack([lm_word_tr, lm_char_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_va = np.hstack([lm_word_va, lm_char_va]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te = np.hstack([lm_word_te, lm_char_te]).astype(np.float32)

        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm"][val] = m.predict_proba(lm_va).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_lm"] += m.predict_proba(lm_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr[tr], style_tr.values[tr], lm_tr]).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        dense_va = np.hstack([svd_tr[val], style_tr.values[val], lm_va]).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, style_te.values, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(dense_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(dense_va).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_dense"] += m.predict_proba(dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        dtr = lgb.Dataset(dense_tr, y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(dense_va, y_val)
        params = {
            "objective": "multiclass",
            "num_class": 3,
            "metric": "multi_logloss",
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "feature_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_freq": 1,
            "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
            "lambda_l2": 1.0,
            "verbosity": -1,
            "seed": 42,
            "num_threads": 4,
        }
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_dense"][val] = (
            np.asarray(model.predict(dense_va)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        )
        test_pred["lgb_dense"] += (
            np.asarray(model.predict(dense_te)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # --- TF-IDF nearest-neighbor probabilities ---
        nn = NearestNeighbors(
            n_neighbors=20, metric="cosine", algorithm="brute", n_jobs=4
        )
        nn.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr])
        dist_val, idx_val = nn.kneighbors(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        dist_te, idx_te = nn.kneighbors(X_te_tfidf)

        y_tr_onehot = np.zeros((len(y_tr), 3), dtype=np.float32)
        y_tr_onehot[np.arange(len(y_tr)), y_tr] = 1.0

        p_val = knn_probabilities(dist_val, idx_val, y_tr_onehot)
        p_te = knn_probabilities(dist_te, idx_te, y_tr_onehot)
        oof["knn_tfidf"][val] = p_val.astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["knn_tfidf"] += p_te.astype(np.float32) / n_splits

    # Print base-model CV scores
    print("\nBase model 5-fold CV log losses:", flush=True)
    for name in base_names:
        score = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(oof[name]))
        print(f"  {name}: {score:.6f}", flush=True)

    simple_avg_pred = np.mean([oof[n] for n in base_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
    simple_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(simple_avg_pred))
    print(f"Base model simple average CV log loss: {simple_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # --- Stacking meta-features ---
    raw_meta = np.hstack([oof[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = oof[name]
        entropy_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta = np.column_stack(entropy_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta = np.hstack([raw_meta, log_meta, entropy_meta]).astype(np.float32)

    raw_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta_test = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_test_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = test_pred[name]
        entropy_test_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta_test = np.column_stack(entropy_test_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([raw_meta_test, log_meta_test, entropy_meta_test]).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    print("Stacking with logistic regression...", flush=True)
    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    meta_pipe = Pipeline(
        [
            ("sc", StandardScaler()),
            (
                "lr",
                LogisticRegression(
                    C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    meta_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    for tr, val in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y):
        meta_pipe.fit(X_meta[tr], y[tr])
        meta_oof[val] = meta_pipe.predict_proba(X_meta[val])

    stack_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(meta_oof))
    print(f"5-Fold CV log loss (stacked): {stack_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Fit final stacker and predict test
    meta_pipe.fit(X_meta, y)
    final_test = normalize_rows(meta_pipe.predict_proba(X_meta_test).astype(np.float32))

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    s = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    s[s == 0] = 1.0
    return P / s


def as_proba(p):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float32)
    if p.ndim == 1:
        p = p.reshape(-1, 3)
    return normalize_rows(p)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    words = text.str.split()
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = words.str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = words.apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_long_words"] = words.apply(lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if len(w) > 6))
    feats["n_stop"] = words.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def author_logp_matrix(X_tr_counts, y_tr, alpha=0.5):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    V = X_tr_counts.shape[1]
    logp = np.zeros((len(classes), V), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, c in enumerate(classes):
        counts = (
            np.asarray(X_tr_counts[y_tr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
            + alpha
        )
        logp[i] = np.log(counts / counts.sum())
    return logp


def compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_counts, y_tr, alpha=0.5):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    class_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    V = X_tr_counts.shape[1]
    n = X_tr_counts.shape[0]

    counts_by_class = []
    for c in classes:
        counts_by_class.append(
            np.asarray(X_tr_counts[y_tr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        )

    logp_all = np.zeros((len(classes), V), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, c in enumerate(classes):
        denom = counts_by_class[j].sum() + alpha * V
        logp_all[j] = np.log((counts_by_class[j] + alpha) / denom)

    scores = np.asarray(X_tr_counts @ logp_all.T, dtype=np.float64).copy()

    for i in range(n):
        row = X_tr_counts[i]
        if row.nnz == 0:
            continue
        ci = class_to_idx[y_tr[i]]
        indices = row.indices
        data = row.data.astype(np.float64)
        row_total = data.sum()

        adjusted = counts_by_class[ci][indices] - data
        denom_adj = counts_by_class[ci].sum() - row_total + alpha * V
        scores[i, ci] = np.dot(data, np.log((adjusted + alpha) / denom_adj))

    return scores.astype(np.float32)


def build_lm_block(scores, row_sums, n_chars):
    eps = 1e-8
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scores,
            scores / np.maximum(row_sums[:, None], eps),
            scores / np.maximum(n_chars[:, None], eps),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)


def make_nbsvm_features(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, alpha=1.0):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    tr_parts, va_parts, te_parts = [], [], []
    n_features = X_tr.shape[1]

    for c in classes:
        mask = y_tr == c
        pos = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        neg = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha

        r = np.log(pos / (pos.sum() + alpha * n_features)) - np.log(
            neg / (neg.sum() + alpha * n_features)
        )
        r = r.astype(np.float32)

        tr_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))
        va_parts.append(X_va.multiply(r))
        te_parts.append(X_te.multiply(r))

    return hstack(tr_parts).tocsr(), hstack(va_parts).tocsr(), hstack(te_parts).tocsr()


def knn_probabilities(dist, idx, y_onehot):
    weights = (1.0 / (dist + 1e-8)).astype(np.float32)
    neighbor_labels = y_onehot[idx].astype(np.float32)
    p = np.einsum("nkc,nk->nc", neighbor_labels, weights)
    return p / weights.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values.astype(int)

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    splits = list(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y))

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)
    all_text = pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0).fillna("")

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=80000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=80000,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=100000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=150000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_tr_word_tf = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_tf = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_tf = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_tf = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_word_cnt, all_char_cnt

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word_tf, X_tr_char_tf]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word_tf, X_te_char_tf]).tocsr()

    print("Building SVD/NMF features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_tr = svd.fit_transform(X_tr_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

    nmf = NMF(n_components=64, init="nndsvda", random_state=42, max_iter=300)
    nmf_tr = nmf.fit_transform(X_tr_word_tf).astype(np.float32)
    nmf_te = nmf.transform(X_te_word_tf).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    X_dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, nmf_tr, style_tr.values]).astype(np.float32)
    X_dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, nmf_te, style_te.values]).astype(np.float32)

    base_names = [
        "lr_all",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_word",
        "sgd_all",
        "mnb_w",
        "mnb_c",
        "cnb_w",
        "cnb_c",
        "bnb_w",
        "bnb_c",
        "nbsvm_w",
        "lr_svd",
        "lgb_svd",
        "lr_lm",
        "lr_lm_dense",
        "lgb_lm_dense",
        "mlp_lm_dense",
        "knn_lm_dense",
        "lda_lm_dense",
        "extra_lm_dense",
        "knn_tfidf5",
        "knn_tfidf30",
        "lr_centroid",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}

    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": 3,
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "num_threads": 4,
    }

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(splits):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        # Fold-safe language-model scores
        logp_word = author_logp_matrix(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_tr_word = compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_val_word = np.asarray(X_tr_word_cnt[val] @ logp_word.T, dtype=np.float32)
        scores_te_word = np.asarray(X_te_word_cnt @ logp_word.T, dtype=np.float32)

        row_sums_tr_word = np.asarray(X_tr_word_cnt[tr].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_val_word = np.asarray(X_tr_word_cnt[val].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_te_word = np.asarray(X_te_word_cnt.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

        lm_tr_word = build_lm_block(
            scores_tr_word, row_sums_tr_word, style_tr["n_chars"].values[tr]
        )
        lm_val_word = build_lm_block(
            scores_val_word, row_sums_val_word, style_tr["n_chars"].values[val]
        )
        lm_te_word = build_lm_block(
            scores_te_word, row_sums_te_word, style_te["n_chars"].values
        )

        logp_char = author_logp_matrix(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_tr_char = compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_val_char = np.asarray(X_tr_char_cnt[val] @ logp_char.T, dtype=np.float32)
        scores_te_char = np.asarray(X_te_char_cnt @ logp_char.T, dtype=np.float32)

        row_sums_tr_char = np.asarray(X_tr_char_cnt[tr].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_val_char = np.asarray(X_tr_char_cnt[val].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_te_char = np.asarray(X_te_char_cnt.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

        lm_tr_char = build_lm_block(
            scores_tr_char, row_sums_tr_char, style_tr["n_chars"].values[tr]
        )
        lm_val_char = build_lm_block(
            scores_val_char, row_sums_val_char, style_tr["n_chars"].values[val]
        )
        lm_te_char = build_lm_block(
            scores_te_char, row_sums_te_char, style_te["n_chars"].values
        )

        lm_tr = np.hstack([lm_tr_word, lm_tr_char]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_val = np.hstack([lm_val_word, lm_val_char]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te = np.hstack([lm_te_word, lm_te_char]).astype(np.float32)

        X_dense_lm_tr = np.hstack([X_dense_tr[tr], lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        X_dense_lm_val = np.hstack([X_dense_tr[val], lm_val]).astype(np.float32)
        X_dense_lm_te = np.hstack([X_dense_te, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Logistic regression on word + character TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val]))
        test_pred["lr_all"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf)) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on character TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_char_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_tf[val]))
        test_pred["lr_char"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_tf)) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on word TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_word_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_tf[val]))
        test_pred["lr_word"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_word_tf)) / n_splits

        # SGD logistic regression
        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss", alpha=1e-4, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["sgd_all"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val]))
        test_pred["sgd_all"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf)) / n_splits

        # Naive Bayes variants
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_w"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["mnb_w"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.15)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_c"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["mnb_c"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_w"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["cnb_w"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_c"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["cnb_c"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_w"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["bnb_w"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_c"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["bnb_c"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt)) / n_splits

        # NBSVM-style word count model
        X_tr_nb, X_val_nb, X_te_nb = make_nbsvm_features(
            X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, X_tr_word_cnt[val], X_te_word_cnt
        )
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_nb, y_tr)
        oof["nbsvm_w"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_val_nb))
        test_pred["nbsvm_w"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_nb)) / n_splits

        # Dense LR without LM
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_svd"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]))
        test_pred["lr_svd"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense LightGBM without LM
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[val], y_val)
        model = lgb.train(
            lgb_params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_svd"][val] = as_proba(model.predict(X_dense_tr[val]))
        test_pred["lgb_svd"] += as_proba(model.predict(X_dense_te)) / n_splits

        # LM-only LR
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(lm_val))
        test_pred["lr_lm"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM LR
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["lr_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM LightGBM
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_lm_val, y_val)
        model = lgb.train(
            lgb_params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(model.predict(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["lgb_lm_dense"] += as_proba(model.predict(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM MLP
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "mlp",
                    MLPClassifier(
                        hidden_layer_sizes=(128, 64),
                        activation="relu",
                        alpha=1e-3,
                        batch_size=256,
                        learning_rate_init=1e-3,
                        max_iter=400,
                        early_stopping=True,
                        n_iter_no_change=10,
                        random_state=42,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["mlp_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["mlp_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM KNN
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "knn",
                    KNeighborsClassifier(
                        n_neighbors=25, weights="distance", p=2, n_jobs=4
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["knn_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["knn_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM LDA
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                ("lda", LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto")),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lda_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["lda_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM Extra Trees
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "et",
                    ExtraTreesClassifier(
                        n_estimators=300,
                        max_features=0.3,
                        min_samples_leaf=5,
                        n_jobs=4,
                        random_state=42,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["extra_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["extra_lm_dense"] += (
            as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits
        )

        # TF-IDF nearest-neighbor probabilities

        )
        nn.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr])
        dist_val, idx_val = nn.kneighbors(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        dist_te, idx_te = nn.kneighbors(X_te_tfidf)

        y_tr_onehot = np.zeros((len(y_tr), 3), dtype=np.float32)
        y_tr_onehot[np.arange(len(y_tr)), y_tr] = 1.0

        for k, knn_name in [(5, "knn_tfidf5"), (30, "knn_tfidf30")]:
            p_val = knn_probabilities(dist_val[:, :k], idx_val[:, :k], y_tr_onehot)
            p_te = knn_probabilities(dist_te[:, :k], idx_te[:, :k], y_tr_onehot)
            oof[knn_name][val] = as_proba(p_val)
            test_pred[knn_name] += as_proba(p_te) / n_splits

        # Fold-safe class-centroid cosine similarity features
        Xtr_norm = normalize(X_tr_tfidf[tr], norm="l2", axis=1)
        Xval_norm = normalize(X_tr_tfidf[val], norm="l2", axis=1)
        Xte_norm = normalize(X_te_tfidf, norm="l2", axis=1)

        sums = []
        counts = []
        for c in range(3):
            mask = y_tr == c
            sums.append(
                np.asarray(Xtr_norm[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float32)
            )
            counts.append(int(mask.sum()))

        sims_tr = np.zeros((len(y_tr), 3), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(3):
            proj = np.asarray(Xtr_norm @ sums[c]).ravel().astype(np.float32)
            mask = y_tr == c
            sims_tr[mask, c] = (proj[mask] - 1.0) / max(counts[c] - 1, 1)
            sims_tr[~mask, c] = proj[~mask] / max(counts[c], 1)

        row_norms = np.asarray(Xtr_norm.multiply(Xtr_norm).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        zero_rows = row_norms < 1e-8
        if zero_rows.any():
            sims_tr[zero_rows, :] = 0.0

        sims_val = np.zeros((Xval_norm.shape[0], 3), dtype=np.float32)
        sims_te = np.zeros((Xte_norm.shape[0], 3), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(3):
            sims_val[:, c] = np.asarray(Xval_norm @ sums[c]).ravel() / counts[c]
            sims_te[:, c] = np.asarray(Xte_norm @ sums[c]).ravel() / counts[c]

        lr_cent = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(

    simple_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(simple_avg_pred))
    print(f"Base model simple average CV log loss: {simple_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Build meta features: raw probabilities + log probabilities + entropy
    raw_meta = np.hstack([oof[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = oof[name]
        entropy_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta = np.column_stack(entropy_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta = np.hstack([raw_meta, log_meta, entropy_meta]).astype(np.float32)

    raw_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta_test = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_test_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = test_pred[name]
        entropy_test_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta_test = np.column_stack(entropy_test_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([raw_meta_test, log_meta_test, entropy_meta_test]).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    print("Stacking with logistic regression...", flush=True)
    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    meta_pipe = Pipeline(
        [
            ("sc", StandardScaler()),
            (
                "lr",
                LogisticRegression(
                    C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    meta_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    for tr, val in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y):
        meta_pipe.fit(X_meta[tr], y[tr])
        meta_oof[val] = meta_pipe.predict_proba(X_meta[val])

    stack_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(meta_oof))
    print(f"5-Fold CV log loss (stacked): {stack_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    meta_pipe.fit(X_meta, y)
    final_test = normalize_rows(meta_pipe.predict_proba(X_meta_test).astype(np.float32))

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)

    main()

import time
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack, coo_matrix, spdiags

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD, NMF, LatentDirichletAllocation
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier, NearestNeighbors
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesClassifier
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    s = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    s[s == 0] = 1.0
    return P / s


def safe_log_loss(y, P):
    return log_loss(y, normalize_rows(np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)))


def build_style_features(texts):
    s = pd.Series(texts)
    stops = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    n_words = s.str.split().str.len().fillna(0).astype(np.float64)
    n_unique = (
        s.str.lower()
        .str.split()
        .apply(lambda x: len(set(x)) if x else 0)
        .astype(np.float64)
    )
    n_chars = s.str.len().astype(np.float64)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=range(len(s)))
    feats["n_chars"] = n_chars
    feats["n_words"] = n_words
    feats["n_unique"] = n_unique
    feats["avg_word_len"] = n_chars / n_words.replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = n_unique / n_words.replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = s.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = s.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = s.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / n_chars.replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = s.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = s.str.count('"') + s.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = s.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = s.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = s.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = s.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = s.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = s.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = s.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stops)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).values.astype(np.float32)


def fold_lm_features(fit_texts, fit_y, score_texts, max_features=100000):
    """Fold-safe author word/char n-gram likelihood + coverage features."""
    feature_list = []

    for kind in ("word", "char"):
        if kind == "word":
            cv = CountVectorizer(
                ngram_range=(1, 2),
                min_df=2,
                lowercase=True,
                token_pattern=r"\w+",
                max_features=max_features,
            )
        else:
            cv = CountVectorizer(
                analyzer="char_wb",
                ngram_range=(2, 5),
                min_df=3,
                lowercase=True,
                max_features=max_features,
            )

        X_fit = cv.fit_transform(fit_texts)
        X_score = cv.transform(score_texts)

        counts = np.zeros((3, X_fit.shape[1]))
        for i in range(3):
            counts[i] = np.asarray(X_fit[fit_y == i].sum(axis=0)).ravel()

        alpha = 0.1
        total = counts.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True) + alpha * X_fit.shape[1]
        probs = (counts + alpha) / total

        log_lik = X_score @ np.log(probs).T
        lengths = np.asarray(X_score.sum(axis=1)).ravel() + 1.0
        avg_log_lik = log_lik / lengths[:, None]

        binary = X_score.copy()
        binary.data[:] = 1.0
        vocab_present = (counts > 0).astype(np.float64)
        coverage = binary @ vocab_present.T
        denom = np.asarray(binary.sum(axis=1)).ravel() + 1e-6
        coverage = coverage / denom[:, None]

        feature_list.append(avg_log_lik)
        feature_list.append(coverage)

    return np.hstack(feature_list).astype(np.float32)


def build_label_prop_graph(X_low, n_neighbors=8):
    n = X_low.shape[0]
    nn = NearestNeighbors(
        n_neighbors=n_neighbors + 1,
        metric="cosine",
        algorithm="brute",
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    nn.fit(X_low)
    dists, indices = nn.kneighbors(X_low)

    rows = np.repeat(np.arange(n), indices.shape[1])
    cols = indices.ravel()
    sim = np.clip(1.0 - dists.ravel(), 0.0, 1.0)

    A = coo_matrix((sim, (rows, cols)), shape=(n, n)).tocsr()
    A = A.maximum(A.T)

    d = np.asarray(A.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    d_inv = 1.0 / np.maximum(d, 1e-8)
    D_inv = spdiags(d_inv, 0, n, n)
    S = D_inv @ A
    return S.tocsr()


def run_label_prop_fold(S, n_train, y, tr, val, alpha=0.9, iters=30):
    n_all = S.shape[0]
    Y0 = np.zeros((n_all, 3))
    Y0[tr, y[tr]] = 1.0

    F = Y0.copy()
    for _ in range(iters):
        F = alpha * (S @ F) + (1.0 - alpha) * Y0
        F[tr] = Y0[tr]

    val_prob = normalize_rows(F[val]).astype(np.float32)
    test_prob = normalize_rows(F[n_train:]).astype(np.float32)
    return val_prob, test_prob


def build_meta(P):
    P = np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float32)
    logP = np.log(np.clip(P, 1e-12, 1.0))
    ent = -np.sum(P * logP, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return np.hstack([P, logP, ent]).astype(np.float32)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    np.random.seed(42)

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")

    train_text = train["text"].fillna("").astype(str).values
    test_text = test["text"].fillna("").astype(str).values
    all_text = np.concatenate([train_text, test_text])

    n_train = len(train_text)
    n_test = len(test_text)

    print("Fitting vectorizers...", flush=True)
    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(

    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(

    X_all_tfidf = hstack([X_all_word_tf, X_all_char_tf]).tocsr()

        test_pred["knn_dense"] += m.predict_proba(dense_te).astype(np.float32) / 5.0

    print("\nBase model 5-fold CV log losses:", flush=True)
    for name in model_names:

        for C in Cs:
            scores = []
            for itr, iva in inner_skf.split(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m]):
                lr_tmp = LogisticRegression(
                    C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4
                )
                lr_tmp.fit(X_meta[tr_m][itr], y[tr_m][itr])
                scores.append(
                    log_loss(
                        y[tr_m][iva],
                        normalize_rows(lr_tmp.predict_proba(X_meta[tr_m][iva])),
                    )
                )
            mean_score = np.mean(scores)
            if mean_score < best_score:
                best_score = mean_score
                best_C = C

        lr_stack = LogisticRegression(C=best_C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4)
        lr_stack.fit(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m])
        meta_oof[val_m] = lr_stack.predict_proba(X_meta[val_m])
        test_pred_stack += (
            normalize_rows(lr_stack.predict_proba(X_meta_test)).astype(np.float32) / 5.0
        )

    stack_cv = safe_log_loss(y, meta_oof)
    print(f"Stacked CV log loss: {stack_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    avg_test_pred = np.mean([test_pred[name] for name in model_names], axis=0).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    if stack_cv <= avg_cv:
        final_test = normalize_rows(test_pred_stack)
        final_cv = stack_cv
    else:
        final_test = normalize_rows(avg_test_pred)
        final_cv = avg_cv

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Final 5-fold CV log loss: {final_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
