import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD, NMF
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesClassifier
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV

import lightgbm as lgb


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def make_nbsvm_features(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, alpha=1.0):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    tr_parts, va_parts, te_parts = [], [], []
    n_features = X_tr.shape[1]

    for c in classes:
        mask = y_tr == c
        pos = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        neg = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha

        r = np.log(pos / (pos.sum() + alpha * n_features)) - np.log(
            neg / (neg.sum() + alpha * n_features)
        )
        r = r.astype(np.float32)

        tr_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))
        va_parts.append(X_va.multiply(r))
        te_parts.append(X_te.multiply(r))

    return hstack(tr_parts).tocsr(), hstack(va_parts).tocsr(), hstack(te_parts).tocsr()


def compute_lm_scores(X_count, train_idx, y_tr, row_idx, alpha=0.3):
    """Fold-safe average log-likelihood under each author's n-gram LM."""
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    n_authors = len(classes)
    V = X_count.shape[1]

    log_p = np.zeros((n_authors, V), dtype=np.float64)
    for k, c in enumerate(classes):
        rows = train_idx[y_tr == c]
        cnt = np.asarray(X_count[rows].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        s = cnt.sum()
        log_p[k] = np.log(cnt) - np.log(s)

    scores = X_count[row_idx].dot(log_p.T)
    lengths = np.asarray(X_count[row_idx].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    lengths[lengths == 0] = 1.0
    return (scores / lengths[:, None]).astype(np.float32)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    splits = list(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y))

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)
    all_text = pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0).fillna("")

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=80000,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=80000,
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=100000,
        dtype=np.int32,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=150000,
        dtype=np.int32,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    all_tfidf = hstack([all_word_tf, all_char_tf]).tocsr()

    X_tr_word_tf = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_tf = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_tf = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_tf = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_tfidf = all_tfidf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = all_tfidf[n_train:].tocsr()

    print("Building SVD features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_all = svd.fit_transform(all_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    svd_tr = svd_all[:n_train]
    svd_te = svd_all[n_train:]
    del svd_all

    print("Building NMF topic features...", flush=True)
    nmf_model = NMF(n_components=60, init="nndsvda", max_iter=150, random_state=42)
    nmf_all = nmf_model.fit_transform(all_word_tf).astype(np.float32)
    nmf_tr = nmf_all[:n_train]
    nmf_te = nmf_all[n_train:]
    del nmf_all, all_word_tf, all_char_tf

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)
    style_tr_values = style_tr.values.astype(np.float32)
    style_te_values = style_te.values.astype(np.float32)

    base_names = [
        "lr_all",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_word",
        "lr_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "mlp_dense",
        "lda_dense",
        "et_dense",
        "lr_nmf",
        "lr_lm",
        "sgd_all",
        "mnb_w",
        "mnb_c",
        "cnb_w",
        "cnb_c",
        "bnb_w",
        "bnb_c",
        "nbsvm_w",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}

    test_idx = np.arange(n_train, n_train + n_test)

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(splits):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        # Fold-safe language-model features.
        lm_word_tr = compute_lm_scores(all_word_cnt, tr, y_tr, tr, alpha=0.3)
        lm_word_val = compute_lm_scores(all_word_cnt, tr, y_tr, val, alpha=0.3)
        lm_word_te = compute_lm_scores(all_word_cnt, tr, y_tr, test_idx, alpha=0.3)

        lm_char_tr = compute_lm_scores(all_char_cnt, tr, y_tr, tr, alpha=0.3)
        lm_char_val = compute_lm_scores(all_char_cnt, tr, y_tr, val, alpha=0.3)
        lm_char_te = compute_lm_scores(all_char_cnt, tr, y_tr, test_idx, alpha=0.3)

        dense_tr_fold = np.hstack(
            [svd_tr[tr], nmf_tr[tr], style_tr_values[tr], lm_word_tr, lm_char_tr]
        ).astype(np.float32)
        dense_val_fold = np.hstack(
            [svd_tr[val], nmf_tr[val], style_tr_values[val], lm_word_val, lm_char_val]
        ).astype(np.float32)
        dense_te_fold = np.hstack(
            [svd_te, nmf_te, style_te_values, lm_word_te, lm_char_te]
        ).astype(np.float32)

        lm_dense_tr = np.hstack([lm_word_tr, lm_char_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_dense_val = np.hstack([lm_word_val, lm_char_val]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_dense_te = np.hstack([lm_word_te, lm_char_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Logistic regression on word + char TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1200, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["lr_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on char TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1200, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_char_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_tf[val])
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_tf) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on word TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1200, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_word_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_tf[val])
        test_pred["lr_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_tf) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on dense features
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(dense_tr_fold, y_tr)
        oof["lr_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(dense_val_fold)
        test_pred["lr_dense"] += m.predict_proba(dense_te_fold) / n_splits

        # LightGBM on dense features
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(dense_tr_fold, label=y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(dense_val_fold, label=y_val)
        params = {
            "objective": "multiclass",
            "num_class": 3,
            "metric": "multi_logloss",
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "feature_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_freq": 1,
            "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
            "lambda_l2": 1.0,
            "verbosity": -1,
            "seed": 42,
            "num_threads": 4,
        }
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1200,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_dense"][val] = (
            np.asarray(model.predict(dense_val_fold)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        )
        test_pred["lgb_dense"] += (
            np.asarray(model.predict(dense_te_fold)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # MLP on dense features
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "mlp",
                    MLPClassifier(
                        hidden_layer_sizes=(128, 64),
                        activation="relu",
                        alpha=1e-3,
                        batch_size=256,
                        learning_rate_init=1e-3,
                        max_iter=300,
                        early_stopping=True,
                        n_iter_no_change=10,
                        random_state=42,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(dense_tr_fold, y_tr)
        oof["mlp_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(dense_val_fold)
        test_pred["mlp_dense"] += m.predict_proba(dense_te_fold) / n_splits

        # LDA on dense features
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                ("lda", LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto")),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(dense_tr_fold, y_tr)
        oof["lda_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(dense_val_fold)
        test_pred["lda_dense"] += m.predict_proba(dense_te_fold) / n_splits

        # Extra Trees on dense features
        m = ExtraTreesClassifier(
            n_estimators=250,
            min_samples_leaf=5,
            max_features=0.3,
            n_jobs=4,
            random_state=42,
        )
        m.fit(dense_tr_fold, y_tr)
        oof["et_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(dense_val_fold)
        test_pred["et_dense"] += m.predict_proba(dense_te_fold) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on NMF topics
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(nmf_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_nmf"][val] = m.predict_proba(nmf_tr[val])
        test_pred["lr_nmf"] += m.predict_proba(nmf_te) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on LM likelihood features
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(lm_dense_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm"][val] = m.predict_proba(lm_dense_val)
        test_pred["lr_lm"] += m.predict_proba(lm_dense_te) / n_splits

        # SGD logistic regression on combined TF-IDF
        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss", alpha=1e-4, max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["sgd_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["sgd_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / n_splits

        # Naive Bayes variants
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["mnb_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.15)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_c"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["mnb_c"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["cnb_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_c"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["cnb_c"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val])
        test_pred["bnb_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt) / n_splits

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_c"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val])
        test_pred["bnb_c"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt) / n_splits

        # NBSVM-style features
        X_tr_nb, X_val_nb, X_te_nb = make_nbsvm_features(
            X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, X_tr_word_cnt[val], X_te_word_cnt
        )
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_nb, y_tr)
        oof["nbsvm_w"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_val_nb)
        test_pred["nbsvm_w"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_nb) / n_splits

    simple_avg_pred = np.mean([oof[n] for n in base_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
    simple_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(simple_avg_pred))
    print(f"Base model simple average CV log loss: {simple_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Build rich meta-features.
    raw_meta = np.hstack([oof[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_parts = []
    pair_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = oof[name]
        entropy = -np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1)
        entropy_parts.append(entropy)
        pair_parts.append(
            np.column_stack([p[:, 0] - p[:, 1], p[:, 0] - p[:, 2], p[:, 1] - p[:, 2]])
        )
    entropy_meta = np.column_stack(entropy_parts).astype(np.float32)
    pair_meta = np.hstack(pair_parts).astype(np.float32)
    X_meta = np.hstack([raw_meta, log_meta, entropy_meta, pair_meta]).astype(np.float32)

    raw_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta_test = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_test_parts = []
    pair_test_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = test_pred[name]
        entropy = -np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1)
        entropy_test_parts.append(entropy)
        pair_test_parts.append(
            np.column_stack([p[:, 0] - p[:, 1], p[:, 0] - p[:, 2], p[:, 1] - p[:, 2]])
        )
    entropy_meta_test = np.column_stack(entropy_test_parts).astype(np.float32)
    pair_meta_test = np.hstack(pair_test_parts).astype(np.float32)
    X_meta_test = np.hstack(
        [raw_meta_test, log_meta_test, entropy_meta_test, pair_meta_test]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    print("Training multi-stacker meta-model with nested 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)

    stack_oof = {
        "cal_lr": np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32),
        "lgb": np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32),
        "mlp": np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32),
    }

    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": 3,
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.02,
        "num_leaves": 7,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 50,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l2": 2.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "num_threads": 4,
    }

    for tr, val in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y):
        # Calibrated logistic regression stacker
        cal_lr = CalibratedClassifierCV(
            estimator=Pipeline(
                [
                    ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                    (
                        "lr",
                        LogisticRegression(
                            C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, random_state=42
                        ),
                    ),
                ]
            ),
            method="sigmoid",
            cv=3,
        )
        cal_lr.fit(X_meta[tr], y[tr])
        stack_oof["cal_lr"][val] = cal_lr.predict_proba(X_meta[val])

        # LightGBM stacker
        dmeta_tr = lgb.Dataset(X_meta[tr], label=y[tr])
        lgb_stack = lgb.train(lgb_params, dmeta_tr, num_boost_round=200)
        stack_oof["lgb"][val] = (
            np.asarray(lgb_stack.predict(X_meta[val])).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        )

        # MLP stacker
        mlp_stack = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "mlp",
                    MLPClassifier(
                        hidden_layer_sizes=(64, 32),
                        activation="relu",
                        alpha=0.01,
                        max_iter=300,
                        early_stopping=True,
                        n_iter_no_change=10,
                        random_state=42,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        mlp_stack.fit(X_meta[tr], y[tr])
        stack_oof["mlp"][val] = mlp_stack.predict_proba(X_meta[val])

    cal_lr_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(stack_oof["cal_lr"]))
    lgb_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(stack_oof["lgb"]))
    mlp_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(stack_oof["mlp"]))

    print(f"  Calibrated LR stacker CV log loss: {cal_lr_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"  LightGBM stacker CV log loss: {lgb_cv:.6f}", flush=True)
    print(f"  MLP stacker CV log loss: {mlp_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    avg_stack_oof = (stack_oof["cal_lr"] + stack_oof["lgb"] + stack_oof["mlp"]) / 3.0
    ensemble_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(avg_stack_oof))
    print(f"Multi-stacker ensemble CV log loss: {ensemble_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Fit stackers on all meta-data and predict test.
    cal_lr_final = CalibratedClassifierCV(
        estimator=Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        ),
        method="sigmoid",
        cv=3,
    )
    cal_lr_final.fit(X_meta, y)
    test_cal_lr = normalize_rows(cal_lr_final.predict_proba(X_meta_test))

    dmeta_full = lgb.Dataset(X_meta, label=y)
    lgb_final = lgb.train(lgb_params, dmeta_full, num_boost_round=200)
    test_lgb = normalize_rows(
        np.asarray(lgb_final.predict(X_meta_test)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
    )

    mlp_final = Pipeline(
        [
            ("sc", StandardScaler()),
            (
                "mlp",
                MLPClassifier(
                    hidden_layer_sizes=(64, 32),
                    activation="relu",
                    alpha=0.01,
                    max_iter=300,
                    early_stopping=True,
                    n_iter_no_change=10,
                    random_state=42,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )
    mlp_final.fit(X_meta, y)
    test_mlp = normalize_rows(mlp_final.predict_proba(X_meta_test))

    final_probs = normalize_rows((test_cal_lr + test_lgb + test_mlp) / 3.0)

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_probs[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

import time

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

import lightgbm as lgb
from xgboost import XGBClassifier


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    row_sum = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sum[row_sum == 0] = 1.0
    return P / row_sum


def safe_log_loss(y, P):
    return log_loss(y, normalize_rows(np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)))


def word_shape_preprocessor(text):
    return "".join(
        "A" if ch.isupper() else "a" if ch.islower() else " " if ch.isspace() else ch
        for ch in text
    )


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    words = text.str.split()
    feats["n_words"] = words.str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = words.apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_short_words"] = text.str.findall(r"\b\w{1,3}\b").str.len()
    feats["n_long_words"] = text.str.findall(r"\b\w{7,}\b").str.len()
    feats["n_stop"] = words.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def build_lm_features_fold(C, train_idx, val_idx, test_idx, y, alpha=0.5):
    classes = np.unique(y)
    n_classes = len(classes)
    V = C.shape[1]

    counts = []
    totals = []
    logP = np.zeros((n_classes, V), dtype=np.float64)

    for a in range(n_classes):
        idx = train_idx[y[train_idx] == a]
        if len(idx) == 0:
            counts.append(np.zeros(V, dtype=np.float64))
            totals.append(0.0)
            logP[a] = np.log(alpha / (alpha * V))
            continue
        cnt = np.asarray(C[idx].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        counts.append(cnt)
        total = cnt.sum()
        totals.append(total)
        smoothed = cnt + alpha
        logP[a] = np.log(smoothed / (total + alpha * V))

    train_rows = C[train_idx]
    full_scores = train_rows.dot(logP.T)
    row_sums = np.asarray(train_rows.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

    n_tr = len(train_idx)
    train_feats = np.zeros((n_tr, n_classes * 2), dtype=np.float64)

    for a in range(n_classes):
        train_feats[:, a * 2] = full_scores[:, a]
        train_feats[:, a * 2 + 1] = np.divide(
            full_scores[:, a],
            row_sums,
            out=np.zeros(n_tr),
            where=row_sums != 0,
        )

    for j, row_idx in enumerate(train_idx):
        a = int(y[row_idx])
        r = C[row_idx]
        vals = r.data.astype(np.float64)
        inds = r.indices
        row_sum = vals.sum()

        if row_sum == 0:
            continue

        cnt_a = counts[a]
        total_a = totals[a]

        num_diff = 0.0
        for val, w in zip(vals, inds):
            cnt_w = cnt_a[w]
            num_diff += val * (np.log(cnt_w - val + alpha) - np.log(cnt_w + alpha))

        denom_diff = row_sum * (
            np.log(total_a + alpha * V) - np.log(total_a - row_sum + alpha * V)
        )
        loo = full_scores[j, a] + num_diff - denom_diff
        train_feats[j, a * 2] = loo
        train_feats[j, a * 2 + 1] = loo / row_sum

    def score_features(idx):
        rows = C[idx]
        scores = rows.dot(logP.T)
        sums = np.asarray(rows.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        n = len(idx)
        feats = np.zeros((n, n_classes * 2), dtype=np.float64)
        for a in range(n_classes):
            feats[:, a * 2] = scores[:, a]
            feats[:, a * 2 + 1] = np.divide(
                scores[:, a],
                sums,
                out=np.zeros(n),
                where=sums != 0,
            )
        return feats

    val_feats = score_features(val_idx)
    test_feats = score_features(test_idx)
    return train_feats, val_feats, test_feats


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    np.random.seed(42)

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

    print("Building vectorizers and features...", flush=True)
    all_text = (
        pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0)
        .reset_index(drop=True)
        .fillna("")
        .astype(str)
    )

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        max_features=120000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=140000,
    )
    hasher = HashingVectorizer(
        n_features=2**20,
        alternate_sign=False,
        norm="l2",
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
    )
    tf_shape = TfidfVectorizer(
        lowercase=False,
        preprocessor=word_shape_preprocessor,
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=100000,
    )
    cnt_nb_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        max_features=80000,
    )
    cnt_nb_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        max_features=100000,
    )
    lm_word_vec = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 1),
        min_df=2,
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        max_features=50000,
    )
    lm_char_vec = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=80000,
    )

    X_word = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    X_char = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    X_all_tf = hstack([X_word, X_char]).tocsr()
    X_hash = hasher.transform(all_text)
    X_shape = tf_shape.fit_transform(all_text)
    X_cnt_word = cnt_nb_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    X_cnt_char = cnt_nb_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    C_word_lm = lm_word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    C_char_lm = lm_char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    print("Fitting SVD / NMF / LDA / style features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    X_svd = svd.fit_transform(X_all_tf).astype(np.float32)

    nmf = NMF(n_components=20, init="random", max_iter=100, random_state=42)
    X_nmf = nmf.fit_transform(X_word).astype(np.float32)

    lda = LatentDirichletAllocation(
        n_components=15,
        learning_method="batch",
        max_iter=8,
        random_state=42,
    )
    X_lda = lda.fit_transform(C_word_lm).astype(np.float32)

    style_all = np.vstack(
        [
            build_style_features(train).values,
            build_style_features(test).values,
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    global_dense_all = np.hstack([X_svd, X_nmf, X_lda, style_all]).astype(np.float32)

    model_names = [
        "lr_word",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_all",
        "sgd_hash",
        "lr_shape",
        "lr_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "xgb_dense",
        "et_dense",
        "mlp_dense",
        "mnb_word",
        "cnb_char",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}

    test_idx = np.arange(n_train, n_train + n_test)

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y)):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        lm_word_tr, lm_word_val, lm_word_te = build_lm_features_fold(
            C_word_lm, tr, val, test_idx, y, alpha=0.5
        )
        lm_char_tr, lm_char_val, lm_char_te = build_lm_features_fold(
            C_char_lm, tr, val, test_idx, y, alpha=0.5
        )

        lm_tr = np.hstack([lm_word_tr, lm_char_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_val = np.hstack([lm_word_val, lm_char_val]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te = np.hstack([lm_word_te, lm_char_te]).astype(np.float32)

        X_dense_tr = np.hstack([global_dense_all[tr], lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        X_dense_val = np.hstack([global_dense_all[val], lm_val]).astype(np.float32)
        X_dense_te = np.hstack([global_dense_all[n_train:], lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        X_tr_word = X_word[tr]
        X_val_word = X_word[val]
        X_te_word = X_word[n_train:]

        X_tr_char = X_char[tr]
        X_val_char = X_char[val]
        X_te_char = X_char[n_train:]

        X_tr_all = X_all_tf[tr]
        X_val_all = X_all_tf[val]
        X_te_all = X_all_tf[n_train:]

        X_tr_hash = X_hash[tr]
        X_val_hash = X_hash[val]
        X_te_hash = X_hash[n_train:]

        X_tr_shape = X_shape[tr]
        X_val_shape = X_shape[val]
        X_te_shape = X_shape[n_train:]

        X_tr_cnt_word = X_cnt_word[tr]
        X_val_cnt_word = X_cnt_word[val]
        X_te_cnt_word = X_cnt_word[n_train:]

        X_tr_cnt_char = X_cnt_char[tr]
        X_val_cnt_char = X_cnt_char[val]
        X_te_cnt_char = X_cnt_char[n_train:]

        # Word TF-IDF logistic regression
        m = LogisticRegression(C=5.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, random_state=42)
        m.fit(X_tr_word, y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_val_word)).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        test_pred["lr_word"] += (
            normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_te_word)).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Character TF-IDF logistic regression
        m = LogisticRegression(C=5.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, random_state=42)
        m.fit(X_tr_char, y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_val_char)).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        test_pred["lr_char"] += (
            normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_te_char)).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Combined word+char TF-IDF logistic regression
        m = LogisticRegression(C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, random_state=42)
        m.fit(X_tr_all, y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_val_all)).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        test_pred["lr_all"] += (
            normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_te_all)).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Hashing vectorizer + SGD logistic loss
        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss",
            alpha=1e-5,
            max_iter=1000,
            tol=1e-4,
            random_state=42,
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_hash, y_tr)
        oof["sgd_hash"][val] = normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_val_hash)).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        test_pred["sgd_hash"] += (
            normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_te_hash)).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Word-shape character TF-IDF logistic regression
        m = LogisticRegression(C=5.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, random_state=42)
        m.fit(X_tr_shape, y_tr)
        oof["lr_shape"][val] = normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_val_shape)).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        test_pred["lr_shape"] += (
            normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_te_shape)).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Dense logistic regression
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, random_state=42),
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_dense"][val] = normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_dense_val)).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        test_pred["lr_dense"] += (
            normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_dense_te)).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # LightGBM on dense features
        params = {
            "objective": "multiclass",
            "num_class": 3,
            "metric": "multi_logloss",
            "learning_rate": 0.04,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "max_depth": 4,
            "feature_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_freq": 1,
            "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
            "lambda_l2": 1.0,
            "verbosity": -1,
            "seed": 42,
            "num_threads": 4,
        }
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr, y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_val, y_val)
        lgb_m = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1200,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_dense"][val] = normalize_rows(
            np.asarray(
                lgb_m.predict(X_dense_val, num_iteration=lgb_m.best_iteration)
            ).reshape(-1, 3)
        ).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lgb_dense"] += (
            normalize_rows(
                np.asarray(
                    lgb_m.predict(X_dense_te, num_iteration=lgb_m.best_iteration)
                ).reshape(-1, 3)
            ).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # XGBoost on dense features
        xgb_m = XGBClassifier(
            n_estimators=800,
            max_depth=4,
            learning_rate=0.05,
            subsample=0.8,
            colsample_bytree=0.8,
            objective="multi:softprob",
            num_class=3,
            eval_metric="mlogloss",
            tree_method="hist",
            n_jobs=4,
            random_state=42,
            early_stopping_rounds=40,
        )
        xgb_m.fit(X_dense_tr, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_dense_val, y_val)], verbose=False)
        oof["xgb_dense"][val] = normalize_rows(xgb_m.predict_proba(X_dense_val)).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        test_pred["xgb_dense"] += (
            normalize_rows(xgb_m.predict_proba(X_dense_te)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # ExtraTrees on dense features
        et_m = ExtraTreesClassifier(
            n_estimators=250,
            min_samples_leaf=2,
            max_features="sqrt",
            n_jobs=-1,
            random_state=42,
        )
        et_m.fit(X_dense_tr, y_tr)
        oof["et_dense"][val] = normalize_rows(et_m.predict_proba(X_dense_val)).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        test_pred["et_dense"] += (
            normalize_rows(et_m.predict_proba(X_dense_te)).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # MLP on scaled dense features
        mlp_m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            MLPClassifier(
                hidden_layer_sizes=(96, 32),
                alpha=1e-3,
                max_iter=150,
                early_stopping=True,
                n_iter_no_change=10,
                random_state=42,
            ),
        )
        mlp_m.fit(X_dense_tr, y_tr)
        oof["mlp_dense"][val] = normalize_rows(mlp_m.predict_proba(X_dense_val)).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        test_pred["mlp_dense"] += (
            normalize_rows(mlp_m.predict_proba(X_dense_te)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # Calibrated MultinomialNB on word counts
        mnb_m = CalibratedClassifierCV(MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1), method="sigmoid", cv=3)
        mnb_m.fit(X_tr_cnt_word, y_tr)
        oof["mnb_word"][val] = normalize_rows(
            mnb_m.predict_proba(X_val_cnt_word)
        ).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["mnb_word"] += (
            normalize_rows(mnb_m.predict_proba(X_te_cnt_word)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # Calibrated ComplementNB on character counts
        cnb_m = CalibratedClassifierCV(ComplementNB(alpha=0.3), method="sigmoid", cv=3)
        cnb_m.fit(X_tr_cnt_char, y_tr)
        oof["cnb_char"][val] = normalize_rows(
            cnb_m.predict_proba(X_val_cnt_char)
        ).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["cnb_char"] += (
            normalize_rows(cnb_m.predict_proba(X_te_cnt_char)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

    print("\nBase model CV log losses:", flush=True)
    for name in model_names:
        cv = safe_log_loss(y, oof[name])
        print(f"  {name}: {cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    avg_oof = np.mean([oof[name] for name in model_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
    avg_cv = safe_log_loss(y, avg_oof)
    print(f"Simple average CV log loss: {avg_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Stacking features from all base models
    X_meta = np.hstack([oof[name] for name in model_names]).astype(np.float32)
    X_meta_log = np.log(np.clip(X_meta, 1e-12, 1.0))
    X_meta_entropy = -np.sum(X_meta * X_meta_log, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    X_meta = np.hstack([X_meta, X_meta_log, X_meta_entropy]).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[name] for name in model_names]).astype(
        np.float32
    )
    X_meta_test_log = np.log(np.clip(X_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0))
    X_meta_test_entropy = -np.sum(X_meta_test * X_meta_test_log, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    X_meta_test = np.hstack([X_meta_test, X_meta_test_log, X_meta_test_entropy]).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    # Select regularizer for logistic stacker using inner 3-fold CV
    Cs = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0]
    inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=7)
    best_C = Cs[1]
    best_score = 1e9
    for C in Cs:
        scores = []
        for itr, iva in inner_skf.split(X_meta, y):
            m = LogisticRegression(C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
            m.fit(X_meta[itr], y[itr])
            scores.append(
                log_loss(y[iva], normalize_rows(m.predict_proba(X_meta[iva])))
            )
        mean_score = np.mean(scores)
        if mean_score < best_score:
            best_score = mean_score
            best_C = C

    print(f"Selected stacker C: {best_C}", flush=True)

    # Nested 5-fold logistic stacking
    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=2024)
    meta_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    meta_test = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32)

    for tr_m, val_m in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y):
        stack_m = LogisticRegression(C=best_C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        stack_m.fit(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m])
        meta_oof[val_m] = normalize_rows(stack_m.predict_proba(X_meta[val_m])).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        meta_test += (
            normalize_rows(stack_m.predict_proba(X_meta_test)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

    stack_cv = safe_log_loss(y, meta_oof)
    print(f"Stacked CV log loss: {stack_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    final_test = normalize_rows(meta_test).astype(np.float64)

    sub = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"].values})
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b").astype(np.float32)
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]").astype(np.float32)
    feats["upper_ratio"] = (feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)).astype(
        np.float32
    )
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]").astype(np.float32)
    feats["n_quotes"] = (text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")).astype(np.float32)
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!").astype(np.float32)
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?").astype(np.float32)

    X_te_char = X_char_all[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_rev = X_rev_all[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_rev = X_rev_all[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_te_word_cnt = X_word_cnt_all[n_train:].tocsr()

    svd_comb_all = svd_comb.fit_transform(X_comb_svd_all).astype(np.float32)

    svd_rev_all = svd_rev.fit_transform(X_rev_all).astype(np.float32)

    svd_comb_tr = svd_comb_all[:n_train]
    svd_comb_te = svd_comb_all[n_train:]
    svd_rev_tr = svd_rev_all[:n_train]
    svd_rev_te = svd_rev_all[n_train:]

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

        np.float32

        "lr_char",
        "lr_revchar",
        "lr_comb",
        "mnb_word",
        "cnb_word",
        "lr_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "rbf_lr",

    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}

    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y)):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        m = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_word).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on forwards character TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-3)
        m.fit(X_tr_char[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on reversed character TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-3)
        m.fit(X_tr_rev[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_revchar"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_rev[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_revchar"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_te_rev).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Logistic regression on word + forwards char + reversed char
        m = LogisticRegression(C=1.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-3)
        m.fit(X_tr_comb[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_comb"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_comb[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_comb"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_comb).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        # Multinomial Naive Bayes on word counts
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["mnb_word"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Complement Naive Bayes on word counts
        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["cnb_word"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Logistic regression on dense SVD + stylometric features
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4),
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_dense"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # LightGBM on dense features
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[val], y_val)
        params = {
            "objective": "multiclass",
            "num_class": 3,
            "metric": "multi_logloss",
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,

            "bagging_freq": 1,

            "seed": 42,
            "num_threads": 4,

        oof["lgb_dense"][val] = (
            np.asarray(lgb_model.predict(X_dense_tr[val]))
            .reshape(-1, 3)
            .astype(np.float32)
        )
        test_pred["lgb_dense"] += (
            np.asarray(lgb_model.predict(X_dense_te)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # Random-Fourier RBF approximation + logistic regression
        rbf_model = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            RBFSampler(gamma=0.3, n_components=256, random_state=42),
            LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4),
        )
        rbf_model.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["rbf_lr"][val] = rbf_model.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["rbf_lr"] += (
            rbf_model.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

    print("\nBase model CV log losses:", flush=True)
    for name in model_names:
        cv = safe_log_loss(y, oof[name])
        print(f"  {name}: {cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    avg_oof = np.mean([oof[name] for name in model_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
    avg_cv = safe_log_loss(y, avg_oof)
    print(f"Simple average CV log loss: {avg_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Stacking meta-features: raw probabilities, log probabilities, entropy
    X_meta = np.hstack([oof[name] for name in model_names]).astype(np.float32)
    X_meta = np.hstack(
        [
            X_meta,
            np.log(np.clip(X_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            -np.sum(
                X_meta * np.log(np.clip(X_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)),
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True,
            ),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[name] for name in model_names]).astype(
        np.float32
    )
    X_meta_test = np.hstack(
        [
            X_meta_test,
            np.log(np.clip(X_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            -np.sum(
                X_meta_test * np.log(np.clip(X_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)),
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True,
            ),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    Cs = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0]

    stack_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    test_pred_stack = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32)

    print("Fitting logistic meta-model with nested 5-fold CV...", flush=True)

    for tr_m, val_m in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y):
        inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=7)
        best_C = Cs[0]
        best_score = 1e9

        for C in Cs:
            scores = []
            for itr, iva in inner_skf.split(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m]):
                lr_tmp = LogisticRegression(
                    C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4
                )
                lr_tmp.fit(X_meta[tr_m][itr], y[tr_m][itr])
                proba = normalize_rows(lr_tmp.predict_proba(X_meta[tr_m][iva]))
                scores.append(log_loss(y[tr_m][iva], proba))
            mean_score = np.mean(scores)
            if mean_score < best_score:
                best_score = mean_score
                best_C = C

        lr_stack = LogisticRegression(C=best_C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4)
        lr_stack.fit(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m])
        stack_oof[val_m] = lr_stack.predict_proba(X_meta[val_m]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred_stack += (
            normalize_rows(lr_stack.predict_proba(X_meta_test)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

    stack_cv = safe_log_loss(y, stack_oof)
    print(f"Logistic stacker CV log loss: {stack_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    final_test = normalize_rows(test_pred_stack)

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i].astype(np.float64)

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import time
import re

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.sparse import hstack

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, SGDClassifier
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.ensemble import ExtraTreesClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

import lightgbm as lgb


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    row_sum = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_sum[row_sum == 0] = 1.0
    return P / row_sum


def safe_log_loss(y, P):
    return log_loss(y, normalize_rows(np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)))


def count_syllables(text):
    vowels = set("aeiouy")
    total = 0
    for word in re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z]+", text):
        word = word.lower()
        count = 0
        prev_vowel = False
        for ch in word:
            if ch in vowels:
                if not prev_vowel:
                    count += 1
                prev_vowel = True
            else:
                prev_vowel = False
        if word.endswith("e") and count > 1:
            count -= 1
        total += max(1, count)
    return total


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    f = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    f["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    f["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    f["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    f["avg_word_len"] = f["n_chars"] / f["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    f["frac_unique"] = f["n_unique"] / f["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    f["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    f["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    f["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    f["upper_ratio"] = f["n_upper"] / f["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    f["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    f["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    f["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    f["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    f["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    f["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    f["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    f["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    f["stop_ratio"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words) / max(len(x), 1)
    )

    syll = text.apply(count_syllables)
    f["syll_per_word"] = syll / f["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    f["syll_per_sent"] = syll / f["n_sent"]
    f["flesch"] = (
        206.835 - 1.015 * (f["n_words"] / f["n_sent"]) - 84.6 * f["syll_per_word"]
    )
    f["ari"] = (
        4.71 * (f["n_chars"] / f["n_words"].replace(0, 1))
        + 0.5 * (f["n_words"] / f["n_sent"])
        - 21.43
    )
    f["long_word_ratio"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if len(w) > 6) / max(len(x), 1)
    )
    return f.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def pair_coupling(p01, p02, p12):
    eps = 1e-6
    p01 = np.clip(p01, eps, 1 - eps)
    p02 = np.clip(p02, eps, 1 - eps)
    p12 = np.clip(p12, eps, 1 - eps)

    a = np.log(p01 / (1 - p01))
    b = np.log(p02 / (1 - p02))
    c = np.log(p12 / (1 - p12))

    # Least-squares solution for class log-odds, up to an additive constant.
    l0 = np.zeros_like(a)
    l1 = (c - 2 * a - b) / 3.0
    l2 = (-a - 2 * b - c) / 3.0

    logits = np.column_stack([l0, l1, l2]).astype(np.float64)
    logits -= logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    exp = np.exp(logits)
    return (exp / exp.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)).astype(np.float32)


def pairwise_predict(X_tr, y_tr, X_val, X_test, C=4.0):
    pairs = [(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2)]
    p01 = np.zeros(X_val.shape[0], dtype=np.float64)
    p02 = np.zeros(X_val.shape[0], dtype=np.float64)
    p12 = np.zeros(X_val.shape[0], dtype=np.float64)

    p01_t = np.zeros(X_test.shape[0], dtype=np.float64)
    p02_t = np.zeros(X_test.shape[0], dtype=np.float64)
    p12_t = np.zeros(X_test.shape[0], dtype=np.float64)

    for a, b in pairs:
        mask = np.isin(y_tr, [a, b])
        yb = (y_tr[mask] == a).astype(np.int32)
        lr = LogisticRegression(C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4)
        lr.fit(X_tr[mask], yb)

        pv = lr.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
        pt = lr.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

        if a == 0 and b == 1:
            p01, p01_t = pv, pt
        elif a == 0 and b == 2:
            p02, p02_t = pv, pt
        else:
            p12, p12_t = pv, pt

    return pair_coupling(p01, p02, p12), pair_coupling(p01_t, p02_t, p12_t)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    np.random.seed(42)

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

    all_text = (
        pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0)
        .reset_index(drop=True)
        .fillna("")
    )

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=120000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 6),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=120000,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=100000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=100000,
    )

    X_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    X_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    X_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    X_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_word_tr = X_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_word_te = X_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()
    X_char_tr = X_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_char_te = X_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()
    X_word_cnt_tr = X_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_word_cnt_te = X_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()
    X_char_cnt_tr = X_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_char_cnt_te = X_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_all_tf = hstack([X_word_tf, X_char_tf]).tocsr()
    X_all_tr_tf = X_all_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_all_te_tf = X_all_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    print("Building SVD and style features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_all = svd.fit_transform(X_all_tf)
    svd_tr = svd_all[:n_train].astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd_all[n_train:].astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    print("Building word/char language-model count matrices...", flush=True)
    lm_word_vec = CountVectorizer(
        token_pattern=r"[a-z']+", lowercase=True, max_features=100000
    )
    lm_char_vec = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(4, 4), lowercase=True, max_features=100000
    )
    word_lm_mat = lm_word_vec.fit_transform(all_text)
    char_lm_mat = lm_char_vec.fit_transform(all_text)

    word_row_sum = np.asarray(word_lm_mat.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    char_row_sum = np.asarray(char_lm_mat.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

    global_word_counts = np.asarray(word_lm_mat.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    global_word_total = global_word_counts.sum()
    global_char_counts = np.asarray(char_lm_mat.sum(axis=0)).ravel()
    global_char_total = global_char_counts.sum()

    V_word = word_lm_mat.shape[1]
    V_char = char_lm_mat.shape[1]

    y_full = np.concatenate([y, -np.ones(n_test, dtype=int)])

    ALPHA = 0.3
    BETA = 0.1

    def make_logp(counts, total, global_counts, global_total, V):
        p_mle = (counts + ALPHA) / (total + ALPHA * V)
        p_global = (global_counts + ALPHA) / (global_total + ALPHA * V)
        p = (1 - BETA) * p_mle + BETA * p_global
        return np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-15, 1.0))

    def loo_score(row, author_counts, author_total, global_counts, global_total, V):
        idx = row.indices
        cnt = row.data
        if idx.size == 0:
            return 0.0
        total_loo = max(author_total - cnt.sum(), 1.0)
        counts_loo = author_counts[idx] - cnt
        p_mle = (counts_loo + ALPHA) / (total_loo + ALPHA * V)
        p_global = (global_counts[idx] + ALPHA) / (global_total + ALPHA * V)
        p = (1 - BETA) * p_mle + BETA * p_global
        return float(np.dot(cnt, np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-15, 1.0))))

    def compute_lm_features(
        indices,
        logp_word,
        author_word_counts,
        author_word_totals,
        logp_char,
        author_char_counts,
        author_char_totals,
        need_loo,
    ):
        indices = np.asarray(indices)
        Ws = word_lm_mat[indices]
        Cs = char_lm_mat[indices]
        rows_w = word_row_sum[indices]
        rows_c = char_row_sum[indices]

        F = np.zeros((len(indices), 12), dtype=np.float32)

        for a in range(3):
            ws = Ws.dot(logp_word[a])
            cs = Cs.dot(logp_char[a])
            F[:, a * 4 + 0] = ws
            F[:, a * 4 + 1] = ws / np.maximum(rows_w, 1)
            F[:, a * 4 + 2] = cs
            F[:, a * 4 + 3] = cs / np.maximum(rows_c, 1)

        if need_loo:
            for pos, gi in enumerate(indices):
                a = y_full[gi]
                if a < 0:
                    continue
                row_w = word_lm_mat[gi]
                row_c = char_lm_mat[gi]

                ws_loo = loo_score(
                    row_w,
                    author_word_counts[a],
                    author_word_totals[a],
                    global_word_counts,
                    global_word_total,
                    V_word,
                )
                cs_loo = loo_score(
                    row_c,
                    author_char_counts[a],
                    author_char_totals[a],
                    global_char_counts,
                    global_char_total,
                    V_char,
                )
                F[pos, a * 4 + 0] = ws_loo
                F[pos, a * 4 + 1] = ws_loo / max(rows_w[pos], 1)
                F[pos, a * 4 + 2] = cs_loo
                F[pos, a * 4 + 3] = cs_loo / max(rows_c[pos], 1)

        return F

    model_names = [
        "lr_word",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_all",
        "sgd_all",
        "mnb_word",
        "cnb_word",
        "bnb_word",
        "mnb_cal",
        "cnb_cal",
        "lr_pairs",
        "lr_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "et_dense",
        "lr_lm",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in model_names}

    te_idx = np.arange(n_train, n_train + n_test)

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)

    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y)):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        author_word_counts = []
        author_char_counts = []
        author_word_totals = []
        author_char_totals = []

        for a in range(3):
            idx_a = tr[y[tr] == a]
            wc = np.asarray(word_lm_mat[idx_a].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
            cc = np.asarray(char_lm_mat[idx_a].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
            author_word_counts.append(wc)
            author_char_counts.append(cc)
            author_word_totals.append(wc.sum())
            author_char_totals.append(cc.sum())

        logp_word = [
            make_logp(
                author_word_counts[a],
                author_word_totals[a],
                global_word_counts,
                global_word_total,
                V_word,
            )
            for a in range(3)
        ]
        logp_char = [
            make_logp(
                author_char_counts[a],
                author_char_totals[a],
                global_char_counts,
                global_char_total,
                V_char,
            )
            for a in range(3)
        ]

        lm_tr = compute_lm_features(
            tr,
            logp_word,
            author_word_counts,
            author_word_totals,
            logp_char,
            author_char_counts,
            author_char_totals,
            True,
        )
        lm_val = compute_lm_features(
            val,
            logp_word,
            author_word_counts,
            author_word_totals,
            logp_char,
            author_char_counts,
            author_char_totals,
            False,
        )
        lm_te = compute_lm_features(
            te_idx,
            logp_word,
            author_word_counts,
            author_word_totals,
            logp_char,
            author_char_counts,
            author_char_totals,
            False,
        )

        X_dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr[tr], style_tr.values[tr], lm_tr]).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        X_dense_val = np.hstack([svd_tr[val], style_tr.values[val], lm_val]).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        X_dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, style_te.values, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Word TF-IDF logistic regression
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=5.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_word_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_word_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_word"] += m.predict_proba(X_word_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        # Character TF-IDF logistic regression
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=5.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_char_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_char_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_char_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

        # Combined word + char TF-IDF logistic regression
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_all_tr_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_all_tr_tf[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_all"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_all_te_tf).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # SGD logistic regression on combined TF-IDF
        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss", alpha=1e-4, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_all_tr_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["sgd_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_all_tr_tf[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["sgd_all"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_all_te_tf).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Naive Bayes variants
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1)
        m.fit(X_word_cnt_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["mnb_word"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_word_cnt_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["cnb_word"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_word_cnt_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_word"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["bnb_word"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Calibrated Naive Bayes models
        m = CalibratedClassifierCV(MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1), cv=3, method="sigmoid")
        m.fit(X_word_cnt_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_cal"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["mnb_cal"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        m = CalibratedClassifierCV(ComplementNB(alpha=0.3), cv=3, method="sigmoid")
        m.fit(X_word_cnt_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_cal"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_tr[val]).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["cnb_cal"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_word_cnt_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Pairwise one-vs-one logistic probabilities with coupling
        p_val, p_te = pairwise_predict(
            X_all_tr_tf[tr], y_tr, X_all_tr_tf[val], X_all_te_tf, C=4.0
        )
        oof["lr_pairs"][val] = p_val
        test_pred["lr_pairs"] += p_te / n_splits

        # Dense-feature logistic regression
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            LogisticRegression(
                C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
            ),
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_val).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_dense"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # LightGBM on dense features
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr, y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_val, y_val)
        params = {
            "objective": "multiclass",
            "num_class": 3,
            "metric": "multi_logloss",
            "learning_rate": 0.05,

            "seed": 42,
            "num_threads": 4,

        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_dense"][val] = (
            np.asarray(model.predict(X_dense_val)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        )
        test_pred["lgb_dense"] += (
            np.asarray(model.predict(X_dense_te)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

        # ExtraTrees on dense features
        m = ExtraTreesClassifier(
            n_estimators=300,
            min_samples_leaf=3,
            n_jobs=-1,
            random_state=42,
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr, y_tr)
        oof["et_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_dense_val).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["et_dense"] += (
            m.predict_proba(X_dense_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits
        )

        # Language-model features only, logistic regression
        m = make_pipeline(
            StandardScaler(),
            LogisticRegression(
                C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
            ),
        )
        m.fit(lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm"][val] = m.predict_proba(lm_val).astype(np.float32)
        test_pred["lr_lm"] += m.predict_proba(lm_te).astype(np.float32) / n_splits

    print("\nBase model CV log losses:", flush=True)
    for name in model_names:
        cv = safe_log_loss(y, oof[name])
        print(f"  {name}: {cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    avg_oof = np.mean([oof[name] for name in model_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
    avg_cv = safe_log_loss(y, avg_oof)
    print(f"Simple average CV log loss: {avg_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Meta-features: raw probabilities, log probabilities, entropy
    X_meta = np.hstack([oof[name] for name in model_names]).astype(np.float32)
    X_meta = np.hstack(
        [
            X_meta,
            np.log(np.clip(X_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            -np.sum(
                X_meta * np.log(np.clip(X_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1, keepdims=True
            ),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[name] for name in model_names]).astype(
        np.float32
    )
    X_meta_test = np.hstack(
        [
            X_meta_test,
            np.log(np.clip(X_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)),
            -np.sum(
                X_meta_test * np.log(np.clip(X_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)),
                axis=1,
                keepdims=True,
            ),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    Cs = [0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0]

    meta_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
    meta_test = np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32)

    print("Fitting nested logistic stacker...", flush=True)

    for tr_m, val_m in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y):
        inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=7)
        best_C = Cs[0]
        best_score = 1e9

        for C in Cs:
            scores = []
            for itr, iva in inner_skf.split(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m]):
                tmp = LogisticRegression(C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4)
                tmp.fit(X_meta[tr_m][itr], y[tr_m][itr])
                scores.append(
                    log_loss(
                        y[tr_m][iva],
                        normalize_rows(tmp.predict_proba(X_meta[tr_m][iva])),
                    )
                )
            mean_score = np.mean(scores)
            if mean_score < best_score:
                best_score = mean_score
                best_C = C

        stacker = LogisticRegression(C=best_C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4)
        stacker.fit(X_meta[tr_m], y[tr_m])
        meta_oof[val_m] = stacker.predict_proba(X_meta[val_m]).astype(np.float32)
        meta_test += (
            normalize_rows(stacker.predict_proba(X_meta_test)).astype(np.float32)
            / n_splits
        )

    stack_cv = safe_log_loss(y, meta_oof)
    print(f"Logistic stacker CV log loss: {stack_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    if stack_cv <= avg_cv:
        final_test = normalize_rows(meta_test)
    else:
        final_test = normalize_rows(
            np.mean([test_pred[name] for name in model_names], axis=0).astype(
                np.float32
            )
        )

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings
import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import hstack
from scipy.optimize import minimize, minimize_scalar

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def safe_normalize(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def temperature_apply(P, T):
    P = safe_normalize(P)
    logp = np.log(np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)) / T
    logp -= logp.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    Q = np.exp(logp)
    Q /= Q.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return Q.astype(np.float32)


def optimize_weights(P, y):
    """Optimize non-negative convex blend weights on OOF probabilities."""
    n_models = P.shape[1]
    z0 = np.zeros(n_models)

    def objective(z):
        z = z - np.max(z)
        w = np.exp(z)
        w = w / w.sum()
        pred = np.einsum("m,nmc->nc", w, P)
        pred = safe_normalize(pred)
        return log_loss(y, pred)

    res = minimize(objective, z0, method="L-BFGS-B", options={"maxiter": 300})
    z = np.asarray(res.x, dtype=np.float64)
    z = z - np.max(z)
    w = np.exp(z)
    w = w / w.sum()
    return w


def optimize_temperature(P, y):
    P = safe_normalize(P)

    def objective(T):
        if T <= 1e-6:
            return 10.0
        Q = temperature_apply(P, T)
        return log_loss(y, Q)

    res = minimize_scalar(objective, bounds=(0.2, 5.0), method="bounded")

def compute_lm_features(lm_matrices, train_idx, y_fold, target_idx, alpha=1.0):
    n_target = len(target_idx)
    n_types = len(lm_matrices)
    feats = np.zeros((n_target, 3 * n_types), dtype=np.float32)
    col = 0

    for X in lm_matrices:
        X_tr = X[train_idx]
        X_target = X[target_idx]
        row_sums = np.asarray(X_target.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

        for c in range(3):
            mask = y_fold == c
            counts = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
            counts = counts / counts.sum()
            logp = np.log(counts)
            scores = X_target.dot(logp)
            feats[:, col] = np.asarray(scores).ravel() / np.maximum(row_sums, 1)
            col += 1

    return feats


def compute_vocab_coverage(Xw1, train_idx, y_fold, target_idx, top_k=3000):
    X_tr = Xw1[train_idx]
    X_target = Xw1[target_idx]
    row_sums = np.asarray(X_target.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    feats = np.zeros((len(target_idx), 3), dtype=np.float32)

    for c in range(3):
        counts = np.asarray(X_tr[y_fold == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel()
        k = min(top_k, counts.shape[0])
        if k == 0:
            continue
        vocab_idx = np.argsort(counts)[::-1][:k]
        covered = np.asarray(X_target[:, vocab_idx].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        feats[:, c] = covered / np.maximum(row_sums, 1)

    logits = np.log(P)
    logits = logits / T
    logits = logits - logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    exp = np.exp(logits)
    return exp / exp.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

                    ),

            ]
        )

        final_test = lr_stack.predict_proba(build_meta_features(P_cal_test))

    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)
