    s = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    s[s == 0] = 1.0
    return P / s


def as_proba(p):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float32)
    if p.ndim == 1:
        p = p.reshape(-1, 3)
    return normalize_rows(p)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    words = text.str.split()
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = words.str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = words.apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_long_words"] = words.apply(lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if len(w) > 6))
    feats["n_stop"] = words.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def author_logp_matrix(X_tr_counts, y_tr, alpha=0.5):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    V = X_tr_counts.shape[1]
    logp = np.zeros((len(classes), V), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, c in enumerate(classes):
        counts = (
            np.asarray(X_tr_counts[y_tr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
            + alpha
        )
        logp[i] = np.log(counts / counts.sum())
    return logp


def compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_counts, y_tr, alpha=0.5):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    class_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    V = X_tr_counts.shape[1]
    n = X_tr_counts.shape[0]

    counts_by_class = []
    for c in classes:
        counts_by_class.append(
            np.asarray(X_tr_counts[y_tr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        )

    logp_all = np.zeros((len(classes), V), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, c in enumerate(classes):
        denom = counts_by_class[j].sum() + alpha * V
        logp_all[j] = np.log((counts_by_class[j] + alpha) / denom)

    scores = np.asarray(X_tr_counts @ logp_all.T, dtype=np.float64).copy()

    for i in range(n):
        row = X_tr_counts[i]
        if row.nnz == 0:
            continue
        ci = class_to_idx[y_tr[i]]
        indices = row.indices
        data = row.data.astype(np.float64)
        row_total = data.sum()

        adjusted = counts_by_class[ci][indices] - data
        denom_adj = counts_by_class[ci].sum() - row_total + alpha * V
        scores[i, ci] = np.dot(data, np.log((adjusted + alpha) / denom_adj))

    return scores.astype(np.float32)


def build_lm_block(scores, row_sums, n_chars):
    eps = 1e-8
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scores,
            scores / np.maximum(row_sums[:, None], eps),
            scores / np.maximum(n_chars[:, None], eps),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)


def make_nbsvm_features(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, alpha=1.0):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    tr_parts, va_parts, te_parts = [], [], []
    n_features = X_tr.shape[1]

    for c in classes:
        mask = y_tr == c
        pos = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        neg = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha

        r = np.log(pos / (pos.sum() + alpha * n_features)) - np.log(
            neg / (neg.sum() + alpha * n_features)
        )
        r = r.astype(np.float32)

        tr_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))
        va_parts.append(X_va.multiply(r))
        te_parts.append(X_te.multiply(r))

    return hstack(tr_parts).tocsr(), hstack(va_parts).tocsr(), hstack(te_parts).tocsr()


def knn_probabilities(dist, idx, y_onehot):
    weights = (1.0 / (dist + 1e-8)).astype(np.float32)
    neighbor_labels = y_onehot[idx].astype(np.float32)
    p = np.einsum("nkc,nk->nc", neighbor_labels, weights)
    return p / weights.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values.astype(int)

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    splits = list(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y))

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)
    all_text = pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0).fillna("")

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=80000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=80000,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=100000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=150000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_tr_word_tf = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_tf = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_tf = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_tf = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_word_cnt, all_char_cnt

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word_tf, X_tr_char_tf]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word_tf, X_te_char_tf]).tocsr()

    # HashingVectorizer does not support sublinear_tf, so it is omitted here.
    hash_word = HashingVectorizer(
        n_features=2**17,
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        alternate_sign=False,
        norm="l2",
        dtype=np.float32,
    )
    hash_char = HashingVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 6),
        n_features=2**17,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        alternate_sign=False,
        norm="l2",
        dtype=np.float32,
    )

    all_hash_word = hash_word.transform(all_text).tocsr()
    all_hash_char = hash_char.transform(all_text).tocsr()

    X_tr_hash_word = all_hash_word[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_hash_word = all_hash_word[n_train:].tocsr()
    X_tr_hash_char = all_hash_char[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_hash_char = all_hash_char[n_train:].tocsr()

    del all_hash_word, all_hash_char

    print("Building SVD/NMF features...", flush=True)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_tr = svd.fit_transform(X_tr_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    svd_te = svd.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

    nmf = NMF(n_components=64, init="nndsvda", random_state=42, max_iter=300)
    nmf_tr = nmf.fit_transform(X_tr_word_tf).astype(np.float32)
    nmf_te = nmf.transform(X_te_word_tf).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    X_dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, nmf_tr, style_tr.values]).astype(np.float32)
    X_dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, nmf_te, style_te.values]).astype(np.float32)

    # Random feature masks for random-subspace logistic regression bagging
    rng = np.random.default_rng(2024)
    n_tfidf_features = X_tr_tfidf.shape[1]
    rs_masks = [rng.random(n_tfidf_features) < 0.70 for _ in range(6)]
    rs_C_values = [0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 6.0, 8.0]

    base_names = [
        "lr_all",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_word",
        "sgd_all",
        "mnb_w",
        "mnb_c",
        "cnb_w",
        "cnb_c",
        "bnb_w",
        "bnb_c",
        "nbsvm_w",
        "lr_svd",
        "lgb_svd",
        "lr_lm",
        "lr_lm_dense",
        "lgb_lm_dense",
        "mlp_lm_dense",
        "knn_lm_dense",
        "lda_lm_dense",
        "extra_lm_dense",
        "knn_tfidf5",
        "knn_tfidf30",
        "lr_centroid",
        "lr_c_low",
        "lr_c_high",
        "rs_lr_avg",
        "hash_lr_word",
        "hash_lr_char",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}

    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": 3,
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "num_threads": 4,
    }

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)
    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(splits):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        # Fold-safe language-model scores
        logp_word = author_logp_matrix(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_tr_word = compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_val_word = np.asarray(X_tr_word_cnt[val] @ logp_word.T, dtype=np.float32)
        scores_te_word = np.asarray(X_te_word_cnt @ logp_word.T, dtype=np.float32)

        row_sums_tr_word = np.asarray(X_tr_word_cnt[tr].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_val_word = np.asarray(X_tr_word_cnt[val].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_te_word = np.asarray(X_te_word_cnt.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

        lm_tr_word = build_lm_block(
            scores_tr_word, row_sums_tr_word, style_tr["n_chars"].values[tr]
        )
        lm_val_word = build_lm_block(
            scores_val_word, row_sums_val_word, style_tr["n_chars"].values[val]
        )
        lm_te_word = build_lm_block(
            scores_te_word, row_sums_te_word, style_te["n_chars"].values
        )

        logp_char = author_logp_matrix(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_tr_char = compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_val_char = np.asarray(X_tr_char_cnt[val] @ logp_char.T, dtype=np.float32)
        scores_te_char = np.asarray(X_te_char_cnt @ logp_char.T, dtype=np.float32)

        row_sums_tr_char = np.asarray(X_tr_char_cnt[tr].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_val_char = np.asarray(X_tr_char_cnt[val].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_te_char = np.asarray(X_te_char_cnt.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

        lm_tr_char = build_lm_block(
            scores_tr_char, row_sums_tr_char, style_tr["n_chars"].values[tr]
        )
        lm_val_char = build_lm_block(
            scores_val_char, row_sums_val_char, style_tr["n_chars"].values[val]
        )
        lm_te_char = build_lm_block(
            scores_te_char, row_sums_te_char, style_te["n_chars"].values
        )

        lm_tr = np.hstack([lm_tr_word, lm_tr_char]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_val = np.hstack([lm_val_word, lm_val_char]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te = np.hstack([lm_te_word, lm_te_char]).astype(np.float32)

        X_dense_lm_tr = np.hstack([X_dense_tr[tr], lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        X_dense_lm_val = np.hstack([X_dense_tr[val], lm_val]).astype(np.float32)
        X_dense_lm_te = np.hstack([X_dense_te, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Logistic regression on word + character TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val]))
        test_pred["lr_all"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf)) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on character TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_char_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_tf[val]))
        test_pred["lr_char"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_tf)) / n_splits

        # Logistic regression on word TF-IDF
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_word_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_tf[val]))
        test_pred["lr_word"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_word_tf)) / n_splits

        # SGD logistic regression
        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss", alpha=1e-4, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["sgd_all"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val]))
        test_pred["sgd_all"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf)) / n_splits

        # Naive Bayes variants
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_w"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["mnb_w"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.15)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_c"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["mnb_c"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.3)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_w"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["cnb_w"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_c"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["cnb_c"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_w"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["bnb_w"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = BernoulliNB(alpha=0.1, binarize=0.0)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["bnb_c"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["bnb_c"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt)) / n_splits

        # NBSVM-style word count model
        X_tr_nb, X_val_nb, X_te_nb = make_nbsvm_features(
            X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, X_tr_word_cnt[val], X_te_word_cnt
        )
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_nb, y_tr)
        oof["nbsvm_w"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_val_nb))
        test_pred["nbsvm_w"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_nb)) / n_splits

        # Dense LR without LM
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_svd"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_tr[val]))
        test_pred["lr_svd"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense LightGBM without LM
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_tr[val], y_val)
        model = lgb.train(
            lgb_params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_svd"][val] = as_proba(model.predict(X_dense_tr[val]))
        test_pred["lgb_svd"] += as_proba(model.predict(X_dense_te)) / n_splits

        # LM-only LR
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(lm_val))
        test_pred["lr_lm"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM LR
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["lr_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM LightGBM
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(X_dense_lm_val, y_val)
        model = lgb.train(
            lgb_params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1500,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(model.predict(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["lgb_lm_dense"] += as_proba(model.predict(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM MLP
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "mlp",
                    MLPClassifier(
                        hidden_layer_sizes=(128, 64),
                        activation="relu",
                        alpha=1e-3,
                        batch_size=256,
                        learning_rate_init=1e-3,
                        max_iter=400,
                        early_stopping=True,
                        n_iter_no_change=10,
                        random_state=42,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["mlp_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["mlp_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM KNN
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "knn",
                    KNeighborsClassifier(
                        n_neighbors=25, weights="distance", p=2, n_jobs=4
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["knn_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["knn_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM LDA
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                ("lda", LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto")),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lda_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["lda_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        # Dense + LM Extra Trees
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "et",
                    ExtraTreesClassifier(
                        n_estimators=300,
                        max_features=0.3,
                        min_samples_leaf=5,
                        n_jobs=4,
                        random_state=42,

                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(X_dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["extra_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["extra_lm_dense"] += (
            as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_dense_lm_te)) / n_splits
        )

        # TF-IDF nearest-neighbor probabilities
        nn = NearestNeighbors(
            n_neighbors=30, metric="cosine", algorithm="brute", n_jobs=4
        )
        nn.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr])
        dist_val, idx_val = nn.kneighbors(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        dist_te, idx_te = nn.kneighbors(X_te_tfidf)

        y_tr_onehot = np.zeros((len(y_tr), 3), dtype=np.float32)
        y_tr_onehot[np.arange(len(y_tr)), y_tr] = 1.0

        for k, knn_name in [(5, "knn_tfidf5"), (30, "knn_tfidf30")]:
            p_val = knn_probabilities(dist_val[:, :k], idx_val[:, :k], y_tr_onehot)
            p_te = knn_probabilities(dist_te[:, :k], idx_te[:, :k], y_tr_onehot)
            oof[knn_name][val] = as_proba(p_val)
            test_pred[knn_name] += as_proba(p_te) / n_splits

        # Fold-safe class-centroid cosine similarity features
        Xtr_norm = normalize(X_tr_tfidf[tr], norm="l2", axis=1)
        Xval_norm = normalize(X_tr_tfidf[val], norm="l2", axis=1)
        Xte_norm = normalize(X_te_tfidf, norm="l2", axis=1)

        sums = []
        counts = []
        for c in range(3):
            mask = y_tr == c
            sums.append(
                np.asarray(Xtr_norm[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float32)
            )
            counts.append(int(mask.sum()))

        sims_tr = np.zeros((len(y_tr), 3), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(3):
            proj = np.asarray(Xtr_norm @ sums[c]).ravel().astype(np.float32)
            mask = y_tr == c
            sims_tr[mask, c] = (proj[mask] - 1.0) / max(counts[c] - 1, 1)
            sims_tr[~mask, c] = proj[~mask] / max(counts[c], 1)

        row_norms = np.asarray(Xtr_norm.multiply(Xtr_norm).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        zero_rows = row_norms < 1e-8
        if zero_rows.any():
            sims_tr[zero_rows, :] = 0.0

        sims_val = np.zeros((Xval_norm.shape[0], 3), dtype=np.float32)
        sims_te = np.zeros((Xte_norm.shape[0], 3), dtype=np.float32)
        for c in range(3):
            sims_val[:, c] = np.asarray(Xval_norm @ sums[c]).ravel() / counts[c]
            sims_te[:, c] = np.asarray(Xte_norm @ sums[c]).ravel() / counts[c]

        lr_cent = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]

            )

            )

        )

        # Hashed character n-gram SGD logistic
        m = SGDClassifier(

            tol=1e-4,
            random_state=42,
        )

        )

    simple_avg_pred = np.mean([oof[n] for n in base_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)

    print(f"Base model simple average CV log loss: {simple_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Build meta features: raw probabilities + log probabilities + entropy
    raw_meta = np.hstack([oof[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = oof[name]
        entropy_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta = np.column_stack(entropy_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta = np.hstack([raw_meta, log_meta, entropy_meta]).astype(np.float32)

    raw_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta_test = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_test_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = test_pred[name]
        entropy_test_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta_test = np.column_stack(entropy_test_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([raw_meta_test, log_meta_test, entropy_meta_test]).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    # Tune the regularized logistic stacker with nested 5-fold CV
    print("Tuning and fitting logistic stacker...", flush=True)
    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    candidate_Cs = [0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0]
    best_C = 0.5
    best_stack_cv = np.inf

    for C_val in candidate_Cs:
        meta_oof = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32)
        for tr, val in meta_skf.split(X_meta, y):
            pipe = Pipeline(
                [
                    ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                    (
                        "lr",
                        LogisticRegression(
                            C=C_val,
                            solver="lbfgs",
                            max_iter=2000,
                            tol=1e-4,
                            random_state=42,
                        ),
                    ),
                ]
            )
            pipe.fit(X_meta[tr], y[tr])
            meta_oof[val] = pipe.predict_proba(X_meta[val])
        score = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(meta_oof))
        if score < best_stack_cv:
            best_stack_cv = score
            best_C = C_val

    print(f"5-Fold CV log loss (stacked): {best_stack_cv:.6f} (C={best_C})", flush=True)

    # Fit final stacker on all OOF meta-features
    final_pipe = Pipeline(
        [
            ("sc", StandardScaler()),
            (
                "lr",
                LogisticRegression(
                    C=best_C,
                    solver="lbfgs",
                    max_iter=2000,
                    tol=1e-4,
                    random_state=42,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )
    final_pipe.fit(X_meta, y)
    final_test = normalize_rows(
        final_pipe.predict_proba(X_meta_test).astype(np.float32)
    )

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):
        sub[cls] = final_test[:, i]

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import warnings

import time

from scipy.sparse import hstack

)

def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    s = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    s[s == 0] = 1.0
    return P / s


def as_proba(p):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float32)
    if p.ndim == 1:
        p = p.reshape(-1, 3)
    return normalize_rows(p)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    words = text.str.split()
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = words.str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = words.apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_long_words"] = words.apply(lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if len(w) > 6))
    feats["n_stop"] = words.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def author_logp_matrix(X_tr_counts, y_tr, alpha=0.5):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    V = X_tr_counts.shape[1]
    logp = np.zeros((len(classes), V), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, c in enumerate(classes):
        counts = (
            np.asarray(X_tr_counts[y_tr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
            + alpha
        )
        logp[i] = np.log(counts / counts.sum())
    return logp


def compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_counts, y_tr, alpha=0.5):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    class_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    V = X_tr_counts.shape[1]
    n = X_tr_counts.shape[0]

    counts_by_class = []
    for c in classes:
        counts_by_class.append(
            np.asarray(X_tr_counts[y_tr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        )

    logp_all = np.zeros((len(classes), V), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, c in enumerate(classes):
        denom = counts_by_class[j].sum() + alpha * V
        logp_all[j] = np.log((counts_by_class[j] + alpha) / denom)

    scores = np.asarray(X_tr_counts @ logp_all.T, dtype=np.float64).copy()

    for i in range(n):
        row = X_tr_counts[i]
        if row.nnz == 0:
            continue
        ci = class_to_idx[y_tr[i]]
        indices = row.indices
        data = row.data.astype(np.float64)
        row_total = data.sum()

        adjusted = counts_by_class[ci][indices] - data
        denom_adj = counts_by_class[ci].sum() - row_total + alpha * V
        scores[i, ci] = np.dot(data, np.log((adjusted + alpha) / denom_adj))

    return scores.astype(np.float32)


def build_lm_block(scores, row_sums, n_chars):
    eps = 1e-8
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scores,
            scores / np.maximum(row_sums[:, None], eps),
            scores / np.maximum(n_chars[:, None], eps),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)


def make_nbsvm_features(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, alpha=1.0):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    tr_parts, va_parts, te_parts = [], [], []
    n_features = X_tr.shape[1]

    for c in classes:
        mask = y_tr == c
        pos = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        neg = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha

        r = np.log(pos / (pos.sum() + alpha * n_features)) - np.log(
            neg / (neg.sum() + alpha * n_features)
        )
        r = r.astype(np.float32)

        tr_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))
        va_parts.append(X_va.multiply(r))
        te_parts.append(X_te.multiply(r))

    return hstack(tr_parts).tocsr(), hstack(va_parts).tocsr(), hstack(te_parts).tocsr()


def knn_probabilities(dist, idx, y_onehot):
    weights = (1.0 / (dist + 1e-8)).astype(np.float32)
    neighbor_labels = y_onehot[idx].astype(np.float32)
    p = np.einsum("nkc,nk->nc", neighbor_labels, weights)
    return p / weights.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    s = P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    s[s == 0] = 1.0
    return P / s


def as_proba(p):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float32)
    if p.ndim == 1:
        p = p.reshape(-1, 3)
    return normalize_rows(p)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)

    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = words.str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = words.apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_long_words"] = words.apply(lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if len(w) > 6))
    feats["n_stop"] = words.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def author_logp_matrix(X_tr_counts, y_tr, alpha=0.5):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    V = X_tr_counts.shape[1]
    logp = np.zeros((len(classes), V), dtype=np.float64)
    for i, c in enumerate(classes):
        counts = (
            np.asarray(X_tr_counts[y_tr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
            + alpha
        )
        logp[i] = np.log(counts / counts.sum())
    return logp


def compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_counts, y_tr, alpha=0.5):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    class_to_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    V = X_tr_counts.shape[1]

    counts_by_class = []
    for c in classes:
        counts_by_class.append(
            np.asarray(X_tr_counts[y_tr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        )

    logp_all = np.zeros((len(classes), V), dtype=np.float64)
    for j, c in enumerate(classes):
        denom = counts_by_class[j].sum() + alpha * V
        logp_all[j] = np.log((counts_by_class[j] + alpha) / denom)

    scores = np.asarray(X_tr_counts @ logp_all.T, dtype=np.float64).copy()

    for i in range(X_tr_counts.shape[0]):
        row = X_tr_counts[i]
        if row.nnz == 0:
            continue
        ci = class_to_idx[y_tr[i]]
        indices = row.indices
        data = row.data.astype(np.float64)
        row_total = data.sum()

        adjusted = counts_by_class[ci][indices] - data
        denom_adj = counts_by_class[ci].sum() - row_total + alpha * V
        scores[i, ci] = np.dot(data, np.log((adjusted + alpha) / denom_adj))

    return scores.astype(np.float32)


def build_lm_block(scores, row_sums, n_chars):
    return np.hstack(
        [
            scores,
            scores / np.maximum(row_sums[:, None], 1e-8),
            scores / np.maximum(n_chars[:, None], 1e-8),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)


def make_nbsvm_features(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, alpha=1.0):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    tr_parts, va_parts, te_parts = [], [], []
    n_features = X_tr.shape[1]

    for c in classes:
        mask = y_tr == c
        pos = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        neg = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha

        r = np.log(pos / (pos.sum() + alpha * n_features)) - np.log(
            neg / (neg.sum() + alpha * n_features)
        )
        r = r.astype(np.float32)

        tr_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))
        va_parts.append(X_va.multiply(r))
        te_parts.append(X_te.multiply(r))

    return hstack(tr_parts).tocsr(), hstack(va_parts).tocsr(), hstack(te_parts).tocsr()


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values.astype(int)

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    n_splits = 5
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    splits = list(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y))

    all_text = (
        pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0)
        .reset_index(drop=True)
        .fillna("")
    )

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=60000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=60000,
    )
    tf_w3 = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=50000,
    )
    tf_clong = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(6, 10),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=40000,
    )
    tf_rev = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=30000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_w3_tf = tf_w3.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_clong_tf = tf_clong.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_rev_tf = tf_rev.fit_transform(all_text.str[::-1])

    cnt_word_nb = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=50000,
    )
    cnt_char_nb = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=60000,
    )
    cnt_uni = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 1),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=40000,
    )
    cnt_char_lm = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(3, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=60000,
    )

    all_word_cnt = cnt_word_nb.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char_nb.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_cnt_uni = cnt_uni.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_cnt_char_lm = cnt_char_lm.fit_transform(all_text)

    hash_vec = HashingVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        n_features=2**18,
        alternate_sign=False,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
    )

    X_tr_word_tf = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_tf = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_tf = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_tf = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_w3_tf = all_w3_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_w3_tf = all_w3_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_clong_tf = all_clong_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_clong_tf = all_clong_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_rev = all_rev_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_rev = all_rev_tf[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_cnt_uni = all_cnt_uni[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_cnt_uni = all_cnt_uni[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_cnt_char_lm = all_cnt_char_lm[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_cnt_char_lm = all_cnt_char_lm[n_train:].tocsr()

    X_tr_hash = hash_vec.transform(train["text"].fillna("").astype(str))
    X_te_hash = hash_vec.transform(test["text"].fillna("").astype(str))

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word_tf, X_tr_char_tf]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word_tf, X_te_char_tf]).tocsr()

    X_tr_w3cl = hstack([X_tr_w3_tf, X_tr_clong_tf]).tocsr()
    X_te_w3cl = hstack([X_te_w3_tf, X_te_clong_tf]).tocsr()

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_w3_tf, all_clong_tf, all_rev_tf

    print("Building SVD / NMF / LDA embeddings...", flush=True)

    # Correct row-wise concatenation of train and test: use vstack, not hstack.
    all_tfidf = vstack([X_tr_tfidf, X_te_tfidf]).tocsr()

    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=80, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
    svd_all = svd.fit_transform(all_tfidf).astype(np.float32)
    del all_tfidf

    all_word_full = vstack([X_tr_word_tf, X_te_word_tf]).tocsr()
    nmf = NMF(n_components=24, init="nndsvda", random_state=42, max_iter=150)
    nmf_all = nmf.fit_transform(all_word_full).astype(np.float32)
    del all_word_full

    cnt_lda = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=20000,
    )
    all_lda_cnt = cnt_lda.fit_transform(all_text)
    lda_model = LatentDirichletAllocation(n_components=20, random_state=42, max_iter=12)
    lda_all = lda_model.fit_transform(all_lda_cnt).astype(np.float32)

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    dense_tr = np.hstack(
        [
            svd_all[:n_train],
            nmf_all[:n_train],
            lda_all[:n_train],
            style_tr.values,
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    dense_te = np.hstack(
        [
            svd_all[n_train:],
            nmf_all[n_train:],
            lda_all[n_train:],
            style_te.values,
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)

    base_names = [
        "lr_all",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_w3cl",
        "lr_rev",
        "sgd_hash",
        "mnb_word",
        "cnb_char",
        "nbsvm_word",
        "lr_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "lr_lm",
        "lr_lm_dense",
        "lgb_lm_dense",
        "lda_lm_dense",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}

    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": 3,
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "num_threads": 4,
    }

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)

    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(splits):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/{n_splits}", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        # Fold-safe language model features
        logp_word = author_logp_matrix(X_tr_cnt_uni[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_tr_word = compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_cnt_uni[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_val_word = np.asarray(X_tr_cnt_uni[val] @ logp_word.T, dtype=np.float32)
        scores_te_word = np.asarray(X_te_cnt_uni @ logp_word.T, dtype=np.float32)

        row_sums_tr_word = np.asarray(X_tr_cnt_uni[tr].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_val_word = np.asarray(X_tr_cnt_uni[val].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_te_word = np.asarray(X_te_cnt_uni.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

        lm_tr_word = build_lm_block(
            scores_tr_word, row_sums_tr_word, style_tr["n_chars"].values[tr]
        )
        lm_val_word = build_lm_block(
            scores_val_word, row_sums_val_word, style_tr["n_chars"].values[val]
        )
        lm_te_word = build_lm_block(
            scores_te_word, row_sums_te_word, style_te["n_chars"].values
        )

        logp_char = author_logp_matrix(X_tr_cnt_char_lm[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_tr_char = compute_loo_lm_scores(X_tr_cnt_char_lm[tr], y_tr, alpha=0.5)
        scores_val_char = np.asarray(
            X_tr_cnt_char_lm[val] @ logp_char.T, dtype=np.float32
        )
        scores_te_char = np.asarray(X_te_cnt_char_lm @ logp_char.T, dtype=np.float32)

        row_sums_tr_char = np.asarray(X_tr_cnt_char_lm[tr].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_val_char = np.asarray(X_tr_cnt_char_lm[val].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        row_sums_te_char = np.asarray(X_te_cnt_char_lm.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

        lm_tr_char = build_lm_block(
            scores_tr_char, row_sums_tr_char, style_tr["n_chars"].values[tr]
        )
        lm_val_char = build_lm_block(
            scores_val_char, row_sums_val_char, style_tr["n_chars"].values[val]
        )
        lm_te_char = build_lm_block(
            scores_te_char, row_sums_te_char, style_te["n_chars"].values
        )

        lm_tr = np.hstack([lm_tr_word, lm_tr_char]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_val = np.hstack([lm_val_word, lm_val_char]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te = np.hstack([lm_te_word, lm_te_char]).astype(np.float32)

        dense_lm_tr = np.hstack([dense_tr[tr], lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        dense_lm_val = np.hstack([dense_tr[val], lm_val]).astype(np.float32)
        dense_lm_te = np.hstack([dense_te, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Sparse logistic models
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val]))
        test_pred["lr_all"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf)) / n_splits

        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_char_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_tf[val]))
        test_pred["lr_char"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_tf)) / n_splits

        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_w3cl[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_w3cl"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_w3cl[val]))
        test_pred["lr_w3cl"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_w3cl)) / n_splits

        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_rev[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_rev"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_rev[val]))
        test_pred["lr_rev"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_rev)) / n_splits

        m = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss", alpha=1e-4, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_hash[tr], y_tr)
        oof["sgd_hash"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_hash[val]))
        test_pred["sgd_hash"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_hash)) / n_splits

        # Naive Bayes and NBSVM
        m = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["mnb_word"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_word_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["mnb_word"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_word_cnt)) / n_splits

        m = ComplementNB(alpha=0.2)
        m.fit(X_tr_char_cnt[tr], y_tr)
        oof["cnb_char"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_cnt[val]))
        test_pred["cnb_char"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_char_cnt)) / n_splits

        X_tr_nb, X_val_nb, X_te_nb = make_nbsvm_features(
            X_tr_word_cnt[tr], y_tr, X_tr_word_cnt[val], X_te_word_cnt
        )
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=0.5, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1200, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_nb, y_tr)
        oof["nbsvm_word"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_val_nb))
        test_pred["nbsvm_word"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(X_te_nb)) / n_splits

        # Dense models without LM
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(dense_tr[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(dense_tr[val]))
        test_pred["lr_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(dense_te)) / n_splits

        dtr = lgb.Dataset(dense_tr[tr], y_tr, free_raw_data=False)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(dense_tr[val], y_val, free_raw_data=False)
        model = lgb.train(
            lgb_params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1200,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_dense"][val] = as_proba(model.predict(dense_tr[val]))
        test_pred["lgb_dense"] += as_proba(model.predict(dense_te)) / n_splits

        # LM-only and dense+LM models
        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(lm_val))
        test_pred["lr_lm"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(lm_te)) / n_splits

        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                (
                    "lr",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lr_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["lr_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        dtr = lgb.Dataset(dense_lm_tr, y_tr, free_raw_data=False)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(dense_lm_val, y_val, free_raw_data=False)
        model = lgb.train(
            lgb_params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1200,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(model.predict(dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["lgb_lm_dense"] += as_proba(model.predict(dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

        m = Pipeline(
            [
                ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                ("lda", LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver="lsqr", shrinkage="auto")),
            ]
        )
        m.fit(dense_lm_tr, y_tr)
        oof["lda_lm_dense"][val] = as_proba(m.predict_proba(dense_lm_val))
        test_pred["lda_lm_dense"] += as_proba(m.predict_proba(dense_lm_te)) / n_splits

    print("\nBase OOF log losses:", flush=True)
    for name in base_names:
        print(f"  {name}: {log_loss(y, normalize_rows(oof[name])):.4f}", flush=True)

    simple_avg_pred = np.mean([oof[n] for n in base_names], axis=0).astype(np.float32)
    simple_cv = log_loss(y, normalize_rows(simple_avg_pred))
    print(f"\nSimple average 5-Fold CV log loss: {simple_cv:.6f}", flush=True)

    # Meta-features: raw probabilities + log-probabilities + entropy
    raw_meta = np.hstack([oof[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = oof[name]
        entropy_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta = np.column_stack(entropy_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta = np.hstack([raw_meta, log_meta, entropy_meta]).astype(np.float32)

    raw_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[n] for n in base_names]).astype(np.float32)
    log_meta_test = np.log(np.clip(raw_meta_test, 1e-12, 1.0)).astype(np.float32)

    entropy_test_parts = []
    for name in base_names:
        p = test_pred[name]
        entropy_test_parts.append(-np.sum(p * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1.0)), axis=1))
    entropy_meta_test = np.column_stack(entropy_test_parts).astype(np.float32)

    X_meta_test = np.hstack([raw_meta_test, log_meta_test, entropy_meta_test]).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    # Tune stacker regularization with nested 5-fold CV
    print("\nTuning logistic stacker...", flush=True)
    C_grid = [0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0]
    inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=777)
    best_c, best_loss = C_grid[0], np.inf

    for C in C_grid:

        for tr, val in inner_skf.split(X_meta, y):
            pipe = Pipeline(
                [
                    ("sc", StandardScaler()),
                    (
                        "lr",
                        LogisticRegression(
                            C=C,
                            solver="lbfgs",
                            max_iter=2000,
                            tol=1e-4,
                            random_state=42,
                        ),
                    ),
                ]
            )
            pipe.fit(X_meta[tr], y[tr])
            p = normalize_rows(pipe.predict_proba(X_meta[val]))
            losses.append(log_loss(y[val], p))
        avg_loss = float(np.mean(losses))
        print(f"  Stacker C={C}: {avg_loss:.6f}", flush=True)
        if avg_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = avg_loss
            best_c = C

    print(
        f"\nBest stacker C={best_c}: 5-Fold CV log loss = {best_loss:.6f}", flush=True
    )

    final_pipe = Pipeline(
        [
            ("sc", StandardScaler()),
            (
                "lr",
                LogisticRegression(
                    C=best_c,
                    solver="lbfgs",
                    max_iter=2000,
                    tol=1e-4,
                    random_state=42,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )
    final_pipe.fit(X_meta, y)
    final_test = normalize_rows(
        final_pipe.predict_proba(X_meta_test).astype(np.float32)
    )

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()

    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)

import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import re
import time
import copy
import math
from collections import Counter

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import hstack

from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    TfidfVectorizer,
    CountVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline

import lightgbm as lgb

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

np.random.seed(42)
torch.manual_seed(42)

PAD_ID = 0
UNK_ID = 1
MASK_ID = 2
CLS_ID = 3


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )
    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def author_lm_scores(Xtr, ytr, Xnew, alpha=1.0):
    """Length-normalized smoothed per-author n-gram log-likelihoods."""
    classes = np.unique(ytr)
    n_features = Xtr.shape[1]
    logp_parts = []
    for c in classes:
        counts = (
            np.asarray(Xtr[ytr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64) + alpha
        )
        total = counts.sum()
        logp_parts.append(np.log(counts / total).astype(np.float32))
    logp_matrix = np.column_stack(logp_parts)

    scores = Xnew.dot(logp_matrix)
    if hasattr(scores, "toarray"):
        scores = scores.toarray()
    scores = np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float32).reshape(Xnew.shape[0], len(classes))

    lengths = np.asarray(Xnew.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    scores = scores / np.maximum(lengths[:, None], 1)
    return scores.astype(np.float32)


def author_lm_scores_loo(Xtr, ytr, alpha=1.0):
    """Exact leave-one-out smoothed per-author n-gram log-likelihoods for training rows."""
    classes = np.unique(ytr)
    n = Xtr.shape[0]
    n_features = Xtr.shape[1]

    counts = np.stack(
        [
            np.asarray(Xtr[ytr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64) + alpha
            for c in classes
        ]
    )
    totals = counts.sum(axis=1)
    logp_base = np.log(counts) - np.log(totals[:, None])

    Xr = Xtr.tocsr()
    scores = np.zeros((n, len(classes)), dtype=np.float64)

    for i in range(n):
        row = Xr[i]
        indices = row.indices
        vals = row.data.astype(np.float64)
        rowlen = vals.sum()
        if rowlen == 0:
            continue

        for ci, c in enumerate(classes):
            if c == ytr[i]:
                counts_c = counts[ci].copy()
                counts_c[indices] -= vals
                denom_c = totals[ci] - rowlen
                scores[i, ci] = np.dot(
                    vals, np.log(counts_c[indices])
                ) - rowlen * np.log(denom_c)
            else:
                scores[i, ci] = np.dot(vals, logp_base[ci, indices])

    lengths = np.asarray(Xtr.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    scores = scores / np.maximum(lengths[:, None], 1)
    return scores.astype(np.float32)


# ---------- Self-supervised Transformer ----------


def tokenize_text(s):
    return re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+|[^\sA-Za-z0-9]", s.lower())


def mask_tokens(input_ids, vocab_size, mask_prob=0.15):
    labels = input_ids.clone()
    not_special = (input_ids != PAD_ID) & (input_ids != CLS_ID)
    masked = (
        torch.bernoulli(
            torch.full(labels.shape, mask_prob, device=input_ids.device)
        ).bool()
        & not_special
    )
    labels[~masked] = -100

    replaced = (
        torch.bernoulli(torch.full(labels.shape, 0.8, device=input_ids.device)).bool()
        & masked
    )
    input_ids[replaced] = MASK_ID

    random = (
        torch.bernoulli(torch.full(labels.shape, 0.5, device=input_ids.device)).bool()
        & masked
        & ~replaced
    )
    random_words = torch.randint(4, vocab_size, labels.shape, device=input_ids.device)
    input_ids[random] = random_words[random]

    return input_ids, labels


class TransformerEncoderModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size,
        d_model=128,
        nhead=4,
        num_layers=4,
        dim_ff=512,
        max_len=128,
        dropout=0.1,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_model = d_model
        self.tok_embed = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, d_model, padding_idx=PAD_ID)
        self.pos_embed = nn.Embedding(max_len, d_model)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model,
            nhead=nhead,
            dim_feedforward=dim_ff,
            dropout=dropout,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(d_model, vocab_size)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(d_model, 3)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None, return_cls=False):
        seq_len = input_ids.size(1)
        positions = torch.arange(seq_len, device=input_ids.device).unsqueeze(0)
        x = self.dropout(self.tok_embed(input_ids) + self.pos_embed(positions))

        if attention_mask is not None:
            h = self.encoder(x, src_key_padding_mask=attention_mask)
        else:
            h = self.encoder(x)
        h = self.norm(h)

        if return_cls:
            cls_vec = h[:, 0, :]
            return self.classifier(cls_vec)
        return self.lm_head(h)


def pretrain_mlm(model, ids_np, device, epochs=2, batch_size=128):
    model.to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-4, weight_decay=0.01)
    loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=-100)
    vocab_size = model.tok_embed.num_embeddings

    loader = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(torch.from_numpy(ids_np.astype(np.int64))),
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=True,
        drop_last=False,
    )

    model.train()
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        total_loss = 0.0
        n_batches = 0
        for step, batch in enumerate(loader):
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            masked_ids, labels = mask_tokens(input_ids.clone(), vocab_size)
            pad_mask = masked_ids == PAD_ID

            logits = model(masked_ids, pad_mask)
            loss = loss_fn(logits.view(-1, vocab_size), labels.view(-1))

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

            total_loss += loss.item()
            n_batches += 1

        print(
            f"  MLM epoch {epoch + 1}/{epochs}: loss={total_loss / max(n_batches, 1):.4f}",
            flush=True,
        )
    return model


def predict_proba_model(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    preds = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            logits = model(input_ids, input_ids == PAD_ID, return_cls=True)
            preds.append(F.softmax(logits, dim=-1).cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(preds).astype(np.float32)


def train_transformer_fold(
    model, tr_ids, y_tr, val_ids, y_val, te_ids, device, epochs=5, batch_size=64
):
    model.to(device)
    model.classifier = nn.Linear(model.d_model, 3).to(device)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4, weight_decay=0.01)
    try:
        loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
    except TypeError:
        loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    tr_loader = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(
            torch.from_numpy(tr_ids.astype(np.int64)),
            torch.from_numpy(y_tr.astype(np.int64)),
        ),
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=True,
        drop_last=False,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(
            torch.from_numpy(val_ids.astype(np.int64)),
            torch.from_numpy(y_val.astype(np.int64)),
        ),
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=False,
        drop_last=False,
    )
    te_loader = DataLoader(
        TensorDataset(torch.from_numpy(te_ids.astype(np.int64))),
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=False,
        drop_last=False,
    )

    def eval_loss():
        model.eval()
        total = 0.0
        total_n = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for input_ids, labels in val_loader:
                input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
                labels = labels.to(device)
                logits = model(input_ids, input_ids == PAD_ID, return_cls=True)
                loss = loss_fn(logits, labels)
                total += loss.item() * labels.size(0)
                total_n += labels.size(0)
        return total / max(total_n, 1)

    best_loss = float("inf")
    best_state = None

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for input_ids, labels in tr_loader:
            input_ids = input_ids.to(device)
            labels = labels.to(device)
            logits = model(input_ids, input_ids == PAD_ID, return_cls=True)
            loss = loss_fn(logits, labels)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        val_loss = eval_loss()
        if val_loss < best_loss:
            best_loss = val_loss
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())

    model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    p_val = predict_proba_model(model, val_loader, device)
    p_te = predict_proba_model(model, te_loader, device)
    return p_val, p_te


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values
    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    splits = list(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y))

    all_text = pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], axis=0).fillna("").astype(str)

    print("Building sparse text features...", flush=True)

    tf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=80000,
    )
    tf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=80000,
    )
    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        token_pattern=r"\w+",
        max_features=100000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=2,
        lowercase=True,
        max_features=150000,
    )

    all_word_tf = tf_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_tf = tf_char.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_word_cnt = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_text)
    all_char_cnt = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_text)

    X_tr_word_tf = all_word_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_tf = all_word_tf[n_train:].tocsr()
    X_tr_char_tf = all_char_tf[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_tf = all_char_tf[n_train:].tocsr()
    X_tr_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_word_cnt = all_word_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()
    X_tr_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[:n_train].tocsr()
    X_te_char_cnt = all_char_cnt[n_train:].tocsr()

    del all_word_tf, all_char_tf, all_word_cnt, all_char_cnt

    X_tr_tfidf = hstack([X_tr_word_tf, X_tr_char_tf]).tocsr()
    X_te_tfidf = hstack([X_te_word_tf, X_te_char_tf]).tocsr()

    style_tr = build_style_features(train)
    style_te = build_style_features(test)

    base_names = ["lr_all", "lr_char", "lr_dense", "lgb_dense", "transformer"]
    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in base_names}

    # ---------- Build self-supervised Transformer if GPU is available ----------
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    transformer_ok = False
    transformer_model = None

    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        print("Building from-scratch Transformer model on GPU...", flush=True)
        try:
            all_tokens = [tokenize_text(t) for t in all_text]
            vocab_counter = Counter()
            for toks in all_tokens:
                vocab_counter.update(toks)

            max_vocab = 30000
            vocab = ["<pad>", "<unk>", "<mask>", "<cls>"]
            for w, c in vocab_counter.most_common(max_vocab - 4):
                if c >= 2:
                    vocab.append(w)
            stoi = {w: i for i, w in enumerate(vocab)}
            vocab_size = len(vocab)

            MAX_LEN = 96
            all_ids = np.zeros((len(all_text), MAX_LEN), dtype=np.int64)
            for i, text in enumerate(all_text):
                toks = tokenize_text(text)[: MAX_LEN - 1]
                ids = [stoi.get(tok, UNK_ID) for tok in toks]
                all_ids[i, 0] = CLS_ID
                all_ids[i, 1 : len(ids) + 1] = ids

            transformer_model = TransformerEncoderModel(
                vocab_size=vocab_size,
                d_model=128,
                nhead=4,
                num_layers=4,
                dim_ff=512,
                max_len=MAX_LEN,
                dropout=0.1,
            )
            transformer_model = pretrain_mlm(
                transformer_model, all_ids, device, epochs=2, batch_size=128
            )
            transformer_ok = True
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Transformer pretraining skipped: {e}", flush=True)
            transformer_ok = False

    if not transformer_ok:
        print("Using CPU/classical ensemble only.", flush=True)

    # ---------- Main 5-fold base model training ----------
    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)

    for fold, (tr, val) in enumerate(splits):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/5", flush=True)
        y_tr, y_val = y[tr], y[val]

        # Sparse TF-IDF logistic regression on word + char.
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_tfidf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_tfidf[val])
        test_pred["lr_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_tfidf) / 5

        # Sparse TF-IDF logistic regression on char only.
        m = LogisticRegression(
            C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4, random_state=42
        )
        m.fit(X_tr_char_tf[tr], y_tr)
        oof["lr_char"][val] = m.predict_proba(X_tr_char_tf[val])
        test_pred["lr_char"] += m.predict_proba(X_te_char_tf) / 5

        # Dense features: fold-local SVD + style + fold-safe author LM.
        svd_fold = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, n_iter=5, random_state=42)
        svd_tr = svd_fold.fit_transform(X_tr_tfidf[tr]).astype(np.float32)
        svd_val = svd_fold.transform(X_tr_tfidf[val]).astype(np.float32)
        svd_te = svd_fold.transform(X_te_tfidf).astype(np.float32)

        word_tr = X_tr_word_cnt[tr]
        word_val = X_tr_word_cnt[val]
        word_te = X_te_word_cnt

        char_tr = X_tr_char_cnt[tr]
        char_val = X_tr_char_cnt[val]
        char_te = X_te_char_cnt

        lm_tr = np.hstack(
            [
                author_lm_scores_loo(word_tr, y_tr),
                author_lm_scores_loo(char_tr, y_tr),
            ]
        ).astype(np.float32)

        lm_val = np.hstack(
            [
                author_lm_scores(word_tr, y_tr, word_val),
                author_lm_scores(char_tr, y_tr, char_val),
            ]
        ).astype(np.float32)

        lm_te = np.hstack(
            [
                author_lm_scores(word_tr, y_tr, word_te),
                author_lm_scores(char_tr, y_tr, char_te),
            ]
        ).astype(np.float32)

        dense_tr = np.hstack([svd_tr, style_tr.values[tr], lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        dense_val = np.hstack([svd_val, style_tr.values[val], lm_val]).astype(
            np.float32
        )
        dense_te = np.hstack([svd_te, style_te.values, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        scaler = StandardScaler().fit(dense_tr)

        m = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=42)
        m.fit(scaler.transform(dense_tr), y_tr)
        oof["lr_dense"][val] = m.predict_proba(scaler.transform(dense_val))
        test_pred["lr_dense"] += m.predict_proba(scaler.transform(dense_te)) / 5

        dtr = lgb.Dataset(dense_tr, y_tr)
        dval = lgb.Dataset(dense_val, y_val)
        params = {
            "objective": "multiclass",
            "num_class": 3,
            "metric": "multi_logloss",
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "feature_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_freq": 1,
            "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
            "lambda_l2": 1.0,
            "verbosity": -1,
            "seed": 42,
            "num_threads": 4,
        }
        model = lgb.train(
            params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=1000,
            valid_sets=[dval],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
        )
        oof["lgb_dense"][val] = (
            np.asarray(model.predict(dense_val)).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.float32)
        )
        test_pred["lgb_dense"] += (

        if transformer_ok and transformer_model is not None:
            p_val_t, p_te_t = train_transformer_fold(

        else:

    used_names = [n for n in base_names if (transformer_ok or n != "transformer")]

    raw_meta_test = np.hstack([test_pred[n] for n in used_names]).astype(np.float32)

    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)
    meta_pipe = Pipeline(
        [

    meta_pipe.fit(X_meta, y)
    final_test = normalize_rows(meta_pipe.predict_proba(X_meta_test).astype(np.float32))

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()
    for i, cls in enumerate(classes):

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)

    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)

)

from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB, BernoulliNB

from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors

def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.asarray(P, dtype=np.float64)
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def build_style_features(df):
    text = df["text"].fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = text.str.split().str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = text.str.split().apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sent"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = text.str.split().apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )

    return feats.fillna(0).astype(np.float32)


def make_nbsvm_features(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, X_te, alpha=1.0):
    classes = np.unique(y_tr)
    tr_parts, va_parts, te_parts = [], [], []
    n_features = X_tr.shape[1]

    for c in classes:
        mask = y_tr == c
        pos = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha
        neg = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel() + alpha

        r = np.log(pos / (pos.sum() + alpha * n_features)) - np.log(
            neg / (neg.sum() + alpha * n_features)
        )
        r = r.astype(np.float32)

        tr_parts.append(X_tr.multiply(r))
        va_parts.append(X_va.multiply(r))
        te_parts.append(X_te.multiply(r))

    return hstack(tr_parts).tocsr(), hstack(va_parts).tocsr(), hstack(te_parts).tocsr()


def author_lm_scores(Xtr, ytr, Xnew, alpha=0.3):
    """Smoothed per-author n-gram log-likelihood scores for Xnew.

    Author counts are estimated only from Xtr, so validation/test features do not
    leak labels.
    """
    classes = np.unique(ytr)
    logp_cols = []
    for c in classes:
        counts = (
            np.asarray(Xtr[ytr == c].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64) + alpha
        )
        total = counts.sum()
        logp_cols.append(np.log(counts / total).astype(np.float32))
    logp_matrix = np.column_stack(logp_cols)

    scores = Xnew.dot(logp_matrix)
    if hasattr(scores, "toarray"):
        scores = scores.toarray()
    scores = np.asarray(scores, dtype=np.float32).reshape(Xnew.shape[0], len(classes))

    lengths = np.asarray(Xnew.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    scores = scores / np.maximum(lengths[:, None], 1)
    return scores.astype(np.float32)


PUNCT = set(string.punctuation)
FUNC_WORDS = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)


def punct_pattern(s):
    return " ".join(ch for ch in s if ch in PUNCT)


def function_mask(s):
    tokens = re.findall(r"\w+|[^\w\s]", s, flags=re.UNICODE)
    out = []
    for tok in tokens:
        if re.fullmatch(r"\w+", tok):
            out.append(tok if tok.lower() in FUNC_WORDS else "X")
        else:
            out.append(tok)
    return " ".join(out)


def smooth_prob(P, idx, k, alpha, P_cur):
    neighbor = P[idx[:, :k]].mean(axis=1)
    return (1.0 - alpha) * P_cur + alpha * neighbor

        X_dl_val = np.hstack([X_dense_tr[val], lm_val]).astype(np.float32)

    )

    meta_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=123)

    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)
