def lm_features(X_tr, X_va, X_te, y_tr, alpha=0.15, lam=0.75, alpha_global=0.15):
    """Fold-safe author language model likelihood features."""
    K = int(y_tr.max()) + 1
    V = X_tr.shape[1]
    n_tr = X_tr.shape[0]

    total_counts = np.asarray(X_tr.sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
    total_tokens = total_counts.sum()
    global_denom = total_tokens + alpha_global * V
    global_prob_all = (total_counts + alpha_global) / global_denom

    class_counts = []
    class_tokens = []
    for k in range(K):
        c = np.asarray(X_tr[y_tr == k].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        class_counts.append(c)
        class_tokens.append(c.sum())

    def make_logp(counts, total):
        author_prob = (counts + alpha) / (total + alpha * V)
        p = lam * author_prob + (1.0 - lam) * global_prob_all
        return np.log(p)

    tr_scores = np.zeros((n_tr, K), dtype=np.float64)
    va_scores = np.zeros((X_va.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)
    te_scores = np.zeros((X_te.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)

    for k in range(K):
        logp_k = make_logp(class_counts[k], class_tokens[k])

        not_mask = y_tr != k
        if not_mask.any():
            tr_scores[not_mask, k] = np.asarray(X_tr[not_mask].dot(logp_k)).ravel()

        va_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_va.dot(logp_k)).ravel()
        te_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_te.dot(logp_k)).ravel()

        mask = y_tr == k
        for i in np.where(mask)[0]:
            row = X_tr[i]
            idx = row.indices
            if len(idx) == 0:
                continue
            data = row.data.astype(np.float64)
            row_sum = data.sum()

            loo_counts = class_counts[k][idx] - data
            loo_total = class_tokens[k] - row_sum

            author_prob = (loo_counts + alpha) / (loo_total + alpha * V)
            global_prob = global_prob_all[idx]
            p = lam * author_prob + (1.0 - lam) * global_prob
            tr_scores[i, k] = np.dot(data, np.log(p))

    def blocks(scores, X):
        denom = np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        norm = scores / (denom[:, None] + 1e-6)
        return np.hstack([norm, scores]).astype(np.float32)

    return blocks(tr_scores, X_tr), blocks(va_scores, X_va), blocks(te_scores, X_te)


def salience_features(X_tr, X_va, X_te, y_tr, alpha=1.0):
    """Fold-safe one-vs-rest word log-odds features."""
    K = int(y_tr.max()) + 1
    V = X_tr.shape[1]
    n_tr = X_tr.shape[0]

    total_counts = np.asarray(X_tr.sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
    total_tokens = total_counts.sum()

    tr_scores = np.zeros((n_tr, K), dtype=np.float64)
    va_scores = np.zeros((X_va.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)
    te_scores = np.zeros((X_te.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)

    for k in range(K):
        mask = y_tr == k
        cnt = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        total = cnt.sum()

        cnt_other = total_counts - cnt
        total_other = total_tokens - total

        p_k = (cnt + alpha) / (total + alpha * V)
        p_other = (cnt_other + alpha) / (total_other + alpha * V)
        log_ratio = np.log(p_k) - np.log(p_other)

        va_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_va.dot(log_ratio)).ravel()
        te_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_te.dot(log_ratio)).ravel()
        tr_scores[~mask, k] = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].dot(log_ratio)).ravel()

        for i in np.where(mask)[0]:
            row = X_tr[i]
            idx = row.indices
            if len(idx) == 0:
                continue
            data = row.data.astype(np.float64)

            cnt_loo = cnt[idx] - data
            total_loo = total - data.sum()
            cnt_other_loo = total_counts[idx] - cnt_loo
            total_other_loo = total_tokens - total_loo

            p_k_loo = (cnt_loo + alpha) / (total_loo + alpha * V)
            p_other_loo = (cnt_other_loo + alpha) / (total_other_loo + alpha * V)
            log_ratio_loo = np.log(p_k_loo) - np.log(p_other_loo)

            tr_scores[i, k] = np.dot(data, log_ratio_loo)

    denom_tr = np.asarray(X_tr.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    denom_va = np.asarray(X_va.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    denom_te = np.asarray(X_te.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

    norm_tr = tr_scores / (denom_tr[:, None] + 1e-6)
    norm_va = va_scores / (denom_va[:, None] + 1e-6)
    norm_te = te_scores / (denom_te[:, None] + 1e-6)

    return (
        np.hstack([norm_tr, tr_scores]).astype(np.float32),
        np.hstack([norm_va, va_scores]).astype(np.float32),
        np.hstack([norm_te, te_scores]).astype(np.float32),
    )


def centroid_features(X_tr, X_va, X_te, y_tr):
    """Fold-safe leave-one-out TF-IDF centroid similarity features."""
    K = int(y_tr.max()) + 1
    n_tr = X_tr.shape[0]

    raw_tr = np.zeros((n_tr, K), dtype=np.float64)
    raw_va = np.zeros((X_va.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)
    raw_te = np.zeros((X_te.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)

    for k in range(K):
        mask = y_tr == k
        n = int(mask.sum())
        S = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        cent = S / max(n, 1)

        raw_va[:, k] = np.asarray(X_va.dot(cent)).ravel()
        raw_te[:, k] = np.asarray(X_te.dot(cent)).ravel()

        if n > 1:
            x_dot_S = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].dot(S)).ravel()
            x_sq = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].multiply(X_tr[mask]).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            raw_tr[mask, k] = (x_dot_S - x_sq) / (n - 1.0)

        raw_tr[~mask, k] = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].dot(cent)).ravel()

    return (
        raw_tr.astype(np.float32),
        raw_va.astype(np.float32),
        raw_te.astype(np.float32),
    )


def make_meta_features(probs):
    probs = np.clip(probs, 1e-15, 1.0)
    logp = np.log(probs)
    entropy = -np.sum(probs * logp, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    sorted_probs = np.sort(probs, axis=1)
    margin = (sorted_probs[:, -1] - sorted_probs[:, -2])[:, None]
    return np.hstack([probs, logp, entropy, margin]).astype(np.float32)

def tokenize_text(text):
    text = text.lower()
    return re.findall(r"[a-z0-9']+|[^a-z0-9\s]", text)


def build_vocab(texts, max_size=30000, min_freq=2):
    counter = Counter()
    for text in texts:
        counter.update(tokenize_text(text))
    vocab = {"<pad>": 0, "<unk>": 1, "<mask>": 2}
    for w, c in counter.most_common(max_size):
        if c < min_freq:
            break
        vocab[w] = len(vocab)
    return vocab


def encode_texts(texts, vocab, max_len=96):
    unk = vocab.get("<unk>", 1)
    ids = np.zeros((len(texts), max_len), dtype=np.int64)
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        toks = tokenize_text(text)[:max_len]
        for j, tok in enumerate(toks):
            ids[i, j] = vocab.get(tok, unk)
    return ids


class TextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, ids, labels=None):
        self.ids = torch.as_tensor(ids, dtype=torch.long)
        if labels is not None:
            self.labels = torch.as_tensor(
                np.asarray(labels, dtype=np.int64), dtype=torch.long
            )
        else:
            self.labels = None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        if self.labels is not None:
            return self.ids[idx], self.labels[idx]
        return self.ids[idx], -1


class SmallTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, vocab_size, d_model=128, nhead=4, num_layers=2, max_len=96, dropout=0.2
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.emb = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, d_model, padding_idx=0)
        self.pos = nn.Embedding(max_len, d_model)
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model,
            nhead=nhead,
            dim_feedforward=512,
            dropout=dropout,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.head = nn.Linear(d_model, 3)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, ids):
        mask = ids != 0
        positions = (
            torch.arange(ids.size(1), device=ids.device)
            .unsqueeze(0)
            .expand(ids.size(0), -1)
        )
        x = self.emb(ids) + self.pos(positions)
        x = self.encoder(x, src_key_padding_mask=~mask)
        lengths = mask.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1).float()
        x = (x * mask.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=1) / lengths
        x = self.dropout(x)
        logits = self.head(x)
        return x, logits


def mask_tokens(ids, mask_id=2, p=0.15):
    augmented = ids.clone()
    rand = torch.rand(ids.shape, device=ids.device)
    mask = (ids != 0) & (rand < p)
    augmented[mask] = mask_id
    return augmented


def predict_custom(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, _ in loader:
            x = x.to(device)
            _, logits = model(x)
            probs.append(torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1).cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(probs)


def run_custom_transformer(
    train_ids,
    train_labels,
    val_ids,
    val_labels,
    test_ids,
    vocab_size,
    device,
    seed=0,
    epochs=3,
):
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)

    max_len = train_ids.shape[1]
    model = SmallTransformer(
        vocab_size, d_model=128, nhead=4, num_layers=2, max_len=max_len
    ).to(device)

    train_ds = TextDataset(train_ids, train_labels)
    val_ds = TextDataset(val_ids)
    test_ds = TextDataset(test_ids)

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=64, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=128, shuffle=False)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=128, shuffle=False)
    test_cons_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=64, shuffle=True)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=5e-4, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(optimizer, T_max=epochs)

    best_ll = float("inf")
    best_state = None
    test_iter = iter(test_cons_loader)

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for x, y in train_loader:
            x = x.to(device)
            y = y.to(device)

            _, logits = model(x)
            ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, y, label_smoothing=0.1)

            try:
                xt, _ = next(test_iter)
            except StopIteration:
                test_iter = iter(test_cons_loader)
                xt, _ = next(test_iter)
            xt = xt.to(device)

            xt1 = mask_tokens(xt, mask_id=2, p=0.15)
            xt2 = mask_tokens(xt, mask_id=2, p=0.15)
            _, logits1 = model(xt1)
            _, logits2 = model(xt2)

            p1 = torch.softmax(logits1, dim=-1)
            p2 = torch.softmax(logits2, dim=-1)
            cons_loss = F.mse_loss(p1, p2)

            p_avg = 0.5 * (p1 + p2)
            entropy_loss = -(p_avg * torch.log(p_avg + 1e-8)).sum(dim=1).mean()

            loss = ce_loss + 0.5 * cons_loss + 0.1 * entropy_loss

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        scheduler.step()

        val_prob = predict_custom(model, val_loader, device)
        val_prob = np.clip(val_prob, 1e-15, 1.0)
        ll = log_loss(val_labels, val_prob)
        if ll < best_ll:
            best_ll = ll
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())

    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    val_prob = predict_custom(model, val_loader, device)
    test_prob = predict_custom(model, test_loader, device)
    return val_prob.astype(np.float32), test_prob.astype(np.float32)


class HFTextDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, encodings, labels=None):
        self.encodings = encodings
        if labels is not None:
            self.labels = np.asarray(labels, dtype=np.int64)
        else:
            self.labels = None

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.encodings["input_ids"])

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {k: v[idx] for k, v in self.encodings.items()}
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx], dtype=torch.long)
        return item


def predict_hf(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            batch = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items()}
            logits = model(**batch).logits
            probs.append(torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1).cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(probs)


def run_pretrained_transformer(
    train_texts, train_labels, val_texts, val_labels, test_texts, device, epochs=3
):
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification

    model_name = "distilbert-base-uncased"
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name, local_files_only=True)
    model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        model_name, local_files_only=True, num_labels=3
    )
    model.to(device)

    train_enc = tokenizer(
        train_texts, truncation=True, padding=True, max_length=96, return_tensors="pt"
    )
    val_enc = tokenizer(
        val_texts, truncation=True, padding=True, max_length=96, return_tensors="pt"
    )
    test_enc = tokenizer(
        test_texts, truncation=True, padding=True, max_length=96, return_tensors="pt"
    )

    train_ds = HFTextDataset(train_enc, train_labels)
    val_ds = HFTextDataset(val_enc)
    test_ds = HFTextDataset(test_enc)

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32, shuffle=True)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=64, shuffle=False)
    test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=64, shuffle=False)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-5)
    best_ll = float("inf")
    best_state = None

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for batch in train_loader:
            batch = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items()}
            outputs = model(**batch)
            logits = outputs.logits
            loss = F.cross_entropy(logits, batch["labels"], label_smoothing=0.1)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()

        val_prob = predict_hf(model, val_loader, device)
        val_prob = np.clip(val_prob, 1e-15, 1.0)
        ll = log_loss(val_labels, val_prob)
        if ll < best_ll:
            best_ll = ll
            best_state = copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())

    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    val_prob = predict_hf(model, val_loader, device)
    test_prob = predict_hf(model, test_loader, device)
    return val_prob.astype(np.float32), test_prob.astype(np.float32)


def train_transformer_base(
    train_texts,
    train_labels,
    val_texts,
    val_labels,
    test_texts,
    train_ids,
    val_ids,
    test_ids,
    vocab_size,
    device,
    seed=0,
):
    global _HF_AVAILABLE
    if _HF_AVAILABLE:
        try:
            return run_pretrained_transformer(
                train_texts, train_labels, val_texts, val_labels, test_texts, device
            )
        except Exception:
            _HF_AVAILABLE = False

    return run_custom_transformer(
        train_ids,
        train_labels,
        val_ids,
        val_labels,
        test_ids,
        vocab_size,
        device,
        seed=seed,
        epochs=3,
    )

import os
import gc
import time
import warnings

os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HUB_OFFLINE"] = "1"
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import sparse as sp
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import (
    CountVectorizer,
    TfidfVectorizer,
    ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS,
)
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB, ComplementNB
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import TruncatedSVD, NMF
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
import lightgbm as lgb
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader

SEED = 42
N_SPLITS = 5


def set_seed(seed=SEED):
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def handcrafted_features(texts):
    words = texts.str.split()
    num_words = words.str.len().astype(np.float32)
    num_unique = words.apply(lambda x: len(set(x))).astype(np.float32)
    avg_word_len = words.apply(
        lambda x: float(np.mean([len(w) for w in x])) if len(x) else 0.0
    ).astype(np.float32)
    num_chars = texts.str.len().astype(np.float32)
    stop_count = texts.apply(
        lambda s: sum(1 for w in s.split() if w.lower() in ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)
    ).astype(np.float32)

    df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "num_chars": num_chars,
            "num_words": num_words,
            "num_unique": num_unique,
            "avg_word_len": avg_word_len,
            "stopword_count": stop_count,
            "stopword_ratio": stop_count / (num_words + 1e-6),
            "unique_ratio": num_unique / (num_words + 1e-6),
            "exclam": texts.str.count("!").astype(np.float32),
            "quest": texts.str.count(r"\?").astype(np.float32),
            "comma": texts.str.count(",").astype(np.float32),
            "semicolon": texts.str.count(";").astype(np.float32),
            "colon": texts.str.count(":").astype(np.float32),
            "quote": texts.str.count('"').astype(np.float32),
            "apostrophe": texts.str.count("'").astype(np.float32),
            "digit": texts.str.count(r"\d").astype(np.float32),
            "caps": texts.str.count(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b").astype(np.float32),
            "sentence": texts.str.count(r"[.!?]").astype(np.float32) + 1.0,
        }
    )
    return df.values.astype(np.float32)


def lm_features(X_tr, X_va, X_te, y_tr, alpha=0.15, lam=0.75, alpha_global=0.15):
    """
    Fold-safe author language-model likelihood features.
    Training rows use exact leave-one-out counts for their true author.
    Validation/test rows use only training-fold counts.
    """
    K = int(y_tr.max()) + 1
    V = X_tr.shape[1]
    n_tr = X_tr.shape[0]

    total_counts = np.asarray(X_tr.sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
    total_tokens = total_counts.sum()
    global_denom = total_tokens + alpha_global * V
    global_prob_all = (total_counts + alpha_global) / global_denom

    class_counts = []
    class_tokens = []
    for k in range(K):
        c = np.asarray(X_tr[y_tr == k].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        class_counts.append(c)
        class_tokens.append(c.sum())

    def make_logp(counts, total):
        author_prob = (counts + alpha) / (total + alpha * V)
        p = lam * author_prob + (1.0 - lam) * global_prob_all
        return np.log(p)

    tr_scores = np.zeros((n_tr, K), dtype=np.float64)
    va_scores = np.zeros((X_va.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)
    te_scores = np.zeros((X_te.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)

    for k in range(K):
        logp_k = make_logp(class_counts[k], class_tokens[k])

        not_mask = y_tr != k
        if not_mask.any():
            tr_scores[not_mask, k] = np.asarray(X_tr[not_mask].dot(logp_k)).ravel()

        va_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_va.dot(logp_k)).ravel()
        te_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_te.dot(logp_k)).ravel()

        mask = y_tr == k
        for i in np.where(mask)[0]:
            row = X_tr[i]
            idx = row.indices
            if len(idx) == 0:
                continue
            data = row.data.astype(np.float64)
            row_sum = data.sum()

            loo_counts = class_counts[k][idx] - data
            loo_total = class_tokens[k] - row_sum

            author_prob = (loo_counts + alpha) / (loo_total + alpha * V)
            global_prob = global_prob_all[idx]
            p = lam * author_prob + (1.0 - lam) * global_prob
            tr_scores[i, k] = np.dot(data, np.log(p))

    def blocks(scores, X):
        denom = np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        norm = scores / (denom[:, None] + 1e-6)
        return np.hstack([norm, scores]).astype(np.float32)

    return blocks(tr_scores, X_tr), blocks(va_scores, X_va), blocks(te_scores, X_te)


def centroid_features(X_tr, X_va, X_te, y_tr):
    """
    Fold-safe leave-one-out TF-IDF centroid similarity features.
    """
    K = int(y_tr.max()) + 1
    n_tr = X_tr.shape[0]

    raw_tr = np.zeros((n_tr, K), dtype=np.float64)
    raw_va = np.zeros((X_va.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)
    raw_te = np.zeros((X_te.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)

    for k in range(K):
        mask = y_tr == k
        n = int(mask.sum())
        S = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        cent = S / max(n, 1)

        raw_va[:, k] = np.asarray(X_va.dot(cent)).ravel()
        raw_te[:, k] = np.asarray(X_te.dot(cent)).ravel()

        if n > 1:
            x_dot_S = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].dot(S)).ravel()
            x_sq = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].multiply(X_tr[mask]).sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            raw_tr[mask, k] = (x_dot_S - x_sq) / (n - 1.0)

        raw_tr[~mask, k] = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].dot(cent)).ravel()

    return (
        raw_tr.astype(np.float32),
        raw_va.astype(np.float32),
        raw_te.astype(np.float32),
    )


class DenoisingAE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_dim, hidden):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, hidden), nn.ReLU())
        self.decoder = nn.Linear(hidden, in_dim)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.decoder(self.encoder(x))

    def encode(self, x):
        return self.encoder(x)


def train_autoencoder_embeddings(X, hidden=64, epochs=25, batch_size=256, device="cpu"):
    scaler = StandardScaler().fit(X)
    Xs = scaler.transform(X).astype(np.float32)
    tensor_X = torch.tensor(Xs, dtype=torch.float32)
    dataset = TensorDataset(tensor_X)
    loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, drop_last=False)

    model = DenoisingAE(X.shape[1], hidden).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()

    model.train()
    for _ in range(epochs):
        for (xb,) in loader:
            xb = xb.to(device)
            noisy = xb + torch.randn_like(xb) * 0.1
            rec = model(noisy)
            loss = criterion(rec, xb)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

    model.eval()
    embeddings = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        eval_loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=1024, shuffle=False)
        for (xb,) in eval_loader:
            xb = xb.to(device)
            embeddings.append(model.encode(xb).cpu().numpy())
    return np.vstack(embeddings).astype(np.float32)


def make_meta_features(probs, n_models):
    P = np.clip(probs, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)
    logP = np.log(P)

    feats = [P, logP]

    for m in range(n_models):
        block = P[:, m * 3 : (m + 1) * 3]
        ent = -np.sum(block * np.log(block), axis=1, keepdims=True)
        sorted_block = np.sort(block, axis=1)
        margin = (sorted_block[:, -1] - sorted_block[:, -2])[:, None]
        feats.append(ent)
        feats.append(margin)

    P3 = P.reshape(-1, n_models, 3)
    feats.append(P3.mean(axis=1))
    feats.append(P3.std(axis=1))

    return np.hstack(feats).astype(np.float32)


def safe_log_loss(y_true, y_pred):
    return log_loss(y_true, np.clip(y_pred, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15))


def stacker_pipe(C):
    return make_pipeline(
        StandardScaler(),
        LogisticRegression(C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, random_state=SEED),
    )


def select_best_C(X, y, candidates):
    best_score = np.inf
    best_C = candidates[0]
    for C in candidates:
        cv_pred = np.zeros((len(y), 3), dtype=np.float64)
        inner_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED + 100)
        for tr, va in inner_skf.split(X, y):
            pipe = stacker_pipe(C)
            pipe.fit(X[tr], y[tr])
            cv_pred[va] = pipe.predict_proba(X[va])
        score = safe_log_loss(y, cv_pred)
        if score < best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_C = C
    return best_C


def main():
    start = time.time()
    set_seed()

    train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

    train["text"] = train["text"].astype(str)
    test["text"] = test["text"].astype(str)

    le = LabelEncoder()
    y = le.fit_transform(train["author"].values)
    n_train = len(train)

    all_text = pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], ignore_index=True)

    # ---------- Sparse representations ----------
    word_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=120000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        lowercase=True,
    )
    char_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=150000,
        lowercase=True,
    )
    rev_char_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=120000,
        lowercase=True,
    )
    word3_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=120000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        lowercase=True,
    )
    char_long_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(5, 8),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=100000,
        lowercase=True,
    )

    Xw_all = word_tfidf.fit_transform(all_text)
    Xc_all = char_tfidf.fit_transform(all_text)
    Xr_all = rev_char_tfidf.fit_transform(all_text.str[::-1])
    Xw3_all = word3_tfidf.fit_transform(all_text)
    Xcl_all = char_long_tfidf.fit_transform(all_text)

    # Unsupervised SVD latent features
    combo_svd_all = sp.hstack([Xw_all, Xc_all, Xr_all]).tocsr()
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, algorithm="randomized", random_state=SEED)
    D_all = svd.fit_transform(combo_svd_all).astype(np.float32)
    del combo_svd_all
    gc.collect()

    # Unsupervised NMF topic features
    try:
        nmf = NMF(n_components=24, init="nndsvda", random_state=SEED, max_iter=150)
        N_all = nmf.fit_transform(Xw_all).astype(np.float32)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"NMF failed, using zeros: {e}", flush=True)
        N_all = np.zeros((len(all_text), 24), dtype=np.float32)

    # Self-supervised denoising autoencoder embeddings
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Device: {device}", flush=True)
    AE_input = np.hstack([D_all, N_all]).astype(np.float32)
    A_all = train_autoencoder_embeddings(AE_input, hidden=64, epochs=25, device=device)

    # Handcrafted stylometry
    H_all = handcrafted_features(all_text)

    # Count matrices for fold-safe language models
    word_cv = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        max_features=180000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        lowercase=True,
    )
    char_cv = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        max_features=180000,
        lowercase=True,
    )

    Wc_all = word_cv.fit_transform(all_text)
    Cc_all = char_cv.fit_transform(all_text)

    # Split into train / test
    Xw_train, Xw_test = Xw_all[:n_train], Xw_all[n_train:]
    Xc_train, Xc_test = Xc_all[:n_train], Xc_all[n_train:]
    Xr_train, Xr_test = Xr_all[:n_train], Xr_all[n_train:]
    Xw3_train, Xw3_test = Xw3_all[:n_train], Xw3_all[n_train:]
    Xcl_train, Xcl_test = Xcl_all[:n_train], Xcl_all[n_train:]

    D_train, D_test = D_all[:n_train], D_all[n_train:]
    N_train, N_test = N_all[:n_train], N_all[n_train:]
    A_train, A_test = A_all[:n_train], A_all[n_train:]
    H_train, H_test = H_all[:n_train], H_all[n_train:]

    Wc_train, Wc_test = Wc_all[:n_train], Wc_all[n_train:]
    Cc_train, Cc_test = Cc_all[:n_train], Cc_all[n_train:]

    del Xw_all, Xc_all, Xr_all, Xw3_all, Xcl_all
    del D_all, N_all, A_all, H_all, Wc_all, Cc_all
    gc.collect()

    # Global scaling for the autoencoder-only base model
    scaler_ae = StandardScaler().fit(A_train)
    A_scaled_train = scaler_ae.transform(A_train).astype(np.float32)
    A_scaled_test = scaler_ae.transform(A_test).astype(np.float32)

    Xall_test = sp.hstack([Xw_test, Xc_test, Xr_test]).tocsr()

    base_names = [
        "lr_combo",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_rev",
        "lr_word3",
        "lr_char_long",
        "lr_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "lr_lm",
        "lr_ae",
        "mnb_word",
        "cnb_char",
    ]
    n_base = len(base_names)

    oof_stack = np.zeros((n_train, n_base * 3), dtype=np.float64)
    test_stack = np.zeros((len(test), n_base * 3), dtype=np.float64)

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_SPLITS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(train.index, y), 1):
        print(f"Fold {fold}/{N_SPLITS} start", flush=True)
        y_tr = y[tr_idx]

        Xw_tr = Xw_train[tr_idx]
        Xw_va = Xw_train[va_idx]
        Xc_tr = Xc_train[tr_idx]
        Xc_va = Xc_train[va_idx]
        Xr_tr = Xr_train[tr_idx]
        Xr_va = Xr_train[va_idx]
        Xw3_tr = Xw3_train[tr_idx]
        Xw3_va = Xw3_train[va_idx]
        Xcl_tr = Xcl_train[tr_idx]
        Xcl_va = Xcl_train[va_idx]

        Xall_tr = sp.hstack([Xw_tr, Xc_tr, Xr_tr]).tocsr()
        Xall_va = sp.hstack([Xw_va, Xc_va, Xr_va]).tocsr()

        # Fold-safe language model features
        lm_w_tr, lm_w_va, lm_w_te = lm_features(
            Wc_train[tr_idx], Wc_train[va_idx], Wc_test, y_tr
        )
        lm_c_tr, lm_c_va, lm_c_te = lm_features(
            Cc_train[tr_idx], Cc_train[va_idx], Cc_test, y_tr
        )
        lm_tr = np.hstack([lm_w_tr, lm_c_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_va = np.hstack([lm_w_va, lm_c_va]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te = np.hstack([lm_w_te, lm_c_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Fold-safe centroid similarity features
        cent_tr, cent_va, cent_te = centroid_features(Xw_tr, Xw_va, Xw_test, y_tr)

        dense_raw_tr = np.hstack(
            [
                D_train[tr_idx],
                N_train[tr_idx],
                A_train[tr_idx],
                H_train[tr_idx],
                lm_tr,
                cent_tr,
            ]
        ).astype(np.float32)
        dense_raw_va = np.hstack(
            [
                D_train[va_idx],
                N_train[va_idx],
                A_train[va_idx],
                H_train[va_idx],
                lm_va,
                cent_va,
            ]
        ).astype(np.float32)
        dense_raw_te = np.hstack(
            [D_test, N_test, A_test, H_test, lm_te, cent_te]
        ).astype(np.float32)

        scaler_lm = StandardScaler().fit(lm_tr)
        lm_tr_s = scaler_lm.transform(lm_tr).astype(np.float32)
        lm_va_s = scaler_lm.transform(lm_va).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te_s = scaler_lm.transform(lm_te).astype(np.float32)

        scaler_dense = StandardScaler().fit(dense_raw_tr)
        dense_tr_s = scaler_dense.transform(dense_raw_tr).astype(np.float32)
        dense_va_s = scaler_dense.transform(dense_raw_va).astype(np.float32)
        dense_te_s = scaler_dense.transform(dense_raw_te).astype(np.float32)

        # ---- Base models ----

        # 1. Word + char + reversed-char TF-IDF logistic regression
        lr_combo = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_combo.fit(Xall_tr, y_tr)
        p_combo_va = lr_combo.predict_proba(Xall_va)
        p_combo_te = lr_combo.predict_proba(Xall_test)

        # 2. Character TF-IDF logistic regression
        lr_char = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_char.fit(Xc_tr, y_tr)
        p_char_va = lr_char.predict_proba(Xc_va)
        p_char_te = lr_char.predict_proba(Xc_test)

        # 3. Reversed character TF-IDF logistic regression
        lr_rev = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_rev.fit(Xr_tr, y_tr)
        p_rev_va = lr_rev.predict_proba(Xr_va)
        p_rev_te = lr_rev.predict_proba(Xr_test)

        # 4. Word trigram TF-IDF logistic regression
        lr_word3 = LogisticRegression(C=2.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_word3.fit(Xw3_tr, y_tr)
        p_word3_va = lr_word3.predict_proba(Xw3_va)
        p_word3_te = lr_word3.predict_proba(Xw3_test)

        # 5. Long character n-gram TF-IDF logistic regression
        lr_char_long = LogisticRegression(C=2.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_char_long.fit(Xcl_tr, y_tr)
        p_charlong_va = lr_char_long.predict_proba(Xcl_va)
        p_charlong_te = lr_char_long.predict_proba(Xcl_test)

        # 6. Logistic regression on dense features
        lr_dense = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_dense.fit(dense_tr_s, y_tr)
        p_dense_va = lr_dense.predict_proba(dense_va_s)
        p_dense_te = lr_dense.predict_proba(dense_te_s)

        # 7. LightGBM on raw dense features
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(dense_raw_tr, label=y_tr)
        dva = lgb.Dataset(
            dense_raw_va, label=y[va_idx], reference=dtr, free_raw_data=False
        )
        lgb_params = {
            "objective": "multiclass",
            "num_class": 3,
            "metric": "multi_logloss",
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
            "feature_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
            "bagging_freq": 1,
            "lambda_l2": 1.0,
            "verbosity": -1,
            "seed": SEED,
            "num_threads": 4,
        }
        bst = lgb.train(
            lgb_params,
            dtr,
            num_boost_round=600,
            valid_sets=[dva],
            callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50)],
        )
        p_lgb_va = bst.predict(dense_raw_va, num_iteration=bst.best_iteration)
        p_lgb_te = bst.predict(dense_raw_te, num_iteration=bst.best_iteration)

        # 8. Logistic regression on language-model features
        lr_lm = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_lm.fit(lm_tr_s, y_tr)
        p_lm_va = lr_lm.predict_proba(lm_va_s)
        p_lm_te = lr_lm.predict_proba(lm_te_s)

        # 9. Logistic regression on autoencoder embeddings
        lr_ae = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_ae.fit(A_scaled_train[tr_idx], y_tr)
        p_ae_va = lr_ae.predict_proba(A_scaled_train[va_idx])
        p_ae_te = lr_ae.predict_proba(A_scaled_test)

        # 10. Multinomial NB on word counts
        mnb = MultinomialNB(alpha=1.0)
        mnb.fit(Wc_train[tr_idx], y_tr)
        p_mnb_va = mnb.predict_proba(Wc_train[va_idx])
        p_mnb_te = mnb.predict_proba(Wc_test)

        # 11. Calibrated Complement NB on character counts
        cnb_cal = CalibratedClassifierCV(
            ComplementNB(alpha=1.0), method="sigmoid", cv=3
        )
        cnb_cal.fit(Cc_train[tr_idx], y_tr)
        p_cnb_va = cnb_cal.predict_proba(Cc_train[va_idx])
        p_cnb_te = cnb_cal.predict_proba(Cc_test)

        val_preds = np.hstack(
            [
                p_combo_va,
                p_char_va,
                p_rev_va,
                p_word3_va,
                p_charlong_va,
                p_dense_va,
                p_lgb_va,
                p_lm_va,
                p_ae_va,
                p_mnb_va,
                p_cnb_va,
            ]
        )
        test_preds = np.hstack(
            [
                p_combo_te,
                p_char_te,
                p_rev_te,
                p_word3_te,
                p_charlong_te,
                p_dense_te,
                p_lgb_te,
                p_lm_te,
                p_ae_te,
                p_mnb_te,
                p_cnb_te,
            ]
        )

        oof_stack[va_idx] = val_preds
        test_stack += test_preds

        print(f"Fold {fold}/{N_SPLITS} done", flush=True)

    test_stack /= N_SPLITS

    print("\nBase OOF log losses:")
    for i, name in enumerate(base_names):
        p = np.clip(oof_stack[:, i * 3 : (i + 1) * 3], 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
        print(f"  {name}: {log_loss(y, p):.6f}")

    avg_pred = oof_stack.reshape(n_train, n_base, 3).mean(axis=1)
    print(f"Simple average CV log loss: {safe_log_loss(y, avg_pred):.6f}")

    # ---- Stacking ----
    meta_train = make_meta_features(oof_stack, n_base)
    meta_test = make_meta_features(test_stack, n_base)

    candidates = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0]

    outer_skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_SPLITS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    meta_cv = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float64)

    for tr, va in outer_skf.split(meta_train, y):
        best_C = select_best_C(meta_train[tr], y[tr], candidates)
        pipe = stacker_pipe(best_C)
        pipe.fit(meta_train[tr], y[tr])
        meta_cv[va] = pipe.predict_proba(meta_train[va])

    stacked_logloss = safe_log_loss(y, meta_cv)
    print(f"5-fold CV log loss (stacked): {stacked_logloss:.6f}")

    # Final stacker fit on all OOF meta-features
    best_C_full = select_best_C(meta_train, y, candidates)
    final_pipe = stacker_pipe(best_C_full)
    final_pipe.fit(meta_train, y)
    test_prob = final_pipe.predict_proba(meta_test)
    test_prob = np.clip(test_prob, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    test_prob = test_prob / test_prob.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"].astype(str)})
    for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
        submission[col] = test_prob[:, list(le.classes_).index(col)]

    submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved submission.csv", submission.shape)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - start:.1f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import gc
import time
import warnings

os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HUB_OFFLINE"] = "1"
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

    CountVectorizer,
    TfidfVectorizer,
    HashingVectorizer,

)

from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler

import lightgbm as lgb

SEED = 42
N_SPLITS = 5
np.random.seed(SEED)


def handcrafted_features(texts):
    """Handcrafted stylometric features."""
    words = texts.str.split()
    num_words = words.str.len().astype(np.float32)
    num_unique = words.apply(lambda x: len(set(x))).astype(np.float32)
    avg_word_len = words.apply(
        lambda x: float(np.mean([len(w) for w in x])) if len(x) else 0.0
    ).astype(np.float32)
    num_chars = texts.str.len().astype(np.float32)
    stop_count = texts.apply(
        lambda s: sum(1 for w in s.split() if w.lower() in ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)
    ).astype(np.float32)

    df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "num_chars": num_chars,
            "num_words": num_words,
            "num_unique": num_unique,
            "avg_word_len": avg_word_len,
            "stopword_count": stop_count,
            "stopword_ratio": stop_count / (num_words + 1e-6),
            "unique_ratio": num_unique / (num_words + 1e-6),
            "exclam": texts.str.count("!").astype(np.float32),
            "quest": texts.str.count(r"\?").astype(np.float32),
            "comma": texts.str.count(",").astype(np.float32),
            "semicolon": texts.str.count(";").astype(np.float32),
            "colon": texts.str.count(":").astype(np.float32),
            "quote": texts.str.count('"').astype(np.float32),
            "apostrophe": texts.str.count("'").astype(np.float32),
            "digit": texts.str.count(r"\d").astype(np.float32),
            "caps": texts.str.count(r"\b[A-Z]{2,}\b").astype(np.float32),
            "sentence": texts.str.count(r"[.!?]").astype(np.float32) + 1.0,
        }
    )
    return df.values.astype(np.float32)


def sentence_complexity_features(texts):
    """Unsupervised sentence-level features used by the stacker."""
    lower = texts.str.lower()
    words = texts.str.split()
    n_words = words.str.len().astype(np.float32)
    n_chars = texts.str.len().astype(np.float32)
    punct = texts.str.count(r"[!?;:,.']").astype(np.float32)
    stop = lower.str.count(
        r"\b(the|a|an|of|and|to|in|that|for|was|with|as|his|her|by|from|at)\b"
    ).astype(np.float32)
    caps = texts.str.count(r"\b[A-Z]").astype(np.float32)

    return np.column_stack(
        [
            np.log1p(n_chars),
            np.log1p(n_words),
            punct / (n_words + 1.0),
            stop / (n_words + 1.0),
            caps / (n_words + 1.0),
        ]
    ).astype(np.float32)


def lm_features(X_tr, X_va, X_te, y_tr, alpha=0.15, lam=0.75, alpha_global=0.15):
    """
    Fold-safe author language-model likelihood features.
    Training rows use exact leave-one-out counts for their true author.
    """
    K = int(y_tr.max()) + 1
    V = X_tr.shape[1]

    total_counts = np.asarray(X_tr.sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
    total_tokens = total_counts.sum()
    global_denom = total_tokens + alpha_global * V
    global_prob_all = (total_counts + alpha_global) / global_denom

    class_counts = []
    class_tokens = []
    for k in range(K):
        c = np.asarray(X_tr[y_tr == k].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        class_counts.append(c)
        class_tokens.append(c.sum())

    def make_logp(counts, total):
        author_prob = (counts + alpha) / (total + alpha * V)
        p = lam * author_prob + (1.0 - lam) * global_prob_all
        return np.log(p)

    n_tr = X_tr.shape[0]
    tr_scores = np.zeros((n_tr, K), dtype=np.float64)
    va_scores = np.zeros((X_va.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)
    te_scores = np.zeros((X_te.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)

    for k in range(K):
        logp_k = make_logp(class_counts[k], class_tokens[k])

        not_mask = y_tr != k
        if not_mask.any():
            tr_scores[not_mask, k] = np.asarray(X_tr[not_mask].dot(logp_k)).ravel()

        va_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_va.dot(logp_k)).ravel()
        te_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_te.dot(logp_k)).ravel()

        mask = y_tr == k
        for i in np.where(mask)[0]:
            row = X_tr[i]
            idx = row.indices
            if len(idx) == 0:
                continue
            data = row.data.astype(np.float64)
            row_sum = data.sum()

            loo_counts = class_counts[k][idx] - data
            loo_total = class_tokens[k] - row_sum

            author_prob = (loo_counts + alpha) / (loo_total + alpha * V)
            global_prob = global_prob_all[idx]
            p = lam * author_prob + (1.0 - lam) * global_prob
            tr_scores[i, k] = np.dot(data, np.log(p))

    def blocks(scores, X):
        denom = np.asarray(X.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        norm = scores / (denom[:, None] + 1e-6)
        return np.hstack([norm, scores]).astype(np.float32)

    return blocks(tr_scores, X_tr), blocks(va_scores, X_va), blocks(te_scores, X_te)


def salience_features(X_tr, X_va, X_te, y_tr, alpha=1.0):
    """
    Fold-safe one-vs-rest word log-odds features.
    Training rows use exact leave-one-out scores for their own author.
    """
    K = int(y_tr.max()) + 1
    V = X_tr.shape[1]
    n_tr = X_tr.shape[0]

    total_counts = np.asarray(X_tr.sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
    total_tokens = total_counts.sum()

    tr_scores = np.zeros((n_tr, K), dtype=np.float64)
    va_scores = np.zeros((X_va.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)
    te_scores = np.zeros((X_te.shape[0], K), dtype=np.float64)

    for k in range(K):
        mask = y_tr == k
        cnt = np.asarray(X_tr[mask].sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float64)
        total = cnt.sum()

        cnt_other = total_counts - cnt
        total_other = total_tokens - total

        p_k = (cnt + alpha) / (total + alpha * V)
        p_other = (cnt_other + alpha) / (total_other + alpha * V)
        log_ratio = np.log(p_k) - np.log(p_other)

        va_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_va.dot(log_ratio)).ravel()
        te_scores[:, k] = np.asarray(X_te.dot(log_ratio)).ravel()
        tr_scores[~mask, k] = np.asarray(X_tr[~mask].dot(log_ratio)).ravel()

        for i in np.where(mask)[0]:
            row = X_tr[i]
            idx = row.indices
            if len(idx) == 0:
                continue
            data = row.data.astype(np.float64)

            cnt_loo = cnt[idx] - data
            total_loo = total - data.sum()
            cnt_other_loo = total_counts[idx] - cnt_loo
            total_other_loo = total_tokens - total_loo

            p_k_loo = (cnt_loo + alpha) / (total_loo + alpha * V)
            p_other_loo = (cnt_other_loo + alpha) / (total_other_loo + alpha * V)
            log_ratio_loo = np.log(p_k_loo) - np.log(p_other_loo)

            tr_scores[i, k] = np.dot(data, log_ratio_loo)

    denom_tr = np.asarray(X_tr.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    denom_va = np.asarray(X_va.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    denom_te = np.asarray(X_te.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

    norm_tr = tr_scores / (denom_tr[:, None] + 1e-6)
    norm_va = va_scores / (denom_va[:, None] + 1e-6)
    norm_te = te_scores / (denom_te[:, None] + 1e-6)

    return (
        np.hstack([norm_tr, tr_scores]).astype(np.float32),
        np.hstack([norm_va, va_scores]).astype(np.float32),
        np.hstack([norm_te, te_scores]).astype(np.float32),
    )


def make_meta_features(probs):
    """Probability meta-features for final stacking."""
    probs = np.clip(probs, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)
    logp = np.log(probs)
    entropy = -np.sum(probs * logp, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    sorted_probs = np.sort(probs, axis=1)
    top1 = sorted_probs[:, -1][:, None]
    margin = (sorted_probs[:, -1] - sorted_probs[:, -2])[:, None]
    ranks = np.argsort(np.argsort(probs, axis=1), axis=1).astype(np.float32) / 2.0
    return np.hstack([probs, logp, entropy, top1, margin, ranks]).astype(np.float32)


def main():
    start = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("./data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("./data/test.csv")

    train["text"] = train["text"].astype(str)
    test["text"] = test["text"].astype(str)

    le = LabelEncoder()
    y = le.fit_transform(train["author"].values)
    n_train = len(train)

    all_text = pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], ignore_index=True)

    # ---------- Sparse TF-IDF representations ----------
    word_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=120000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        lowercase=True,
    )
    char_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=150000,
        lowercase=True,
    )
    rev_char_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=120000,
        lowercase=True,
    )
    tri_tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=150000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        lowercase=True,
    )
    hash_vec = HashingVectorizer(
        n_features=2**19,
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        alternate_sign=False,
        norm="l2",
        lowercase=True,
    )

    Xw_all = word_tfidf.fit_transform(all_text)
    Xc_all = char_tfidf.fit_transform(all_text)
    Xr_all = rev_char_tfidf.fit_transform(all_text.str[::-1])
    Xt_all = tri_tfidf.fit_transform(all_text)
    Hv_all = hash_vec.transform(all_text)

    # Dense unsupervised embeddings.
    combo_all = sp.hstack([Xw_all, Xc_all, Xr_all]).tocsr()
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, algorithm="randomized", random_state=SEED)
    D_all = svd.fit_transform(combo_all).astype(np.float32)
    del combo_all
    gc.collect()

    nmf = NMF(n_components=16, init="nndsvda", random_state=SEED, max_iter=150)
    N_all = nmf.fit_transform(Xw_all).astype(np.float32)

    H_all = handcrafted_features(all_text).astype(np.float32)
    T_all = sentence_complexity_features(all_text).astype(np.float32)

    # Count matrices for language-model and Naive Bayes models.
    word_cv = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=3,
        max_features=180000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        lowercase=True,
    )
    char_cv = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        max_features=180000,
        lowercase=True,
    )
    uni_cv = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 1),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=120000,
        strip_accents="unicode",
        token_pattern=r"\b[a-z']+\b",
        lowercase=True,
    )

    Wc_all = word_cv.fit_transform(all_text)
    Cc_all = char_cv.fit_transform(all_text)
    U_all = uni_cv.fit_transform(all_text)

    del all_text
    gc.collect()

    Xw_train, Xw_test = Xw_all[:n_train], Xw_all[n_train:]
    Xc_train, Xc_test = Xc_all[:n_train], Xc_all[n_train:]
    Xr_train, Xr_test = Xr_all[:n_train], Xr_all[n_train:]
    Xt_train, Xt_test = Xt_all[:n_train], Xt_all[n_train:]
    Hv_train, Hv_test = Hv_all[:n_train], Hv_all[n_train:]
    Wc_train, Wc_test = Wc_all[:n_train], Wc_all[n_train:]
    Cc_train, Cc_test = Cc_all[:n_train], Cc_all[n_train:]
    U_train, U_test = U_all[:n_train], U_all[n_train:]
    D_train, D_test = D_all[:n_train], D_all[n_train:]
    N_train, N_test = N_all[:n_train], N_all[n_train:]
    H_train, H_test = H_all[:n_train], H_all[n_train:]
    T_train, T_test = T_all[:n_train], T_all[n_train:]

    Xall_test = sp.hstack([Xw_test, Xc_test, Xr_test]).tocsr()

    base_names = [
        "lr_word",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_rev",
        "lr_tri",
        "lr_combo",
        "sgd_hash",
        "lr_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "mlp_dense",
        "mnb_word",
        "cnb_char",
        "bnb_word",
    ]
    n_base = len(base_names)

    oof_stack = np.zeros((n_train, n_base * 3), dtype=np.float64)
    test_stack = np.zeros((len(test), n_base * 3), dtype=np.float64)

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_SPLITS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

    lgb_params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": 3,
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_freq": 1,
        "lambda_l2": 1.0,
        "verbosity": -1,
        "seed": SEED,
        "num_threads": 4,
    }

    def set_model(name, p_va, p_te):
        k = base_names.index(name)
        oof_stack[va_idx, k * 3 : (k + 1) * 3] = p_va
        test_stack[:, k * 3 : (k + 1) * 3] += p_te

    for fold, (tr_idx, va_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(np.arange(n_train), y), 1):
        print(f"Fold {fold}/{N_SPLITS} start", flush=True)
        y_tr = y[tr_idx]

        Xw_tr = Xw_train[tr_idx]
        Xw_va = Xw_train[va_idx]
        Xc_tr = Xc_train[tr_idx]
        Xc_va = Xc_train[va_idx]
        Xr_tr = Xr_train[tr_idx]
        Xr_va = Xr_train[va_idx]

        Xall_tr = sp.hstack([Xw_tr, Xc_tr, Xr_tr]).tocsr()
        Xall_va = sp.hstack([Xw_va, Xc_va, Xr_va]).tocsr()

        # Fold-safe LM features.
        lm_w_tr, lm_w_va, lm_w_te = lm_features(
            Wc_train[tr_idx], Wc_train[va_idx], Wc_test, y_tr
        )
        lm_c_tr, lm_c_va, lm_c_te = lm_features(
            Cc_train[tr_idx], Cc_train[va_idx], Cc_test, y_tr
        )
        lm_tr = np.hstack([lm_w_tr, lm_c_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_va = np.hstack([lm_w_va, lm_c_va]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te = np.hstack([lm_w_te, lm_c_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Fold-safe word salience features.
        sal_tr, sal_va, sal_te = salience_features(
            U_train[tr_idx], U_train[va_idx], U_test, y_tr
        )

        dense_raw_tr = np.hstack(
            [D_train[tr_idx], N_train[tr_idx], H_train[tr_idx], lm_tr, sal_tr]
        ).astype(np.float32)
        dense_raw_va = np.hstack(
            [D_train[va_idx], N_train[va_idx], H_train[va_idx], lm_va, sal_va]
        ).astype(np.float32)
        dense_raw_te = np.hstack([D_test, N_test, H_test, lm_te, sal_te]).astype(
            np.float32
        )

        scaler_dense = StandardScaler().fit(dense_raw_tr)
        dense_tr_s = scaler_dense.transform(dense_raw_tr).astype(np.float32)
        dense_va_s = scaler_dense.transform(dense_raw_va).astype(np.float32)
        dense_te_s = scaler_dense.transform(dense_raw_te).astype(np.float32)

        # 1. Word TF-IDF LR
        lr_word = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_word.fit(Xw_tr, y_tr)
        set_model(
            "lr_word", lr_word.predict_proba(Xw_va), lr_word.predict_proba(Xw_test)
        )

        # 2. Character TF-IDF LR
        lr_char = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_char.fit(Xc_tr, y_tr)
        set_model(
            "lr_char", lr_char.predict_proba(Xc_va), lr_char.predict_proba(Xc_test)
        )

        # 3. Reversed character TF-IDF LR
        lr_rev = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_rev.fit(Xr_tr, y_tr)
        set_model("lr_rev", lr_rev.predict_proba(Xr_va), lr_rev.predict_proba(Xr_test))

        # 4. Word trigram TF-IDF LR
        lr_tri = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_tri.fit(Xt_train[tr_idx], y_tr)
        set_model(
            "lr_tri",
            lr_tri.predict_proba(Xt_train[va_idx]),
            lr_tri.predict_proba(Xt_test),
        )

        # 5. Combined word+char+rev TF-IDF LR
        lr_combo = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_combo.fit(Xall_tr, y_tr)
        set_model(
            "lr_combo",
            lr_combo.predict_proba(Xall_va),
            lr_combo.predict_proba(Xall_test),
        )

        # 6. Hashing vectorizer SGD logistic regression
        sgd = SGDClassifier(
            loss="log_loss",
            alpha=1e-6,
            max_iter=20,
            tol=1e-4,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        sgd.fit(Hv_train[tr_idx], y_tr)
        set_model(
            "sgd_hash",
            sgd.predict_proba(Hv_train[va_idx]),
            sgd.predict_proba(Hv_test),
        )

        # 7. Dense logistic regression
        lr_dense = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
        lr_dense.fit(dense_tr_s, y_tr)
        set_model(
            "lr_dense",
            lr_dense.predict_proba(dense_va_s),
            lr_dense.predict_proba(dense_te_s),
        )

        # 8. LightGBM dense
        dtr = lgb.Dataset(dense_raw_tr, label=y_tr)
        bst = lgb.train(lgb_params, dtr, num_boost_round=300)
        set_model("lgb_dense", bst.predict(dense_raw_va), bst.predict(dense_raw_te))

        # 9. MLP dense
        mlp = MLPClassifier(
            hidden_layer_sizes=(64, 32),
            alpha=1e-2,
            max_iter=150,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        mlp.fit(dense_tr_s, y_tr)
        set_model(
            "mlp_dense", mlp.predict_proba(dense_va_s), mlp.predict_proba(dense_te_s)
        )

        # 10. Multinomial NB on word counts
        mnb = MultinomialNB(alpha=1.0)
        mnb.fit(Wc_train[tr_idx], y_tr)
        set_model(
            "mnb_word",
            mnb.predict_proba(Wc_train[va_idx]),
            mnb.predict_proba(Wc_test),
        )

        # 11. Calibrated ComplementNB on char counts
        cnb_cal = CalibratedClassifierCV(
            ComplementNB(alpha=1.0), method="sigmoid", cv=3
        )
        cnb_cal.fit(Cc_train[tr_idx], y_tr)
        set_model(
            "cnb_char",
            cnb_cal.predict_proba(Cc_train[va_idx]),
            cnb_cal.predict_proba(Cc_test),
        )

        # 12. Calibrated BernoulliNB on word counts
        bnb_cal = CalibratedClassifierCV(BernoulliNB(alpha=0.5), method="sigmoid", cv=3)
        bnb_cal.fit(Wc_train[tr_idx], y_tr)
        set_model(
            "bnb_word",
            bnb_cal.predict_proba(Wc_train[va_idx]),
            bnb_cal.predict_proba(Wc_test),
        )

        print(f"Fold {fold}/{N_SPLITS} done", flush=True)

    test_stack /= N_SPLITS

    print("Base OOF log losses:")
    for i, name in enumerate(base_names):
        p = np.clip(oof_stack[:, i * 3 : (i + 1) * 3], 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)
        print(f"  {name}: {log_loss(y, p):.6f}")

    # Stacker meta-features.
    meta_train = np.hstack([make_meta_features(oof_stack), T_train]).astype(np.float32)
    meta_test = np.hstack([make_meta_features(test_stack), T_test]).astype(np.float32)

    # Nested 5-fold selection of stacker regularization.
    C_grid = [0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1.0]
    best_c = 0.1
    best_score = np.inf

    for C in C_grid:
        meta_cv = np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float64)
        for tr, va in skf.split(meta_train, y):
            meta_model = LogisticRegression(C=C, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
            meta_model.fit(meta_train[tr], y[tr])
            meta_cv[va] = meta_model.predict_proba(meta_train[va])
        score = log_loss(y, np.clip(meta_cv, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15))
        if score < best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_c = C

    print(f"Best stacker C: {best_c}")
    print(f"5-fold CV log loss (stacked): {best_score:.6f}")

    # Final stacker and test predictions.
    final_meta = LogisticRegression(C=best_c, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000)
    final_meta.fit(meta_train, y)
    test_prob = final_meta.predict_proba(meta_test)
    test_prob = np.clip(test_prob, 1e-15, 1.0 - 1e-15)
    test_prob = test_prob / test_prob.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)

    submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"].astype(str)})
    for col in ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]:
        submission[col] = test_prob[:, list(le.classes_).index(col)]

    submission.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Saved submission.csv", submission.shape)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - start:.1f}s")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z']+|\d+|[^\w\s]")


def normalize_rows(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-15, 1.0)
    return P / P.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


def sym_kl(logits1, logits2):
    p1 = F.softmax(logits1, dim=-1)
    p2 = F.softmax(logits2, dim=-1)
    kl1 = (p1 * (p1.log() - p2.log())).sum(dim=-1).mean()
    kl2 = (p2 * (p2.log() - p1.log())).sum(dim=-1).mean()
    return 0.5 * (kl1 + kl2)


def build_style_features(series):
    text = series.fillna("").astype(str)
    stop_words = set(ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS)
    words = text.str.split()

    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=np.arange(len(text)))
    feats["n_chars"] = text.str.len()
    feats["n_words"] = words.str.len()
    feats["n_unique"] = words.apply(lambda x: len({w.lower() for w in x}))
    feats["avg_word_len"] = feats["n_chars"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["frac_unique"] = feats["n_unique"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_sentences"] = text.str.count(r"[.!?]") + 1
    feats["n_caps_words"] = text.str.count(r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*\b")
    feats["n_upper"] = text.str.count(r"[A-Z]")
    feats["upper_ratio"] = feats["n_upper"] / feats["n_chars"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_punct"] = text.str.count(r"[^\w\s]")
    feats["n_quotes"] = text.str.count('"') + text.str.count("'")
    feats["n_excl"] = text.str.count("!")
    feats["n_ques"] = text.str.count(r"\?")
    feats["n_comma"] = text.str.count(",")
    feats["n_colon"] = text.str.count(":")
    feats["n_semic"] = text.str.count(";")
    feats["n_dash"] = text.str.count("-")
    feats["n_stop"] = words.apply(
        lambda x: sum(1 for w in x if w.lower() in stop_words)
    )
    feats["stop_ratio"] = feats["n_stop"] / feats["n_words"].replace(0, 1)
    feats["n_digit"] = text.str.count(r"\d")
    return feats.fillna(0).values.astype(np.float32)


def augment_meta(P):
    P = np.clip(P, 1e-12, 1.0)
    logs = np.log(P)
    entropy = -(P * logs).sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return np.hstack([P, logs, entropy]).astype(np.float32)


class _TextDS(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None):
        self.texts = list(texts)
        self.labels = labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        if self.labels is None:
            return self.texts[idx]
        return self.texts[idx], int(self.labels[idx])


def _make_collate(tokenizer, max_length=192):
    def collate(batch):
        if isinstance(batch[0], tuple):
            texts = [b[0] for b in batch]
            labels = [b[1] for b in batch]
        else:
            texts = batch
            labels = None

        enc = tokenizer(
            texts,
            padding=True,
            truncation=True,
            max_length=max_length,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        if labels is not None:
            return enc, torch.tensor(labels, dtype=torch.long)
        return enc

    return collate


def _predict_proba(model, loader, device, mc_passes=4):
    if mc_passes > 1:
        model.train()
    else:
        model.eval()

    all_probs = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for _ in range(mc_passes):
            preds = []
            for batch in loader:
                if isinstance(batch, (list, tuple)):
                    enc = batch[0]
                else:
                    enc = batch
                enc = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in enc.items()}
                out = model(**enc)
                logits = out.logits if hasattr(out, "logits") else out
                preds.append(F.softmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy())
            all_probs.append(np.vstack(preds))
    model.eval()
    return np.mean(all_probs, axis=0).astype(np.float32)


def train_transformer_fold(
    train_texts,
    train_y,
    val_texts,
    val_y,
    test_texts,
    model_name,
    tokenizer,
    device,
    fold,
):
    torch.manual_seed(2024 + fold)
    model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
        model_name, num_labels=3
    ).to(device)
    model.config.dropout = 0.2
    model.config.attention_dropout = 0.2
    model.config.seq_classif_dropout = 0.2

    collate = _make_collate(tokenizer)
    train_loader = DataLoader(
        _TextDS(train_texts, train_y),
        batch_size=32,
        shuffle=True,
        collate_fn=collate,
    )
    val_loader = DataLoader(
        _TextDS(val_texts, val_y),
        batch_size=64,
        shuffle=False,
        collate_fn=collate,
    )
    test_loader = DataLoader(
        _TextDS(test_texts),
        batch_size=64,
        shuffle=False,
        collate_fn=collate,
    )

    epochs = 3
    total_steps = len(train_loader) * epochs
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.01)
    scheduler = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer,
        num_warmup_steps=max(1, int(0.1 * total_steps)),
        num_training_steps=total_steps,
    )

    try:
        criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
    except TypeError:
        criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

    best_val = 1e9
    best_state = None
    patience = 0

    for epoch in range(epochs):
        model.train()
        for enc, labels in train_loader:
            enc = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in enc.items()}
            labels = labels.to(device)

            logits1 = model(**enc).logits
            logits2 = model(**enc).logits
            loss = 0.5 * (criterion(logits1, labels) + criterion(logits2, labels))
            loss = loss + 0.5 * sym_kl(logits1, logits2)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()

        val_probs = _predict_proba(model, val_loader, device, mc_passes=4)
        val_loss = log_loss(val_y, normalize_rows(val_probs))

        if val_loss < best_val:
            best_val = val_loss
            patience = 0
            best_state = {
                k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()
            }
        else:
            patience += 1
            if patience >= 2:
                break

    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)

    val_probs = _predict_proba(model, val_loader, device, mc_passes=4)
    test_probs = _predict_proba(model, test_loader, device, mc_passes=4)
    return val_probs.astype(np.float32), test_probs.astype(np.float32)


class _ScratchTextDS(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None):
        self.texts = list(texts)
        self.labels = labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        if self.labels is None:
            return self.texts[idx]
        return self.texts[idx], int(self.labels[idx])


def _make_scratch_collate(vocab, max_len=192):
    def collate(batch):
        if isinstance(batch[0], tuple):
            texts = [b[0] for b in batch]
            labels = [b[1] for b in batch]
        else:
            texts = batch
            labels = None

        ids = []
        masks = []
        for text in texts:
            seq = [vocab.get(tok, 1) for tok in TOKEN_RE.findall(text.lower())][
                :max_len
            ]
            mask = [1] * len(seq)
            seq += [0] * (max_len - len(seq))
            mask += [0] * (max_len - len(mask))
            ids.append(seq)
            masks.append(mask)

        enc = {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(ids, dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.tensor(masks, dtype=torch.long),
        }
        if labels is not None:
            return enc, torch.tensor(labels, dtype=torch.long)
        return enc

    return collate


def build_vocab(texts, max_vocab=30000):
    from collections import Counter

    counter = Counter()
    for text in texts:
        counter.update(TOKEN_RE.findall(text.lower()))
    vocab = {"<pad>": 0, "<unk>": 1}
    for w, _ in counter.most_common(max_vocab - 2):
        vocab[w] = len(vocab)
    return vocab


class MiniTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size,
        d_model=128,
        nhead=4,
        num_layers=2,
        max_len=192,
        num_classes=3,
        dropout=0.2,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embed = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, d_model, padding_idx=0)
        self.pos = nn.Embedding(max_len, d_model)
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d_model,
            nhead=nhead,
            dim_feedforward=512,
            dropout=dropout,
            activation="gelu",
            batch_first=True,
        )
        self.encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=num_layers)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.cls = nn.Linear(d_model, num_classes)

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
        seq_len = input_ids.size(1)
        x = self.embed(input_ids) + self.pos(
            torch.arange(seq_len, device=input_ids.device)
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        key_padding_mask = attention_mask == 0
        x = self.encoder(x, src_key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask)
        mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        h = (x * mask).sum(dim=1) / mask.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1.0)
        return self.cls(self.dropout(h))

def compute_lm_block(
    count_mat,
    fold_train_idx,
    fold_val_idx,
    fold_test_idx,
    y_train_fold,
    alpha=0.5,
):
    classes = [0, 1, 2]
    vocab_size = count_mat.shape[1]

    sums_by_class = []
    for c in classes:
        mask = y_train_fold == c
        sums_by_class.append(
            np.asarray(count_mat[fold_train_idx[mask]].sum(axis=0))
            .ravel()
            .astype(np.float64)
        )

    X_tr = count_mat[fold_train_idx]
    X_val = count_mat[fold_val_idx]
    X_te = count_mat[fold_test_idx]

    n_tr = len(fold_train_idx)
    n_val = len(fold_val_idx)
    n_te = len(fold_test_idx)

    lm_tr = np.zeros((n_tr, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    lm_val = np.zeros((n_val, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    lm_te = np.zeros((n_te, 3), dtype=np.float64)

    for c in classes:
        sums = sums_by_class[c] + alpha
        denom = sums.sum()
        logw = np.log(sums / denom)

        raw_tr = X_tr @ logw
        raw_val = X_val @ logw
        raw_te = X_te @ logw

        ntok_tr = np.asarray(X_tr.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        ntok_val = np.asarray(X_val.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
        ntok_te = np.asarray(X_te.sum(axis=1)).ravel()

        lm_tr[:, c] = raw_tr / (ntok_tr + 1e-6)
        lm_val[:, c] = raw_val / (ntok_val + 1e-6)
        lm_te[:, c] = raw_te / (ntok_te + 1e-6)

    for c in classes:
        idxs = np.where(y_train_fold == c)[0]
        total = sums_by_class[c].sum()
        for i in idxs:
            row = X_tr.getrow(i)
            row_sum = float(row.sum())
            denom = total - row_sum + alpha * vocab_size
            score = 0.0
            for j, val in zip(row.indices, row.data):
                num = sums_by_class[c][j] + alpha - val
                if num <= 0:
                    num = alpha
                score += val * math.log(num / denom)
            lm_tr[i, c] = score / (row_sum + 1e-6)

    return lm_tr.astype(np.float32), lm_val.astype(np.float32), lm_te.astype(np.float32)


def try_load_pretrained():
    if not TRANSFORMERS_OK:
        return None
    for name in ["distilbert-base-uncased"]:
        try:
            tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(name)
            model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
                name, num_labels=3
            )
            del model
            if torch.cuda.is_available():
                torch.cuda.empty_cache()
            return (name, tokenizer)
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None


def main():
    t0 = time.time()

    train = pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv("data/test.csv")
    sample = pd.read_csv("data/sample_submission.csv")

    classes = list(sample.columns[1:])
    label_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    y = train["author"].map(label_map).values.astype(int)

    n_train = train.shape[0]
    n_test = test.shape[0]
    test_idx = np.arange(n_train, n_train + n_test)

    all_texts = (
        pd.concat([train["text"], test["text"]], ignore_index=True)
        .fillna("")
        .astype(str)
        .tolist()
    )

    print("Building text features...", flush=True)

    tf_word12 = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=60000,
    )
    tf_char25 = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=60000,
    )
    tf_word3 = TfidfVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        min_df=2,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=80000,
    )
    tf_char_rev = TfidfVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(2, 5),
        min_df=3,
        sublinear_tf=True,
        max_features=60000,
    )

    X_all_word12 = tf_word12.fit_transform(all_texts)
    X_all_char25 = tf_char25.fit_transform(all_texts)
    X_all_word3 = tf_word3.fit_transform(all_texts)
    rev_texts = [t[::-1] for t in all_texts]
    X_all_char_rev = tf_char_rev.fit_transform(rev_texts)

    X_all_combined = hstack([X_all_word12, X_all_char25]).tocsr()

    cnt_word = CountVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 1),
        min_df=2,
        max_features=50000,
    )
    cnt_char = CountVectorizer(
        analyzer="char_wb",
        ngram_range=(4, 4),
        min_df=3,
        max_features=50000,
    )
    X_cnt_word = cnt_word.fit_transform(all_texts)
    X_cnt_char = cnt_char.fit_transform(all_texts)

    hashing = HashingVectorizer(
        ngram_range=(1, 3),
        n_features=2**20,
        alternate_sign=False,
        norm=None,
    )
    X_hash_all = hashing.transform(all_texts)

    print("Building SVD / NMF / style features...", flush=True)

    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=100, random_state=42)
    svd_all = svd.fit_transform(X_all_combined).astype(np.float32)

    nmf = NMF(n_components=25, init="random", random_state=42, max_iter=200)
    nmf_all = nmf.fit_transform(X_all_word12).astype(np.float32)

    style_all = build_style_features(pd.Series(all_texts))

    base_dense_all = np.hstack([svd_all, nmf_all, style_all]).astype(np.float32)
    base_dense_train = base_dense_all[:n_train]
    base_dense_test = base_dense_all[n_train:]

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print("Device:", device, flush=True)

    deep_spec = None
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        pretrained = try_load_pretrained()
        if pretrained is not None:
            deep_spec = {
                "kind": "pretrained",
                "name": pretrained[0],
                "tokenizer": pretrained[1],
            }
            print("Using pretrained transformer with R-Drop.", flush=True)
        else:
            vocab = build_vocab(all_texts)
            deep_spec = {"kind": "scratch", "vocab": vocab}
            print("Using from-scratch transformer with R-Drop on GPU.", flush=True)

    all_possible = [
        "lr_all",
        "lr_word3",
        "lr_char",
        "lr_rev",
        "sgd_hash",
        "nb_word",
        "cnb_word",
        "lr_dense",
        "lgb_dense",
        "et_dense",
        "deep",
    ]

    oof = {name: np.zeros((n_train, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in all_possible}
    test_pred = {name: np.zeros((n_test, 3), dtype=np.float32) for name in all_possible}

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    train_texts = train["text"].astype(str).tolist()
    test_texts = test["text"].astype(str).tolist()

    deep_enabled = deep_spec is not None

    print("Running 5-fold CV...", flush=True)

    for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(np.zeros(n_train), y)):
        print(f"  Fold {fold + 1}/5", flush=True)
        y_tr = y[tr_idx]
        y_val = y[val_idx]

        lm_word_tr, lm_word_val, lm_word_te = compute_lm_block(
            X_cnt_word, tr_idx, val_idx, test_idx, y_tr
        )
        lm_char_tr, lm_char_val, lm_char_te = compute_lm_block(
            X_cnt_char, tr_idx, val_idx, test_idx, y_tr
        )
        lm_tr = np.hstack([lm_word_tr, lm_char_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_val = np.hstack([lm_word_val, lm_char_val]).astype(np.float32)
        lm_te = np.hstack([lm_word_te, lm_char_te]).astype(np.float32)

        dense_tr = np.hstack([base_dense_train[tr_idx], lm_tr]).astype(np.float32)
        dense_val = np.hstack([base_dense_train[val_idx], lm_val]).astype(np.float32)
        dense_te = np.hstack([base_dense_test, lm_te]).astype(np.float32)

        # Combined word+char TF-IDF logistic regression
        m = LogisticRegression(C=4.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4)
        m.fit(X_all_word12[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["lr_all"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_all_word12[val_idx])
        test_pred["lr_all"] += m.predict_proba(X_all_word12[test_idx]) / 5

        # Word trigram TF-IDF logistic regression
        m = LogisticRegression(C=3.0, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1500, tol=1e-4)
        m.fit(X_all_word3[tr_idx], y_tr)
        oof["lr_word3"][val_idx] = m.predict_proba(X_all_word3[val_idx])
        test_pred["lr_word3"] += m.predict_proba(X_all_word3[test_idx]) / 5

        # Character TF-IDF logistic regression

    final_pipe = Pipeline(
        [

            (
                "lr",
                LogisticRegression(C=best_c, solver="lbfgs", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-4),
            ),
        ]
    )
    final_pipe.fit(X_meta, y)
    final_test = normalize_rows(
        final_pipe.predict_proba(X_meta_test).astype(np.float32)

    sub = test[["id"]].copy()

    sub.to_csv("submission.csv", index=False)
    print(f"Saved submission.csv with {sub.shape[0]} rows", flush=True)
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)
